机器人的身体 · 从电池里的电到关节上的力矩 · 从下往上The robot’s body · From the electricity in the battery to the torque at the joints · From the bottom up

从电池到力矩From Battery to Torque

厨房机器人的手臂够不着吊柜，我们给它加一根升降柱。第一版装上去，抬是抬起来了，停在顶上三秒钟，就连着手臂一起滑到了底。这一篇顺着这根升降柱，把机器人"执行"的那一层从头拆开：电池里的电怎样经过驱动器变成电流，电流怎样在电机里变成力矩；为什么规格书上的堵转力矩是额定力矩的十几倍，能长期用的却只有额定那一点；减速器为什么把力矩放大 N 倍，却把转子的惯量放大 N² 倍；行星、谐波、摆线减速器和丝杠各自怎么工作，间隙、摩擦和柔性藏在哪里，什么东西能被推着倒转、什么不能；编码器装在电机侧还是关节侧，力矩怎么量；按下急停，硬件上到底切断了什么。最后读一份真的规格书和一份接口说明，把升降柱从头选一遍，再拿同样的问题去看几台别的机器人。The kitchen robot’s arm cannot reach the wall cabinet, so we give it a lift column. The first version goes on, and it does lift; but after three seconds at the top it slides all the way to the bottom, arm and all. Following that lift column, this page takes the robot’s "actuation" layer apart from the beginning: how the electricity in the battery becomes current by way of the drive, and how that current becomes torque in the motor; why the stall torque on a datasheet is a dozen or so times the nominal torque, yet only that small nominal amount can be used for long periods; why a reducer multiplies torque by N but multiplies the rotor’s inertia by N²; how planetary, strain wave and cycloidal reducers and screws each work, where backlash, friction and compliance hide, and what can be pushed into turning backwards and what cannot; whether the encoder goes on the motor side or the joint side, and how torque is measured; and what pressing the E-stop actually cuts off in the hardware. At the end we read a real datasheet and an interface description, choose the lift column’s parts again from scratch, and then put the same questions to a few other robots.

速查忘了某个说法，查下面的速查表Quick referenceForgot a term? Look it up in the quick-reference table below

单位约定：力用牛顿 N，力矩用 N·m（1 mN·m 是千分之一 N·m，1 N·cm 是百分之一 N·m）；电流用安培 A，电压用伏特 V，电阻用欧姆 Ω（1 mΩ 是千分之一 Ω），功率用瓦特 W（1 W 就是每秒 1 焦耳 J），电池的能量用 Wh（1 Wh = 3600 J）；转速用每分钟转数 rpm 或者 rad/s（1 rpm = 2π/60 ≈ 0.105 rad/s）；温度用 °C，温差用 K（差 1 K 就是差 1 °C）；长度用 m、mm、µm（1 µm 是千分之一毫米）；角度用 °、′（角分，1′ = 1/60°）和 rad；g ≈ 9.81 m/s2。文中说"我们算的"，是用本页仓库里 actuation/calc/ 的小程序算出来的；说"估"的是没有出处的数量级估计；说"示意"的是为了讲清楚而定的设计或编的例子。升降柱、电池和底盘的电机是我们按真实产品给这台虚构的机器人配的，零件的数据都来自厂家的规格书。这一篇能单独读：前几篇提到过的电流环、PWM、急停，这里都从头讲一遍。Units: force in newtons, N, and torque in N·m (1 mN·m is a thousandth of a N·m, and 1 N·cm a hundredth of a N·m); current in amperes, A, voltage in volts, V, and resistance in ohms, Ω (1 mΩ is a thousandth of an Ω); power in watts, W (1 W is 1 joule, J, per second), and the battery’s energy in Wh (1 Wh = 3600 J); rotational speed in revolutions per minute, rpm, or in rad/s (1 rpm = 2π/60 ≈ 0.105 rad/s); temperature in °C, and temperature differences in K (a difference of 1 K is a difference of 1 °C); lengths in m, mm and µm (1 µm is a thousandth of a millimetre); angles in °, ′ (minutes of arc, 1′ = 1/60°) and rad; g ≈ 9.81 m/s2. Where the text says "our arithmetic", the number was worked out with the small programs in actuation/calc/ in this page’s repository; anything marked "est." is an order-of-magnitude estimate with no source; and anything marked "illustrative" is a design chosen, or an example made up, to make things clear. We chose the lift column, the battery and the base’s motors for this fictional robot from real products, and all the parts’ data come from the manufacturers’ datasheets. This page can be read on its own: the current loop, PWM and the E-stop, which earlier pages mentioned, are all explained again here from scratch.

速查表：本篇用到的说法、记号和缩写Quick reference: the terms, notation and abbreviations used on this page

电机Motors

力矩常数 ktTorque constant kt
每安培电流出多少力矩，单位 N·m/A（第 ① 步）How much torque each ampere of current gives, in N·m/A (step ①)
反电动势、反电动势常数 keBack-EMF, back-EMF constant ke
电机转起来时，线圈里自己产生的、顶着电源的电压；每 rad/s 产生多少伏。按国际单位，ke 和 kt 是同一个数（第 ① 步）The voltage that the coils generate by themselves when the motor turns, pushing back against the supply; how many volts it generates per rad/s. In SI units, ke and kt are the same number (step ①)
空载转速、堵转力矩No-load speed, stall torque
不带负载时转多快；把轴卡住不让转时出多大力矩（第 ① 步）How fast it turns with no load; how much torque it gives when the shaft is held so that it cannot turn (step ①)
额定力矩（最大连续力矩）Nominal torque (max. continuous torque)
能一直出、绕组又不过热的力矩，由热决定（第 ② 步）The torque it can give indefinitely without the winding overheating; it is set by heat (step ②)
铜损、热阻、热时间常数Copper loss, thermal resistance, thermal time constant
电流流过绕组电阻变成的热 I²R；每瓦热造成多少度温升（K/W）；温度变化有多快（第 ② 步）The heat I²R produced when current flows through the winding’s resistance; how many degrees of temperature rise each watt of heat causes (K/W); how quickly the temperature changes (step ②)
无刷电机、换相、霍尔传感器Brushless motor, commutation, Hall sensors
磁铁在转子上、线圈在定子上的电机；按转子的角度轮流给各相线圈通电；告诉驱动器转子大致转到哪的三个小传感器（第 ① 步）A motor with the magnets on the rotor and the coils on the stator; powering each phase’s coils in turn according to the rotor’s angle; three small sensors that tell the drive roughly where the rotor has turned to (step ①)

电和驱动器Power and drives

电芯、串联、内阻、压降Cell, series connection, internal resistance, voltage sag
电池里的单节；串起来电压相加；电池内部的电阻；电流大时端电压往下掉的那一截（第 ③ 步）A single unit inside the battery; connected in series, their voltages add up; the resistance inside the battery; how far the terminal voltage drops when the current is large (step ③)
母线Bus (DC bus)
电池接出来、给各个驱动器供电的那对直流电源线（第 ③ 步）The pair of DC supply lines that come out of the battery and power all the drives (step ③)
PWM、占空比PWM, duty cycle
开关很快地通、断，用"接通的时间占几成"来调平均电压（第 ③ 步）Switching on and off very fast, and setting the average voltage by "what fraction of the time it is on" (step ③)
驱动器、电流环Drive, current loop
把指令变成电机电流的那块电路板；它里面最快的那个控制环，让电流跟上指令（第 ③、⑪ 步）The circuit board that turns commands into motor current; the fastest control loop inside it, which makes the current follow the command (steps ③ and ⑪)
回馈Regeneration
电机被负载拖着转时变成发电机，把能量送回母线（第 ③ 步）When the load drags the motor round, the motor becomes a generator and sends energy back into the bus (step ③)
CiA 402、控制字、状态字CiA 402, controlword, statusword
驱动器常用的一套标准：它的状态机，用来下命令的那个数，报告状态的那个数（第 ⑪ 步）A standard that drives commonly follow, with its state machine; the number used to give commands; the number that reports the state (step ⑪)

传动Transmission

减速比 N、效率 ηGear ratio N, efficiency η
输入转 N 圈、输出转 1 圈；输出功率占输入功率的比例（第 ④ 步）The input turns N times for every 1 turn of the output; the output power as a fraction of the input power (step ④)
折算惯量Reflected inertia
站在输出端看，电机转子"相当于"多大的惯量（转动的东西）或质量（直线运动的东西）（第 ④ 步）Seen from the output, how much inertia (for something that turns) or mass (for something that moves in a straight line) the motor’s rotor "amounts to" (step ④)
行星、谐波、摆线（RV）减速器Planetary, strain wave (harmonic) and cycloidal (RV) reducers
三种常见的减速器（第 ⑤ 步）Three common kinds of reducer (step ⑤)
丝杠、导程、导程角、自锁Screw, lead, lead angle, self-locking
把转动变成直线运动的螺杆；转一圈螺母走多远；螺纹的倾角；负载推不动它倒转（第 ⑥ 步）A threaded rod that turns rotation into straight-line motion; how far the nut moves in one turn; the angle at which the thread slopes; the load cannot push it into turning backwards (step ⑥)
回差（间隙）、空程、柔性Backlash (clearance), lost motion, compliance
齿和齿之间的空隙；换向时输入转了、输出还没动的那一段；受力时会扭、会弯（第 ⑦ 步）The gap between meshing teeth; the stretch, after a reversal, where the input has turned but the output has not yet moved; twisting and bending under load (step ⑦)
反驱Backdriving
从输出端推，能把电机推着倒转（第 ⑧ 步）Pushing from the output end can turn the motor backwards (step ⑧)

传感器和安全Sensors and safety

增量式、绝对式编码器，回零Incremental and absolute encoders, homing
只数转过了多少格；每个角度都有自己的编号；增量式上电以后先走到一个已知的位置（第 ⑨ 步）Only counts how many ticks it has turned through; every angle has its own number; after power-up, an incremental one first moves to a known position (step ⑨)
应变片、电桥Strain gauge, bridge
贴在受力件上、被拉长时电阻变大的薄片；把电阻的微小变化变成电压的电路（第 ⑩ 步）A thin patch stuck onto a loaded part, whose resistance goes up when it is stretched; a circuit that turns tiny changes in resistance into a voltage (step ⑩)
停止类别 0、1、2Stop categories 0, 1, 2
立即切断动力；先受控地停下再切断；受控地停下、动力保留（第 ⑫ 步）Cut the power at once; stop under control first, then cut the power; stop under control and keep the power on (step ⑫)
STO（安全转矩关断）STO (safe torque off)
驱动器里的一个安全功能：封锁功率管的驱动信号，电机出不了力（第 ⑫ 步）A safety function in the drive: it blocks the signals that switch the power transistors, so the motor cannot produce torque (step ⑫)
安全继电器、接触器、制动器Safety relay, contactor, brake
专门处理急停信号、自己检查自己的继电器；能切断大电流的电磁开关；断电时靠弹簧抱住轴的刹车（第 ⑫ 步）A relay built specially to handle E-stop signals, which checks itself; an electromagnetic switch that can cut large currents; a brake that clamps the shaft with a spring when the power is off (step ⑫)

第 0 步 · 给厨房机器人加一根升降柱Step 0 · Adding a lift column to the kitchen robot

第一版升降柱The first lift column

还是那台厨房机器人（第 15–18 篇）：差速底盘，两个轮子，轮子半径 0.08 m；头上一台 RealSense 深度相机，底盘前面一台激光雷达；一条七个关节的 Franka Research 3（FR3）手臂，末端是 Franka 的夹爪；一台 Jetson AGX Thor 做感知和规划，一台跑实时内核的小电脑每毫秒和手臂交换一次数据，一块单片机管轮子。第 17 篇里，台面上方有一排吊柜，柜底比台面高 0.50 m。现在要它把洗好的杯子放回吊柜的上层，可手臂装在底盘上，够不着。The same kitchen robot again (pages 15–18): a differential-drive base with two wheels of radius 0.08 m; a RealSense depth camera on its head and a lidar at the front of the base; a seven-joint Franka Research 3 (FR3) arm with Franka’s gripper on the end; a Jetson AGX Thor for perception and planning, a small computer running a real-time kernel that exchanges data with the arm once every millisecond, and a microcontroller in charge of the wheels. On page 17 there was a row of wall cabinets above the counter, with their undersides 0.50 m above it. Now the robot has to put the washed cups back on the upper shelf of the wall cabinets, but the arm is mounted on the base and cannot reach.

办法是在手臂下面加一根升降柱：一根竖直的导轨，上面一个滑台，手臂装在滑台上，滑台能升起 0.40 m。滑台要扛的是 FR3 手臂 18.3 kg、夹爪 0.73 kg、最多 3 kg 的负载，再加上滑台自己约 4 kg，一共约 26 kg，重力 255.1 N（升降柱的设计和滑台的质量是示意的，其余的数来自 FR3 规格书 和 夹爪的产品页）。The fix is to put a lift column under the arm: a vertical rail with a carriage on it, the arm mounted on the carriage, and the carriage able to rise 0.40 m. The carriage has to carry the FR3 arm at 18.3 kg, the gripper at 0.73 kg and a payload of up to 3 kg, plus about 4 kg for the carriage itself: about 26 kg in all, a weight of 255.1 N (the lift column’s design and the carriage’s mass are illustrative; the other numbers come from the FR3 datasheet and the gripper’s product page).

第一版是这样配的：一台 maxon 的 EC 45 flat 无刷电机（70 W，24 V 绕组），轴直接连一根导程 10 mm 的滚珠丝杠，丝杠转一圈，滑台升 10 mm；电机由一块 maxon EPOS4 驱动器供电。选电机时算了一下：要把 255.1 N 抬起来，电机得出 0.451 N·m 的力矩，而规格书上写着"堵转力矩 1690 mN·m"，0.451 N·m 才用到它的 27%（我们算的），看上去绰绰有余。装好一试，抬是抬起来了。可滑台停在顶上，大约三秒钟以后，它连着手臂一起往下滑，不到一秒就滑到了底（我们按示意的参数算的：0.7 s）。Design 1 was put together like this: a maxon EC 45 flat brushless motor (70 W, 24 V winding), its shaft coupled directly to a ball screw with a 10 mm lead, so that one turn of the screw raises the carriage 10 mm; the motor was powered by a maxon EPOS4 drive. A quick calculation when choosing the motor: to lift 255.1 N, the motor has to give 0.451 N·m of torque, and the datasheet says "stall torque 1690 mN·m", so 0.451 N·m uses only 27% of it (our arithmetic). That looked like more than enough. Built and tried, it did lift. But with the carriage stopped at the top, after about three seconds it started to slide down, arm and all, and in under a second it was at the bottom (our arithmetic, with illustrative parameters: 0.7 s).

第二版换成导程 5 mm 的丝杠，电机和丝杠之间再加一个 3.5 比 1 的行星减速器。这回往上抬，电机只要出 0.0716 N·m，算上它自己的摩擦也只要 2.04 A；停在顶上托着要的还更少，一点事没有。直到有一天，手臂举着杯子在吊柜前的时候，有人按下了急停：手臂受控地停住，然后"咔"的一声落进它关节里的锁止销，往下沉了一点（FR3 的硬件手册说，锁止销锁上时手臂会往下沉几厘米）；可升降柱又滑下去了，这次花了约 1.6 s（我们算的）。最后加了一个断电时靠弹簧抱住电机轴的制动器，才算稳了。Design 2 switched to a screw with a 5 mm lead and added a 3.5:1 planetary gearhead between the motor and the screw. This time raising needed only 0.0716 N·m from the motor, or 2.04 A counting its own friction; holding at the top took even less, and there was no trouble at all. Until one day, while the arm was holding a cup up in front of the wall cabinet, someone pressed the E-stop: the arm stopped under control, then dropped onto the locking bolts in its joints with a "click" and sank a little (the FR3 hardware manual says the arm sinks by a few centimetres when the locking bolts engage); but the lift column slid down again, this time in about 1.6 s (our arithmetic). Only when a brake was added, one whose spring clamps the motor shaft when the power is off, did it finally stay put.

还有一件小事。底盘在吊柜前来回挪几次对准位置，里程计说它回到了原地，其实差了一点：每换一次方向，电机都要先空转过轮子减速器里齿和齿之间的间隙，轮子才跟着动，这一截约 1.40 mm（我们算的），编码器数进去了，轮子却没走。正反两次会互相抵消，这个差不会越攒越多，可停下来时总可能差上一个间隙；两个轮子差得不一样，朝向也会偏（第 ⑦ 步）。量轮子转了多少的编码器装在电机上，它看不见这件事。There was one more small thing. The base shuffled back and forth a few times in front of the wall cabinet to line itself up, and the odometry said it was back where it started, but in fact it was slightly off: every time the direction reverses, the motor first has to turn idly through the gap between the teeth in the wheel’s gearhead before the wheel moves with it. That stretch is about 1.40 mm (our arithmetic): the encoder counts it, but the wheel does not move. A reversal one way and a reversal back cancel each other out, so this error does not keep building up, but when the base stops it can always be off by one gap; and if the two wheels are off by different amounts, the heading is off too (step ⑦). The encoder that measures how far the wheels have turned is mounted on the motor, so it cannot see any of this.

这三件事指向同一个问题：力矩是从哪来的，一路上会在哪里卡住？从电池到滑台，中间要过这样一条链：All three point to the same question: where does the torque come from, and where along the way can it get stuck? From the battery to the carriage, it has to pass through a chain like this:

  • 电池：8 节磷酸铁锂电芯串起来，额定 25.6 V；经过保险丝和电池管理板（BMS）接到母线上，给所有驱动器和电脑供电（第 ③ 步）。Battery: 8 LiFePO4 cells in series, 25.6 V nominal; it connects to the bus through a fuse and a battery management system (BMS), and powers all the drives and computers (step ③).
  • 驱动器：把母线的直流电，按指令"切"成三相电流送进电机；它里面有一层套一层的控制环（最里面是电流环），还有一套状态机和各种保护（第 ③、⑪ 步）。Drive: chops the bus’s direct current into three-phase currents for the motor, as commanded; inside it are control loops nested one inside another (the current loop innermost), plus a state machine and a set of protections (steps ③ and ⑪).
  • 电机：电流变成力矩，转起来又产生一个顶着电源的电压（第 ① 步）；能长期出多大力矩，由发热决定（第 ② 步）。Motor: current becomes torque, and when it turns it also generates a voltage that pushes back against the supply (step ①); how much torque it can give for long periods is set by how hot it gets (step ②).
  • 减速器：把电机又快又小的力矩，换成又慢又大的力矩，代价是把转子的惯量放大了减速比的平方倍（第 ④、⑤ 步）。Gearhead: it trades the motor’s fast, small torque for slow, large torque; the price is that the rotor’s inertia is multiplied by the square of the gear ratio (steps ④ and ⑤).
  • 丝杠：把转动变成滑台的直线运动；滚珠丝杠会被重物推着倒转（第 ⑥、⑧ 步）。Screw: it turns rotation into the carriage’s straight-line motion; a ball screw can be pushed into turning backwards by a heavy load (steps ⑥ and ⑧).
  • 滑台和手臂：最后的负载。中间的间隙、摩擦和柔性，让"电机转了多少"和"负载动了多少"不完全一样（第 ⑦ 步）。Carriage and arm: the final load. The backlash, friction and compliance along the way mean that "how far the motor has turned" and "how far the load has moved" are not quite the same (step ⑦).

链旁边还有两样东西。一样是传感器：电机上的霍尔传感器和编码器、驱动器里量电流的电路、FR3 每个关节里的力矩传感器，它们告诉控制器现在转到了哪、出了多大的力（第 ⑨、⑩ 步）。另一样是安全链：急停按钮、安全继电器、切断动力的接触器和制动器，不经过任何软件就能把力矩拿走（第 ⑫ 步）。这一篇要回答这些问题：Beside the chain are two more things. One is the sensors: the Hall sensors and the encoder on the motor, the current-measuring circuit in the drive, and the torque sensor in each FR3 joint, which tell the controller where things have turned to and how much force is being applied (steps ⑨ and ⑩). The other is the safety chain: the E-stop button, the safety relay, the contactors that cut the power, and the brake, which can take the torque away without going through any software (step ⑫). This page sets out to answer these questions:

  1. 电流怎么变成力矩？为什么电机转得越快，能出的力矩越小？How does current become torque? Why can a motor give less torque the faster it turns?
  2. 规格书上的堵转力矩是 1.69 N·m，为什么能长期用的只有 0.134 N·m？The stall torque on the datasheet is 1.69 N·m, so why can only 0.134 N·m be used for long periods?
  3. 电池的电压会往下掉，这对电机意味着什么？驱动器在中间做什么？The battery’s voltage sags: what does that mean for the motor? And what does the drive in between do?
  4. 减速比为什么把力矩放大 N 倍，却把转子的惯量放大 N² 倍？Why does a gear ratio multiply torque by N, but multiply the rotor’s inertia by N²?
  5. 行星、谐波、摆线减速器各自怎么减速，各有什么脾气？How do planetary, strain wave and cycloidal reducers each reduce speed, and what are their quirks?
  6. 丝杠为什么有的会自己倒转，有的不会？Why do some screws turn backwards by themselves, while others do not?
  7. 间隙、摩擦和柔性藏在哪，会让机器人差多少？Where do backlash, friction and compliance hide, and how far off can they make the robot?
  8. 什么叫能反驱，为什么它这么重要？What does it mean to be backdrivable, and why does it matter so much?
  9. 编码器该装在电机侧还是关节侧？力矩又怎么量？Should the encoder go on the motor side or the joint side? And how is torque measured?
  10. 驱动器怎么听指令，出了错会怎样？How does a drive take commands, and what happens when something goes wrong?
  11. 按下急停，硬件上到底切断了什么？升降柱为什么会掉下来？When the E-stop is pressed, what exactly is cut off in the hardware? Why does the lift column fall?
  12. 怎么读一份规格书和一份接口说明，怎么把升降柱选对？How do you read a datasheet and an interface description, and how do you choose the right parts for the lift column?
  • 左边（手机上在上面）是机器人的侧视图：底盘、电池、升降柱（导轨、滑台、丝杠，底下是电机和减速器）、滑台上的手臂，前上方是吊柜。右边是这根升降柱的整条链：电池 → 保险丝和 BMS → 母线 → 驱动器 → 电机 → 减速器 → 丝杠 → 滑台和手臂；下面一排是传感器，再下面一排是安全链。On the left (at the top on a phone) is a side view of the robot: the base, the battery, the lift column (the rail, the carriage and the screw, with the motor and gearhead at the bottom), the arm on the carriage, and the wall cabinet above and in front. On the right is the lift column’s whole chain: Battery → Fuse & BMS → Bus → Drive → Motor → Gearhead → Ball screw → Carriage & arm; the row below it is the sensors, and the row below that is the safety chain.
  • 四个模式：抬起来（默认，以 0.10 m/s 往上抬）、停住（停在顶上）、放下来（以 0.10 m/s 往下放）、急停（在顶上按）。每一格里写着这一段往下传了多少瓦、自己变成了多少热（橙色的"↓"），格子之间的连线跟着功率变粗，能量倒着流时箭头也倒过来。开关制动器（默认开）；开关第一版换成第一版的配法（导程 10 mm、没有减速器、没有制动器，所以制动器开关会变灰）；重来。点链上的任意一格，会弹出一张小卡片：它是做什么的、关键的数、会出什么问题、哪一步讲它。读数是母线电流、电机电流、电机力矩、转速、总效率和滑台高度。Four modes: Raise (the default; lifts at 0.10 m/s), Hold (stays at the top), Lower (lowers at 0.10 m/s) and E-stop (pressed at the top). Each box shows how many watts that link passes on down the chain and how much it turns into heat itself (the orange "↓"); the lines between the boxes get thicker with the power, and when the energy flows backwards the arrows turn round too. Switches: Brake (on by default), and Design 1, which swaps in the first design’s set-up (10 mm lead, no gearhead, no brake, so the brake switch greys out); Restart. Tap any box in the chain and a small card pops up: what it does, the key numbers, what can go wrong, and which step covers it. The readouts are Bus current, Motor current, Motor torque, Speed, Overall efficiency and Carriage height.

先玩：在抬起来模式下，从母线进来的 40.8 W，最后有多少变成了"高度"？热都出在哪几段？换到停住：这时做了多少功，电机还在耗多少电？按放下来：能量倒着流，回到母线的那十几瓦去了哪儿？打开第一版再按停住，看那个三秒钟的倒计时走完以后发生了什么。最后回到第二版，关掉制动器，按急停。Try first: In Raise mode, of the 40.8 W coming in from the bus, how much ends up as "height"? Which links does the heat come from? Switch to Hold: how much work is being done now, and how much power is the motor still using? Press Lower: the energy flows backwards, so where do the dozen or so watts going back into the bus end up? Turn on Design 1 and press Hold, and watch what happens when the three-second countdown runs out. Finally, go back to design 2, switch Brake off and press E-stop.

这一步的要点：从电池到滑台，力矩要过一整条链：电池给电压，驱动器把电压变成电流，电机把电流变成力矩，减速器和丝杠把它变成负载要的力和速度。每一段都有自己的极限（电压、电流、温度、强度），也都会吃掉一部分功率变成热；而当动力被切断的时候，什么东西还能托住负载，是另一个要单独回答的问题。The point of this step: From the battery to the carriage, torque has to pass through a whole chain: the battery supplies the voltage, the drive turns the voltage into current, the motor turns the current into torque, and the gearhead and screw turn that into the force and speed the load needs. Every link has its own limits (voltage, current, temperature, strength), and every link eats some of the power and turns it into heat. And when the power is cut, what can still hold the load up is a separate question that needs its own answer.

第 ① 步 · 电流给力矩，转动给电压Step ① · Current gives torque, turning gives voltage

电流怎么变成力矩How current becomes torque

先看一根导线。把它放在磁铁的两极之间，让电流从里面流过，它会被推向一侧，推力和电流成正比，也和磁场的强弱、导线在磁场里的长度成正比。把导线绕成一个线圈，放在能转的轴上，线圈两条边上的电流方向相反，一条被往上推，一条被往下推，这两个推力绕着轴就形成了一个力矩。线圈的匝数、磁铁的强弱、线圈的半径，对一台做好的电机都是固定的，所以力矩只和电流有关，而且成正比：Start with a single wire. Put it between the two poles of a magnet and let a current flow through it, and it is pushed to one side; the push is proportional to the current, and also to the strength of the magnetic field and to the length of wire in the field. Wind the wire into a coil and mount it on a shaft that can turn: the current runs in opposite directions along the coil’s two sides, so one side is pushed up and the other down, and together the two pushes form a torque about the shaft. Once a motor is built, the number of turns in the coil, the strength of the magnets and the radius of the coil are all fixed, so the torque depends only on the current, and is proportional to it:

τ = kt I

电机出的力矩，等于力矩常数乘以电流。The torque a motor gives equals the torque constant times the current.

每一小段导线受的力是 B·I·ℓ（磁场乘电流乘导线长度），乘上它到轴的距离就是它贡献的力矩。把所有导线加起来，B、ℓ、半径、匝数都并进一个常数 kt，剩下的变量只有电流 I。所以想控制力矩，就控制电流：驱动器里最里面那一层控制环管的就是电流（第 ③ 步）。The force on each short piece of wire is B·I·ℓ (field times current times wire length); multiply it by the piece’s distance from the shaft and you have the torque it contributes. Add up all the wire, and B, ℓ, the radius and the number of turns all merge into a single constant, kt, leaving the current I as the only variable. So to control torque, you control current: the innermost control loop in the drive is the one that looks after the current (step ③).

τ
电流产生的力矩（N·m）；轴上拿到的还要减去电机自己的摩擦，这台约 10.9 mN·m（后面的算例会加上它）the torque produced by the current (N·m); the shaft gets this minus the motor’s own friction, about 10.9 mN·m for this motor (the worked examples below add it in)
kt
力矩常数：每安培电流出多少力矩（N·m/A），由线圈和磁铁决定，写在规格书上the torque constant: how much torque each ampere of current gives (N·m/A); set by the coil and the magnets, and given in the datasheet
I
流过线圈的电流（A）the current flowing through the coil (A)

升降柱用的 EC 45 flat 70 W（24 V 绕组）：kt = 40.4 mN·m/A（maxon 规格书），1 A 出 0.0404 N·m。第二版托住滑台要 0.0716 N·m，就是 0.0716 / 0.0404 = 1.77 A；第一版要 0.451 N·m，就是 11.2 A（我们算的）。The lift’s EC 45 flat 70 W (24 V winding): kt = 40.4 mN·m/A (maxon datasheet), so 1 A gives 0.0404 N·m. Design 2 needs 0.0716 N·m to hold up the carriage, which is 0.0716 / 0.0404 = 1.77 A; design 1 needs 0.451 N·m, which is 11.2 A (our arithmetic).

同一个机壳的电机，常常有好几种绕组。这一款还有 36 V、48 V、60 V 的，kt 分别是 57、80.8、152 mN·m/A（maxon 目录页）。线圈匝数多，每安培的力矩大，可电阻也大，转起来产生的电压也高。按"同样的铜损能换多少力矩"算（kt/√R：力矩 = kt/√R × √铜损，单位 N·m/√W），四种绕组都在 0.046–0.056 之间（我们算的），额定力矩也在 110–143 mN·m 之间（目录页）：换绕组主要换的是"用高电压小电流，还是低电压大电流"，能出多大的力只差两三成。The same motor housing often comes with several different windings. This one is also made with 36 V, 48 V and 60 V windings, whose kt is 57, 80.8 and 152 mN·m/A respectively (maxon catalogue page). A coil with more turns gives more torque per ampere, but it also has more resistance, and generates a higher voltage as it turns. Measured by "how much torque the same copper loss buys" (kt/√R: torque = kt/√R × √copper loss, in N·m/√W), all four windings come out at 0.046–0.056 (our arithmetic), and their nominal torques at 110–143 mN·m (catalogue page): changing the winding mainly changes "high voltage and small current, or low voltage and large current"; the force the motor can deliver differs by only twenty or thirty per cent.

线圈转起来以后，事情多了一半。导线在磁场里运动，导线里会自己产生电压，这是发电机的原理。这个电压的方向，正好顶着外面加上去的电压，所以叫反电动势；转得越快，它越大：Once the coil is turning, there is a second half to the story. When a wire moves through a magnetic field, a voltage arises in the wire by itself: this is how a generator works. This voltage points exactly against the voltage applied from outside, which is why it is called back-EMF; the faster the motor turns, the larger it is:

e = ke ω,  ke = ktV = R I + L dI/dt + ke ω

反电动势等于反电动势常数乘以角速度，而这个常数和力矩常数是同一个数。加在电机两端的电压，一部分花在线圈电阻上，一部分花在电感上（电流变化时），剩下的用来顶住反电动势。The back-EMF equals the back-EMF constant times the angular speed, and this constant is the same number as the torque constant. Of the voltage across the motor, part is spent on the coil’s resistance, part on its inductance (while the current is changing), and the rest goes to countering the back-EMF.

为什么 ke 和 kt 相等？看能量。电源要把电流 I 推过反电动势 e，每秒要做 e·I 的功；这部分功不变成热，全部变成了电流产生的力矩做的功 τω（轴上拿到的再少一点摩擦）。所以 keω·I = ktI·ω，两边一约，ke = kt（用国际单位时，V·s/rad 和 N·m/A 是同一个单位）。第二行就是电机的电路：一个电阻、一个电感，再串一个随转速变的"电池"。Why are ke and kt equal? Look at the energy. To push the current I through the back-EMF e, the supply has to do e·I of work every second; this work does not turn into heat: all of it becomes the work τω done by the torque the current produces (the shaft gets a little less, after friction). So keω·I = ktI·ω; cancel the common factors and ke = kt (in SI units, V·s/rad and N·m/A are the same unit). The second line is the motor’s circuit: a resistor, an inductor, and in series with them a "battery" whose voltage changes with speed.

e
反电动势（V）the back-EMF (V)
ke
反电动势常数（V·s/rad）；规格书常写它的倒数"转速常数"，单位 rpm/Vthe back-EMF constant (V·s/rad); datasheets often give its reciprocal instead, the "speed constant", in rpm/V
ω
电机的角速度（rad/s）；n 是同一个速度用 rpm 表示，n = ω·60/2πthe motor’s angular speed (rad/s); n is the same speed in rpm, n = ω·60/2π
V
加在电机两端的电压（V）the voltage across the motor’s terminals (V)
R, L
线圈的电阻（Ω）和电感（H）the coil’s resistance (Ω) and inductance (H)
dI/dt
电流变化的快慢（A/s）；电流不变时这一项为 0how fast the current is changing (A/s); when the current is steady, this term is 0

规格书写转速常数 236 rpm/V，换算成 ke = 1/(236 × 2π/60) = 0.0405 V·s/rad，和 kt = 0.0404 N·m/A 几乎一样（我们算的）。第二版抬滑台时，电机以 4200 rpm（439.8 rad/s）出 0.0716 N·m，加上电机自己的摩擦 10.9 mN·m，电流 2.04 A：电阻上要 0.573 × 2.04 = 1.17 V，顶反电动势要 0.0405 × 439.8 = 17.8 V，一共 18.97 V（我们算的）。停着托住时，ω = 0，只要 0.573 × 1.77 = 1.01 V。The datasheet gives a speed constant of 236 rpm/V, which converts to ke = 1/(236 × 2π/60) = 0.0405 V·s/rad, almost the same as kt = 0.0404 N·m/A (our arithmetic). When design 2 raises the carriage, the motor gives 0.0716 N·m at 4200 rpm (439.8 rad/s); add the motor’s own friction of 10.9 mN·m and the current is 2.04 A: the resistance takes 0.573 × 2.04 = 1.17 V and countering the back-EMF takes 0.0405 × 439.8 = 17.8 V, 18.97 V in all (our arithmetic). Standing still and holding, ω = 0, and it needs only 0.573 × 1.77 = 1.01 V.

反电动势是电机的天花板：电源电压是有限的，转得越快，顶反电动势用掉的电压越多，剩下来推电流的就越少，力矩也就越小。电机"转得越快，力矩越小"，根子在这里。Back-EMF is the motor’s ceiling: the supply voltage is limited, and the faster the motor turns, the more of it goes to countering the back-EMF, the less is left to push current, and so the smaller the torque. This is the root of "the faster a motor turns, the less torque it gives".

电流稳定以后（dI/dt = 0），把上面两个式子合起来，转速和力矩之间就是一条直线：Once the current is steady (dI/dt = 0), put the two equations above together, and speed and torque lie on a straight line:

ω = V / ke − R τ / kt2ω0 = V / ke,  τs = kt V / R

转速等于"电压除以反电动势常数"，减去"电阻乘以力矩、再除以力矩常数的平方"。不带负载时转速最高，是空载转速；转速降到 0 时力矩最大，是堵转力矩。The speed equals "the voltage divided by the back-EMF constant" minus "the resistance times the torque, divided by the square of the torque constant". With no load the speed is highest: this is the no-load speed; when the speed falls to 0 the torque is largest: this is the stall torque.

由 τ = ktI 得 I = τ/kt，代入 V = RI + keω，解出 ω。力矩每多 1 N·m，转速就少 R/kt2，这个斜率规格书上叫"转速/力矩梯度"。直线的两端：τ = 0 时 ω = V/ke；ω = 0 时 I = V/R，τ = ktV/R。电压升高，整条线平行地往上移；电阻变大（比如线圈热了），线变陡。From τ = ktI we get I = τ/kt; substitute it into V = RI + keω and solve for ω. Each extra 1 N·m of torque costs R/kt2 of speed; datasheets call this slope the "speed/torque gradient". The two ends of the line: at τ = 0, ω = V/ke; at ω = 0, I = V/R and τ = ktV/R. Raise the voltage and the whole line shifts up, parallel to itself; increase the resistance (when the coil heats up, say) and the line gets steeper.

ω0
空载转速（rad/s）the no-load speed (rad/s)
τs
堵转力矩（N·m）：轴被卡住时出的力矩the stall torque (N·m): the torque produced when the shaft is blocked
R/kt2
转速/力矩梯度：负载每多 1 N·m，转速掉多少（rad/s 每 N·m）the speed/torque gradient: how much the speed drops for each extra 1 N·m of load (rad/s per N·m)

24 V 时：ω0 = 24/ke = 593 rad/s，也就是 24 × 236 = 5664 rpm；规格书写 5600 rpm。电机自己的摩擦（空载电流 0.27 A × 40.4 = 10.9 mN·m）让它少转约 37 rpm，模型给的是 5627 rpm，剩下的二十几转规格书没有解释；堵转电流 24/0.573 = 41.9 A，堵转力矩 0.0404 × 41.9 = 1.69 N·m；梯度 0.573/0.0404² = 351 rad/s 每 N·m，就是规格书上的 3.35 rpm/mN·m（都是我们按规格书验算的）。At 24 V: ω0 = 24/ke = 593 rad/s, that is 24 × 236 = 5664 rpm; the datasheet says 5600 rpm. The motor’s own friction (no-load current 0.27 A × 40.4 = 10.9 mN·m) takes about 37 rpm off, so the model gives 5627 rpm; the datasheet does not explain the remaining twenty-odd rpm. The stall current is 24/0.573 = 41.9 A, and the stall torque 0.0404 × 41.9 = 1.69 N·m; the gradient is 0.573/0.0404² = 351 rad/s per N·m, which is the datasheet’s 3.35 rpm/mN·m (all our arithmetic, checked against the datasheet).

直线上每一点电机都"做得到"，但不是每一点都"受得了"。堵转时 41.9 A 流过 0.573 Ω，每秒产生 1006 J 的热（我们算的），这台 150 g 的电机撑不了几秒。能长期待在哪一段，由发热决定，是第 ② 步的事。The motor "can do" every point on the line, but it cannot "take" every point. At stall, 41.9 A flows through 0.573 Ω and makes 1006 J of heat every second (our arithmetic); this 150 g motor would not last more than a few seconds. Which stretch of the line it can stay on for long is decided by heating, and that is step ②.

机械功率是力矩乘转速，τω。它在直线的两端都是 0（空载时没有力矩，堵转时不转），在堵转力矩的一半处最大：24 V 时约 248 W（我们算的），远远超过这台电机标的 70 W，因为那一点的电流有 21 A，发热受不了。效率是机械功率除以电功率，电功率里扣掉线圈电阻上的热（铜损，I2R）和摩擦，才是机械功率。按上面的模型，24 V 时效率最高 84.5%，出现在 0.125 N·m 附近（我们算的），规格书写 85%。效率最高的点在轻载一侧，因为铜损随电流的平方涨。Mechanical power is torque times speed, τω. It is 0 at both ends of the line (at no load there is no torque, at stall nothing turns) and largest at half the stall torque: about 248 W at 24 V (our arithmetic), far more than the 70 W this motor is labelled with, because the current at that point is 21 A, more heat than it can take. Efficiency is mechanical power divided by electrical power: take the heat in the coil’s resistance (copper loss, I2R) and the friction out of the electrical power, and what remains is the mechanical power. With the model above, the best efficiency at 24 V is 84.5%, near 0.125 N·m (our arithmetic); the datasheet says 85%. The best-efficiency point sits on the light-load side, because copper loss grows with the square of the current.

最后说"无刷"。上面的线圈要一直转，电流方向就得跟着转子的角度不停地换：老式的有刷电机靠转子上的铜片和电刷换向；无刷电机反过来，把磁铁放在转子上，线圈装在不动的定子上，分成三相（这台 EC 45 flat 是"外转子"：带磁铁的那一圈在外面转，线圈在里面不动，maxon 产品目录），由驱动器按转子的角度轮流给各相通电，这叫电子换相。驱动器得知道转子转到哪了：最简单的是三个霍尔传感器，每转过一对磁极给出 6 种状态，这台电机有 8 对磁极，转一圈是 48 个状态；要更细，就用编码器（第 ⑨ 步）。现在的驱动器多用"磁场定向控制"（FOC）：按转子的角度算出三相电流该是多少，让电流产生的磁场总是和磁铁的磁场垂直，这样所有的电流都用来出力矩。对上面的公式来说，结论不变：力矩正比于电流。Finally, "brushless". For the coil above to keep turning, the direction of the current has to keep switching with the rotor’s angle: old-style brushed motors do this with copper segments on the rotor and brushes. A brushless motor turns this around: the magnets go on the rotor, and the coils sit on the stationary stator, split into three phases (this EC 45 flat is an "outer rotor" motor: the ring carrying the magnets turns on the outside, while the coils stay still inside, maxon product range); the drive powers the phases in turn according to the rotor’s angle, and this is called electronic commutation. The drive has to know where the rotor is: the simplest way is three Hall sensors, which give 6 states for each pole pair the rotor passes; this motor has 8 pole pairs, so one turn is 48 states. For finer steps, you use an encoder (step ⑨). Most drives today use "field-oriented control" (FOC): from the rotor’s angle they work out what the three phase currents should be, so that the magnetic field of the currents is always perpendicular to the magnets’ field, and all of the current goes into making torque. For the formulas above the conclusion is the same: torque is proportional to current.

  • 左上的小图是从端面看的一个线圈，夹在 N、S 两块磁铁之间：线圈两边标着电流的方向（⊗ 流进去，⊙ 流出来，每转半圈换一次），箭头是导线受的力 F = BIℓ，两个力合起来是让线圈转的力矩（为了看得清，转速放慢了 50 倍）。旁边两根竖条按比例画：空心的是加上去的电压 V，实心的是转动产生的反电动势 e，线圈转得越快它越高；两者之差（蓝色那一截）就是压在电阻上的 RI，电流就是它除以 R。The small picture at top left is one coil seen end-on, between an N magnet and an S magnet: the two sides of the coil show the direction of the current (⊗ flowing in, ⊙ flowing out, swapping every half turn), the arrows are the forces on the wire, F = BIℓ, and together the two forces make the torque that turns the coil (slowed down 50 times so you can follow it). Beside it, two vertical bars are drawn to scale: the hollow one is the applied voltage V, and the solid one is the back-EMF e produced by turning, which grows the faster the coil turns; the difference between them (the blue segment) is the RI across the resistance, and the current is that divided by R.
  • 主图横轴是轴上的力矩（0–0.90 N·m，右边断开一截，再画出 1.69 N·m 的堵转力矩，注着"不含饱和"），纵轴是转速（0–7000 rpm）。粗线是当前电压下的力矩–转速线，淡的是 12、18、24、29.2 V 的线。三条竖线：额定力矩 0.134 N·m（热的限制）、驱动器的 5 A（0.202 N·m）和 15 A（0.606 N·m，只能撑 3 s），把图分成"可以一直跑""短时（会热）""驱动器给不了"三块。圆点是工作点。In the main chart, the horizontal axis is the shaft torque (0–0.90 N·m, then a break on the right before the stall torque of 1.69 N·m is drawn in, labelled "no saturation"), and the vertical axis is speed (0–7000 rpm). The dot is the operating point.
  • 滑块电压 V（0–29.2 V，默认 24.0 V）、轴上的力矩 τ（0–0.90 N·m，默认 0.0716 N·m）；开关功率和效率（图下面多一条：机械功率、铜损和效率随力矩怎么变）、绕组热了（电阻 × 1.39）；预设空转、升降柱在抬、额定点、最大功率、第一版要的力矩；重来。读数：转速、电流、机械功率、铜损、摩擦、输入功率、效率、反电动势。默认这一点是 5388 rpm、2.04 A、40.4 W、效率 82.4%（交互里算的）。Sliders Voltage V (0–29.2 V, default 24.0 V) and Shaft torque τ (0–0.90 N·m, default 0.0716 N·m); toggles Power and efficiency (adds a strip below the chart showing how mechanical power, copper loss and efficiency vary with torque) and Hot winding (resistance × 1.39); presets No load, Lift raising, Nominal, Max power and Design 1’s torque; Restart. Readouts: speed, current, mechanical power, copper loss, friction, input power, efficiency and back-EMF. The default point is 5388 rpm, 2.04 A, 40.4 W and 82.4% efficiency (computed in the interactive).

先玩：把轴上的力矩从 0 慢慢拉大，转速怎么掉，电流怎么涨？再把电压降到 18 V：线往哪儿挪了？按升降柱在抬：要 4200 rpm，驱动器得给多少伏？按最大功率：机械功率有 248 W，这台标着 70 W 的电机为什么不能在这里跑？Try first: Slowly drag Shaft torque up from 0: how does the speed fall, and how does the current rise? Then lower Voltage to 18 V: which way did the line move? Choose Lift raising: to reach 4200 rpm, how many volts must the drive give? Choose Max power: the mechanical power is 248 W, so why can’t this motor, labelled 70 W, run here?

这一步的要点：电机出的力矩正比于电流，τ = ktI；它转起来又像发电机，产生一个正比于转速、顶着电源的反电动势，而且 ke = kt。两件事合起来，转速和力矩之间就是一条直线：电压决定这条线的高低，电阻决定它的斜率。线上的每一点电机都做得到，能不能长期待着，看下一步的热。The point of this step: A motor’s torque is proportional to its current, τ = ktI; and when it turns, it also acts like a generator, producing a back-EMF that is proportional to speed and pushes against the supply, with ke = kt. Put the two together and speed and torque lie on a straight line: the voltage sets how high the line sits, and the resistance sets its slope. The motor can reach every point on the line; whether it can stay there for long depends on heat, the next step.

第 ② 步 · 连续力矩和峰值力矩Step ② · Continuous torque and peak torque

限制力矩的是热Heat is what limits torque

同一台电机，规格书上写着堵转力矩 1690 mN·m，额定力矩（最大连续力矩）只有 134 mN·m，差了 12.6 倍。第 ① 步说过，力矩只和电流有关，电机"做得到"1.69 N·m；做不到的是一直这样做。电流流过线圈的电阻，会变成热，这叫铜损，它和电流的平方成正比：额定电流 3.29 A 时是 3.29² × 0.573 = 6.20 W，堵转电流 41.9 A 时是 1006 W（我们算的）。线圈外面裹着绝缘漆，这台电机的绕组最高只许到 125 °C（规格书），再热绝缘就会损坏、短路。热要从绕组传到外壳，再从外壳散到空气里，每一段都有阻力：For the same motor, the datasheet gives a stall torque of 1690 mN·m but a nominal torque (max. continuous torque) of only 134 mN·m: a factor of 12.6 apart. As step ① said, torque depends only on current, and the motor "can do" 1.69 N·m; what it cannot do is keep doing it. Current flowing through the coil’s resistance turns into heat; this is called copper loss, and it is proportional to the square of the current: 3.29² × 0.573 = 6.20 W at the nominal current of 3.29 A, and 1006 W at the stall current of 41.9 A (our arithmetic). The coil is coated in insulating varnish, and this motor’s winding may reach 125 °C at most (datasheet); any hotter and the insulation is damaged and shorts out. The heat has to travel from the winding to the housing, and from the housing out into the air, and each stage resists it:

ΔTw = P (Rth1 + Rth2)P = I2 R(Tw),  R(T) = R25 [1 + α (T − 25)]

绕组比环境高出的温度，等于发热功率乘以两段热阻之和（稳定以后）。发热功率是电流的平方乘以电阻，而电阻本身随温度升高而变大。The winding’s rise above ambient equals the heating power times the sum of the two thermal resistances (once things have settled). The heating power is the square of the current times the resistance, and the resistance itself grows as the temperature rises.

热阻和电阻是一个道理：电阻是"每安培电流要多少伏的压差"，热阻是"每瓦热流要多少度的温差"。热从绕组到外壳要过 Rth1，从外壳到空气要过 Rth2，串起来相加。铜的电阻每升高 1 °C 约大 0.39%（maxon 的说明里举的例子：升高 50 °C，电阻大"将近 20%"），所以越热越发热；磁铁也会随温度变弱，kt 跟着变小（maxon 说，75 °C 时视材料不同弱 1% 到 10%，maxon 电机数据说明）。Thermal resistance works just like electrical resistance: electrical resistance is "how many volts of difference each ampere of current needs", thermal resistance is "how many degrees of difference each watt of heat flow needs". From the winding to the housing, the heat has to cross Rth1; from the housing to the air, Rth2; in series, the two add. Copper’s resistance rises by about 0.39% for every 1 °C (the example in maxon’s notes: a 50 °C rise makes the resistance "nearly 20%" larger), so the hotter it gets, the more heat it makes; the magnets also weaken as they warm up, and kt falls with them (maxon says by 1% to 10% at 75 °C, depending on the material, maxon’s notes on motor data).

ΔTw
绕组温度比环境高多少（K）how far the winding temperature is above ambient (K)
P
发热功率（W）；这里只算铜损，实际还有铁损和摩擦the heating power (W); only copper loss is counted here, though in reality there are also iron loss and friction
Rth1, Rth2
热阻：绕组到外壳，外壳到空气（K/W）；这台是 6.64 和 2.55 K/Wthe thermal resistances: winding to housing, and housing to air (K/W); 6.64 and 2.55 K/W for this motor
R25, α
25 °C 时的电阻（0.573 Ω）；铜的电阻温度系数，约 0.0039 每 Kthe resistance at 25 °C (0.573 Ω); copper’s temperature coefficient of resistance, about 0.0039 per K
T, Tw
温度（°C），R(T) 是温度为 T 时的电阻；绕组温度（°C）a temperature (°C), with R(T) the resistance at temperature T; the winding temperature (°C)

两段热阻加起来 9.19 K/W。环境 25 °C、绕组最高 125 °C，能散掉的热只有 100/9.19 = 10.88 W。绕组到 125 °C 时电阻是 0.573 × 1.39 = 0.796 Ω，只算铜损，能一直通的电流是 √(10.88/0.796) = 3.70 A；规格书给的是 3.29 A，剩下的那点余量留给了转动时的铁损和摩擦（都是我们算的）。按只算铜损的模型：一直通 1.77 A（第二版托住滑台），绕组最后停在 42.6 °C；一直通 3.29 A，停在 98.3 °C。The two thermal resistances add up to 9.19 K/W. With a 25 °C ambient and the winding allowed 125 °C at most, the heat that can be shed is only 100/9.19 = 10.88 W. At 125 °C the winding’s resistance is 0.573 × 1.39 = 0.796 Ω, so counting copper loss only, the current it can carry continuously is √(10.88/0.796) = 3.70 A; the datasheet gives 3.29 A, and the small margin left over goes to the iron loss and friction while it turns (all our arithmetic). In the copper-loss-only model: with 1.77 A flowing continuously (design 2 holding up the carriage), the winding ends up at 42.6 °C; with 3.29 A continuously, at 98.3 °C.

规格书说得很清楚：额定电流就是在 25 °C 的环境里、按这两个热阻、让绕组刚好到最高温度的那个电流，它是一个"热的极限"（maxon 目录页的注释）。环境更热，能用的就更少：45 °C 时温差只剩 80 K，连续电流大约按 √(80/100) 缩到 2.94 A（粗算）。电机装在密闭的柱子里、贴着发热的驱动器，都等于环境变热了。The datasheet puts it plainly: the nominal current is the current that, in a 25 °C ambient and with these two thermal resistances, brings the winding exactly to its maximum temperature. It is a "thermal limit" (notes on the maxon catalogue page). In a hotter environment you get less: at 45 °C only 80 K of temperature difference is left, and the continuous current shrinks by roughly √(80/100), to 2.94 A (rough estimate). Mounting the motor inside a closed column, or right up against a drive that gives off heat, amounts to a hotter environment.

那峰值力矩又是怎么回事？热不是一下子升上去的。绕组有自己的热容，像一个要慢慢灌满的水桶，它的热时间常数是 43.1 s，整台电机是 127 s（规格书）。短时间里通一个大电流，绕组来不及热到 125 °C，就可以；规格书的说法是"电机可以短时过载（可以反复）"。maxon 的说明里讲，小电机能过载几秒，最大的电机大约一分钟（maxon 电机数据说明）。So what about the peak torque? Heat does not build up all at once. The winding has its own heat capacity, like a bucket that takes time to fill: its thermal time constant is 43.1 s, and the whole motor’s is 127 s (datasheet). A large current for a short time is fine, as long as the winding has no time to reach 125 °C; in the datasheet’s words, "the motor may be briefly overloaded (recurring)". maxon’s notes say small motors can be overloaded for a few seconds, and the largest motors for about a minute (maxon’s notes on motor data).

第一版的升降柱要把滑台抬起来，得通 11.2 A；停在顶上不让它往下滑，摩擦会帮一点忙，最少也要 8.0 A（第 ⑥ 步）。按两节热容的模型，一直通 11.2 A，绕组从 25 °C 到 125 °C 只要 8.3 s（我们算的）。而且这么大的电流下，温度越高电阻越大、发热越多，根本没有稳定的温度：只算铜损，电流超过 6.98 A 就会这样一路热下去（我们算的）。所以电流大的时候，能撑多久比能出多大更要紧，常用一段工作循环的均方根电流来衡量：To raise the carriage, design 1 of the lift needs 11.2 A; to keep it from sliding down at the top, friction helps a little, but it still needs at least 8.0 A (step ⑥). In a model with two heat capacities, at a constant 11.2 A the winding goes from 25 °C to 125 °C in only 8.3 s (our arithmetic). What is more, at a current this large, the hotter the winding gets, the higher its resistance and the more heat it makes, so there is no steady temperature at all: counting copper loss only, any current above 6.98 A goes into thermal runaway like this (our arithmetic). So at large currents, how long the motor can keep it up matters more than how much it can give, and the usual measure is the RMS current over a duty cycle:

Irms = √( Σk Ik2 tk / Σk tk )

一个循环里分成几段，每段的电流平方乘以这段的时间，加起来，除以总时间，再开方。Split one cycle into stretches; for each, multiply the square of its current by its duration; add these up, divide by the total time, and take the square root.

发热和电流的平方成正比，所以要按平方去平均：一个循环里的总发热，和一直通 Irms 的发热一样多。只要循环比绕组的热时间常数短，温度就围着"一直通 Irms"的那个温度小幅起伏；Irms 不超过额定电流，就不会过热。Heating is proportional to the square of the current, so the average has to be taken over the squares: the total heat in one cycle is the same as with Irms flowing the whole time. As long as the cycle is shorter than the winding’s thermal time constant, the temperature wobbles a little around the one that "Irms all the time" would give; as long as Irms does not exceed the nominal current, the motor does not overheat.

Ik, tk
第 k 段的电流（A）和时长（s）the current (A) and duration (s) of stretch k
Irms
均方根电流（A），要和额定电流比the RMS current (A), to compare with the nominal current

第二版的一个循环（示意）：加速 0.2 s，3.23 A；以 0.10 m/s 抬 4.0 s，2.04 A；减速 0.2 s；在顶上托 30 s，按 1.77 A 算（偏保守，见第 ⑥ 步）；放下来 4.2 s；停 20 s，0 A。一共 58.6 s，均方根 1.41 A，不到额定的一半；一直这样循环一小时，绕组在 34–38 °C 之间起伏（我们算的）。这个循环比绕组的热时间常数 43.1 s 还长，温度会跟着每一段走，好在每一段的电流都不超过额定电流。One cycle of design 2 (illustrative): accelerate for 0.2 s at 3.23 A; raise at 0.10 m/s for 4.0 s at 2.04 A; slow down for 0.2 s; hold at the top for 30 s, counted at 1.77 A (conservative, see step ⑥); lower for 4.2 s; idle for 20 s at 0 A. That is 58.6 s in all, with an RMS of 1.41 A, less than half the nominal current; cycling like this for an hour, the winding swings within 34–38 °C (our arithmetic). This cycle is longer than the winding’s thermal time constant of 43.1 s, so the temperature follows each stretch; fortunately, no stretch’s current exceeds the nominal current.

峰值不只受热的限制。驱动器给的电流也有上限：升降柱用的 EPOS4 Compact 50/5 只能连续给 5 A，最多给 15 A、最长 3 s（EPOS4 的产品页），15 A 只够 0.606 N·m，是堵转力矩的 36%。电流再大，磁路会饱和，力矩就涨得比电流慢，不再成正比，规格书的堵转力矩是不算饱和的理论值（目录页的注释）。Peaks are not limited by heat alone. The current the drive can give has an upper limit too: the lift’s EPOS4 Compact 50/5 can give only 5 A continuously, and at most 15 A for at most 3 s (EPOS4 product page); 15 A is only enough for 0.606 N·m, 36% of the stall torque. At larger currents still, the magnetic circuit saturates and the torque rises more slowly than the current, no longer in proportion; the datasheet’s stall torque is a theoretical value that leaves saturation out (notes on the catalogue page).

现在可以把第一版的故事讲完了。驱动器给超过连续 5 A 的电流是有时限的：产品页只写了最大 15 A、最长 3 s，电流小一些能撑多久没写（一般是电流越小撑得越久）。第一版抬的 4 s 里一直要 11 A 左右，到顶以后又撑了 3 s（故事里的设定，示意），驱动器就只能给它的连续电流 5 A，电机只剩 0.202 N·m；可滚珠丝杠被 255.1 N 的重量推着，要往回转，加在电机轴上的力矩是 0.325 N·m（要 8.0 A 才顶得住，第 ⑥ 步），电机顶不住，滑台就滑了下去。即使驱动器不限流，一直通 8–11 A，电机也会在十几秒内过热。还有一层：驱动器的 5 A 本身就比电机的额定 3.29 A 大，一直通 5 A，绕组 69 s 就到 125 °C（我们算的）。所以驱动器里要填上电机自己的额定电流和绕组的热时间常数：maxon 的驱动器拿这两个数估算绕组的温度，估到上限，就把电流限到电机的额定电流（maxon 支持页）。只看驱动器自己的 5 A，是保护不了电机的。Now we can finish the story of design 1. Above its continuous 5 A, the drive can supply current only for a limited time: the product page gives only the maximum, 15 A for at most 3 s, and does not say how long a somewhat smaller current can be kept up (usually, the smaller the current, the longer). Design 1 needed about 11 A throughout the 4 s raise, and held on for another 3 s at the top (part of the story, illustrative); after that the drive could give only its continuous current of 5 A, leaving the motor just 0.202 N·m. But the ball screw, pushed by the 255.1 N weight, wants to turn backwards, putting 0.325 N·m on the motor shaft (it takes 8.0 A to hold that, step ⑥); the motor could not hold it, and the carriage slid down. Even if the drive did not limit the current, a constant 8–11 A would overheat the motor within a dozen or so seconds. There is one more catch: the drive’s 5 A is itself more than the motor’s nominal 3.29 A, and with 5 A flowing continuously the winding reaches 125 °C in 69 s (our arithmetic). So you must enter the motor’s own nominal current and the winding’s thermal time constant into the drive: maxon drives use these two numbers to estimate the winding temperature, and when the estimate reaches the limit, they cut the current back to the motor’s nominal current (maxon support article). Going only by the drive’s own 5 A will not protect the motor.

  • 上面是热的路线：绕组 → Rth1 6.64 K/W → 外壳 → Rth2 2.55 K/W → 空气，箭头粗细是热流有多少瓦，格子里是实时的温度。下面是随时间变化的曲线：上面一条细的是电流（虚线是额定的 3.29 A 和驱动器的 5 A），主图是绕组温度（超过 125 °C 变红，到 300 °C 打一个 ✕，"烧了，不画了"）、外壳温度和空气，虚线是 125 °C。时间轴可以选 0–120 s、0–20 min、0–1 h；▶ 播放、跳到最后，速度 4×、60×、360×。At the top is the heat path: winding → Rth1 6.64 K/W → housing → Rth2 2.55 K/W → air; the arrows’ thickness shows how many watts of heat flow, and the boxes show the live temperatures. Below are the curves over time: the thin one on top is the current (the dashed lines are the nominal 3.29 A and the drive’s 5 A); the main plot shows the winding temperature (red above 125 °C, with an ✕ at 300 °C: "burnt, we stop here"), the housing temperature and the air; the dashed line is 125 °C. Time axis offers 0–120 s, 0–20 min and 0–1 h; ▶ Play, Jump to end, Speed 4×, 60×, 360×.
  • 预设：第二版一直举着（1.77 A，默认）、额定电流（3.29 A）、只算铜损的极限（3.70 A）、第一版硬扛（11.17 A，8.3 s 到 125 °C，再往上就是"烧了"）、驱动器限流以后（先 11.17 A 撑 3 s，再 5 A：54.6 s 后还是到 125 °C）、工作循环（第二版的循环，均方根 1.41 A）、自定义（滑块电流 I，0–15 A）。滑块环境温度（25–45 °C）。读数：电流、发热、绕组温度、外壳温度、到 125 °C 还要多久、稳态温度、均方根电流，以及驱动器 15 A 的 3 s 计时。模型只算铜损，每 10 ms 算一步。Presets: Design 2 holding (1.77 A, default), Nominal current (3.29 A), Copper-only limit (3.70 A), Design 1 forced (11.17 A: 125 °C in 8.3 s, and further up, "burnt"), After the drive limits (11.17 A for 3 s, then 5 A: 125 °C all the same, after 54.6 s), Duty cycle (design 2’s cycle, RMS 1.41 A) and Custom (slider Current I, 0–15 A). Slider Ambient (25–45 °C). Readouts: current, heat, winding temperature, housing temperature, time left to 125 °C, steady-state temperature, RMS current, and the 3 s timer for the drive’s 15 A. The model counts copper loss only, in steps of 10 ms.

先玩：先看第二版一直举着：温度最后停在哪？再按第一版硬扛：几秒到 125 °C？按驱动器限流以后：电流降到 5 A，为什么温度还是不停地往上走？最后把环境温度拉到 45 °C，再看额定电流：只算铜损就已经到 124 °C，再加上模型里没算的铁损和摩擦（25 °C 时就是它们吃掉了 3.70 A 和 3.29 A 之间的余量）呢？Try first: Start with Design 2 holding: where does the temperature end up? Then choose Design 1 forced: how many seconds to 125 °C? Choose After the drive limits: the current drops to 5 A, so why does the temperature keep climbing? Finally, drag Ambient up to 45 °C and choose Nominal current: copper loss alone already takes the winding to 124 °C; what about once you add the iron loss and friction the model leaves out (at 25 °C, they are what eats up the margin between 3.70 A and 3.29 A)?

这一步的要点：电机能出多大的力矩由电流决定，能长期出多大的力矩由热决定：铜损和电流的平方成正比，热要穿过绕组到外壳、外壳到空气两段热阻散出去。额定力矩就是在 25 °C 环境里绕组刚好到最高温度时的力矩；峰值能用，是因为绕组要几十秒才热起来，还要看驱动器给不给得出那么大的电流、给多久。选电机看均方根，不看堵转。The point of this step: How much torque a motor can give is set by its current; how much it can give for long is set by heat. Copper loss is proportional to the square of the current, and the heat has to escape through two thermal resistances, winding to housing and housing to air. The nominal torque is the torque at which the winding just reaches its maximum temperature in a 25 °C ambient. Peaks are usable because the winding takes tens of seconds to heat up, but they also depend on whether the drive can supply that much current, and for how long. Choose a motor by its RMS current, not its stall torque.

第 ③ 步 · 电压从哪来，电流怎么调Step ③ · Where the voltage comes from, how the current is controlled

电从电池来，经过驱动器Power comes from the battery, through the drive

电机要的电流，最后都来自底盘里的电池。电池由一节节电芯组成：串联，电压相加；并联，容量相加。这台机器人用 8 节磷酸铁锂（LiFePO4，常写作 LFP）电芯串联，每节是 EVE 的 LF80：标称 3.2 V、80 Ah，充满 3.65 V，放到 2.5 V 就必须停（电芯规格书）。串起来是标称 25.6 V，刚充满时 29.2 V（这是充电的截止电压；放一会儿，每节回到 3.4 V 左右，整包约 27 V，估），放空 20.0 V；能量是 25.6 V × 80 Ah = 2048 Wh，8 节电芯一共 13.0 kg（我们算的；电池的设计是示意的）。The current the motors need all comes, in the end, from the battery in the base. A battery is built from individual cells: in series, their voltages add; in parallel, their capacities add. This robot uses 8 lithium iron phosphate cells (LiFePO4, often written LFP) in series, each an EVE LF80: nominal 3.2 V and 80 Ah, 3.65 V when full, and discharging must stop at 2.5 V (cell datasheet). In series that makes 25.6 V nominal, 29.2 V straight after a full charge (this is the charge cut-off voltage; after resting a while, each cell settles back to about 3.4 V and the whole pack to about 27 V, est.) and 20.0 V when empty; the energy is 25.6 V × 80 Ah = 2048 Wh, and the 8 cells weigh 13.0 kg in all (our arithmetic; the battery design is illustrative).

电池不是一个理想的电压源。它里面有电阻：电芯本身、连接片、保险丝、电池管理板（BMS）里的开关管、电缆，加起来这里按 30 mΩ 算（示意；单看电芯，规格书写每节的交流内阻不超过 0.5 mΩ，8 节是 4 mΩ）。电流越大，电池两端的电压掉得越多：A battery is not an ideal voltage source. It has resistance inside: the cells themselves, the connecting strips, the fuse, the switching transistors in the battery management system (BMS) and the cables; added up, we take them here as 30 mΩ (illustrative; for the cells alone, the datasheet gives an AC internal resistance of no more than 0.5 mΩ per cell, so 4 mΩ for 8). The larger the current, the more the voltage at the battery terminals drops:

Vbus = Voc(SoC) − Ibat RintE = Vnom × C,  t ≈ E / P̄

母线电压等于电池的开路电压（它随剩余电量变）减去电流乘以内阻。电池的能量是标称电压乘以容量，能用多久大约是能量除以平均功率。The bus voltage is the battery’s open-circuit voltage (which changes with the remaining charge) minus the current times the internal resistance. The battery’s energy is its nominal voltage times its capacity, and how long it lasts is roughly the energy divided by the average power.

开路电压是电池不出电流时两端的电压，由电芯的化学决定，随电量慢慢变。一出电流，内阻上就有 Ibat·Rint 的压降，外面看到的电压就少这么多；电流一停，电压又回来。磷酸铁锂有一个特点：电量从九成到两三成之间，开路电压几乎是平的，所以光看电压很难猜还剩多少电，BMS 一般靠数进出的电量（库仑计）来估。The open-circuit voltage is the voltage across the battery when it delivers no current; it is set by the cell chemistry and changes slowly with the charge. As soon as current flows, there is a drop of Ibat·Rint across the internal resistance, and the voltage seen from outside sags by that much; when the current stops, the voltage comes back. LiFePO4 has one peculiarity: between 90% and 20–30% charge, the open-circuit voltage is almost flat, so the voltage alone hardly tells you how much charge is left; a BMS usually estimates it by counting the charge going in and out (coulomb counting).

Vbus
母线电压：电池接到驱动器、电脑上的那对直流线上的电压（V）Bus voltage: the voltage on the pair of DC lines that connect the battery to the drives and computers (V)
Voc(SoC)
开路电压，随荷电状态 SoC（还剩百分之几的电）变化（V）Open-circuit voltage, which changes with the state of charge SoC (what percentage of the charge is left) (V)
Ibat, Rint
电池出的总电流（A）；电池和线路的内阻（Ω）Total current drawn from the battery (A); internal resistance of the battery and wiring (Ω)
E, Vnom, C
能量（Wh）、标称电压（V）、容量（Ah）Energy (Wh), nominal voltage (V), capacity (Ah)
P̄, t
平均功率（W）；大约能用多久（h）Average power (W); roughly how long it lasts (h)

这台机器人平时的耗电（示意，除了注明的）：Jetson AGX Thor 40–130 W（按 100 W 算，NVIDIA 模组规格书）、实时小电脑 35 W、FR3 的控制柜约 80 W（规格书；它要 100–240 V 交流电，所以中间还要一个逆变器，按 90% 的效率算是 88.9 W）、传感器和交换机 15 W、轮子平均 10 W、升降柱平均 2 W，一共 251 W，电流 9.8 A，2048 Wh 能用 8.2 h；Thor 开到 130 W 时是 7.3 h（我们算的）。轮子和升降柱的电机只占平均功耗的 5% 左右（FR3 的 80 W 里也有它自己关节的电机，规格书没有分开写），大头是电脑。底盘全力加速时（两个轮子电机各 10.2 A，已经跑到 0.3 m/s），从电池多抽约 13.6 A，电压掉 13.6 × 0.030 = 0.41 V（我们算的）。刚起步时电机转得慢，驱动器的占空比小，电机电流再大，从电池抽的电流也不多。This robot’s everyday power draw (illustrative, except where noted): Jetson AGX Thor 40–130 W (taken as 100 W, NVIDIA module datasheet), the small real-time computer 35 W, the FR3 controller about 80 W (datasheet; it needs 100–240 V AC, so there is also an inverter in between, which at 90% efficiency makes it 88.9 W), sensors and network switch 15 W, wheels 10 W on average, lift 2 W on average: 251 W in total, a current of 9.8 A, so the 2048 Wh lasts 8.2 h; with the Thor at 130 W it is 7.3 h (our arithmetic). The wheel and lift motors are only about 5% of the average consumption (the FR3’s 80 W also includes its own joint motors, which the datasheet does not list separately); the bulk goes to the computers. When the base accelerates at full power (the two wheel motors at 10.2 A each, already moving at 0.3 m/s), it draws about 13.6 A more from the battery, and the voltage sags by 13.6 × 0.030 = 0.41 V (our arithmetic). Just after setting off, the motors turn slowly and the drives’ duty cycle is small, so however large the motor current, the current drawn from the battery is small.

"电池还有电"和"电池给得出这么大的电流"是两回事。规格书上有两个电流：LF80 最大充电电流 1C（80 A）、最大放电电流 3C（240 A），C 是"容量对应的电流"。冷的时候、快没电的时候内阻更大，同样的电流掉得更多。电压掉到驱动器或者逆变器的欠压保护线以下，它们就会停机，看上去就像机器人"突然没电了"。"The battery still has charge" and "the battery can deliver this much current" are two different things. The datasheet gives two currents: the LF80’s maximum charge current is 1C (80 A) and its maximum discharge current 3C (240 A), where C stands for "the current corresponding to the capacity". When it is cold, or nearly empty, the internal resistance is higher, and the same current makes the voltage drop further. If the voltage drops below the undervoltage threshold of a drive or of the inverter, it shuts down, and it looks as if the robot "suddenly ran out of power".

电池给的是直流，电压一直是二十几伏；电机要的是可控的电流。中间的驱动器做这件事。它的功率部分是几个功率管（MOSFET），三对，接成三个"半桥"，每一相线圈接在一个半桥的中点上，可以接到母线的正极，也可以接到负极。功率管只当开关用，要么全通，要么全断（这样它自己几乎不发热），一秒钟开关几万次；接通的时间占的比例叫占空比，平均下来，加在线圈上的就是占空比乘以母线电压。这就是 PWM（脉宽调制）：The battery supplies direct current, always at twenty-odd volts; the motor needs a current that can be controlled. The drive in between does this. Its power stage is several power transistors (MOSFETs), three pairs of them, wired as three "half bridges"; each phase coil is connected to the midpoint of one half bridge, which can connect it either to the positive side of the bus or to the negative side. The power transistors are used only as switches, either fully on or fully off (that way they hardly heat up themselves), switching tens of thousands of times a second; the fraction of the time they are on is called the duty cycle, and on average the voltage across the coil is the duty cycle times the bus voltage. This is PWM (pulse-width modulation):

V̄ = D · VbusR I + ke ω ≤ V̄max ≈ 0.9 Vbus

平均电压等于占空比乘以母线电压。电机要的电压（推电流的电阻压降加上反电动势）不能超过驱动器能给的最大平均电压，这台驱动器大约是母线电压的九成。The average voltage is the duty cycle times the bus voltage. The voltage the motor needs (the resistive drop that drives the current, plus the back-EMF) cannot exceed the highest average voltage the drive can give, which for this drive is about 90% of the bus voltage.

线圈有电感，电流变不快：开关每 20 µs 通断一次，电流只在平均值附近小幅起伏，所以电机"看到"的就是平均电压。驱动器里最快的控制环是电流环：每一拍量一次电流，和指令比，差了就调占空比。只要电压够用，电流就能跟上指令，电机就成了一个"要多少力矩给多少"的力矩源；电压不够了，电流跟不上，力矩就掉下来，这就是第 ① 步那条力矩–转速线的顶。The coil has inductance, so the current cannot change quickly: the switches go on and off once every 20 µs, and the current only ripples a little around its average, so what the motor "sees" is the average voltage. The fastest control loop in the drive is the current loop: every cycle it measures the current, compares it with the command, and adjusts the duty cycle if they differ. As long as there is enough voltage, the current keeps up with the command, and the motor becomes a torque source that "gives as much torque as you ask for"; when the voltage runs short, the current cannot keep up and the torque falls off: this is the ceiling drawn by the torque–speed line in step ①.

V̄, D
加在电机上的平均电压（V）；占空比（0–1）Average voltage applied to the motor (V); duty cycle (0–1)
V̄max
驱动器能给的最大平均电压；EPOS4 写的是"0.9 × Vcc"（EPOS4 产品页）The highest average voltage the drive can give; the EPOS4 gives it as "0.9 × Vcc" (EPOS4 product page)
R I + ke ω
电机要的电压：电阻上的压降加反电动势（第 ① 步），这里的 I 是电机电流The voltage the motor needs: the drop across the resistance plus the back-EMF (step ①); I here is the motor current

EPOS4 Compact 50/5 的开关频率是 50 kHz（每 20 µs 一次），电流环 25 kHz（每 40 µs 算一次）（产品页）。第二版以 0.10 m/s 抬滑台，电机要 4200 rpm、18.97 V（第 ① 步）。电池在标称的 25.6 V 时，驱动器最多给 23.04 V，绰绰有余；电池快放空、母线 20.0 V 时，最多 18.0 V，这时托着 0.0716 N·m 只能转到 3972 rpm，滑台最快 0.0946 m/s，比要的慢了 5%（我们算的）。电池没坏，只是电压不够了。The EPOS4 Compact 50/5 has a switching frequency of 50 kHz (once every 20 µs) and a current loop at 25 kHz (one update every 40 µs) (product page). Design 2 raises the carriage at 0.10 m/s, which needs 4200 rpm and 18.97 V at the motor (step ①). With the battery at its nominal 25.6 V, the drive can give at most 23.04 V, plenty; with the battery nearly empty and the bus at 20.0 V, at most 18.0 V, and then, holding up 0.0716 N·m, the motor can only reach 3972 rpm and the carriage at most 0.0946 m/s, 5% slower than required (our arithmetic). Nothing is wrong with the battery; there just is not enough voltage.

电压决定能转多快，电流决定能出多大力，两个上限是分开的。电池快没电时机器人"变慢"，常常就是电压上限压下来了，而不是力矩不够。Voltage sets how fast it can turn, current sets how hard it can push, and the two limits are separate. When a robot "slows down" as its battery runs low, it is often the voltage limit coming down, not a lack of torque.

能量也会倒着流。滑台往下放的时候，是重力在拖着丝杠和电机转，电机成了发电机，驱动器把这份功率送回母线：以 0.10 m/s 放 26 kg，大约有 13 W 回来（我们算的）；底盘刹车时，轮子的电机也一样。这叫回馈。能量本身不多：把 26 kg 举高 0.40 m 是 102 J，把 100 kg 的机器人从 0.3 m/s 刹住是 4.5 J（我们算的），电池收得下。麻烦在回来的电没处去的时候。电池充满了、或者太冷，BMS 会切断充电的那一路；只要母线上的电脑、传感器还在用电（这台约 240 W），回来的 13 W 马上就被它们用掉，电压不会涨。要是回来的功率比母线上别的东西用的还多（大机器急刹、重物快放），多出来的电流就只能给母线上的电容充电，几十毫秒里电压就能冲过驱动器的过压线（EPOS4 是 58 V，第 ⑪ 步），驱动器报过压、停机（示意的情形）。常见的办法是在母线上加一个制动电阻：电压一高，就把多出来的能量烧成热。Energy can also flow backwards. When the carriage is lowered, it is gravity that drags the screw and the motor round; the motor becomes a generator, and the drive sends this power back to the bus: lowering 26 kg at 0.10 m/s returns about 13 W (our arithmetic); the wheel motors do the same when the base brakes. This is called regeneration. The energy itself is small: lifting 26 kg by 0.40 m is 102 J, and stopping the 100 kg robot from 0.3 m/s is 4.5 J (our arithmetic), which the battery can absorb. The trouble comes when the returning power has nowhere to go. If the battery is full, or too cold, the BMS cuts off the charging path; but as long as the computers and sensors on the bus are still drawing power (about 240 W on this robot), they use up the returning 13 W at once, and the voltage does not rise. If more power comes back than everything else on the bus uses (a big machine braking hard, a heavy load lowered fast), the surplus current can only charge the capacitors on the bus, and within tens of milliseconds the voltage can shoot past the drive’s overvoltage threshold (58 V for the EPOS4, step ⑪); the drive raises an overvoltage fault and shuts down (an illustrative scenario). The usual fix is a braking resistor on the bus: as soon as the voltage gets high, it burns the surplus energy off as heat.

  • 左上是磷酸铁锂电芯的开路电压随电量的曲线（形状是示意的；右边的刻度乘了 8，是整个电池），中间那段很平。圆点是当前的电量。右上是 10 s 里的母线：第 2 s 底盘在 0.3 m/s 时全力加速，多抽约 14 A（持续时间是示意的），第 5 s 升降柱开始抬；下面画着电流，上面画着母线电压，两条横线是 BMS 的下限 20.0 V 和驱动器额定范围的下限 10 V。Top left is the open-circuit voltage of a LiFePO4 cell against state of charge (the shape is illustrative; the right-hand scale is multiplied by 8, for the whole battery); the middle part is very flat. The dot is the present state of charge. Top right is the bus over 10 s: at 2 s the base, at 0.3 m/s, accelerates at full power and draws about 14 A more (the duration is illustrative), and at 5 s the lift starts to rise; the current is plotted at the bottom and the bus voltage at the top, and the two horizontal lines are the BMS’s lower limit of 20.0 V and the bottom of the drive’s rated range, 10 V.
  • 左下是升降柱电机的电压上限：按当前母线电压画出的力矩–转速线，和抬滑台需要的那一点（0.0716 N·m、4200 rpm）。右下是耗电的分账，一条横着的堆叠条，合计多少瓦、能用几小时。Bottom left is the lift motor’s voltage limit: the torque–speed line drawn for the present bus voltage, and the point needed to raise the carriage (0.0716 N·m, 4200 rpm). Bottom right is the power budget, a horizontal stacked bar, with the total in watts and how many hours it lasts.
  • 滑块电量 SoC（0–100%，默认 80%）、内阻 Rint（10–100 mΩ，默认 30 mΩ）、Thor 功率（40–130 W，默认 100 W）。开关放下来（能量往回流）；开了它才能接着开电池满了，再开别的负载都关了，最后是制动电阻；重来。读数：开路电压、最低母线电压（看回馈时换成最高母线电压）、压降、满电能用多久、现在还能用多久、升降柱最快多快。Sliders: State of charge (0–100%, default 80%), Resistance Rint (10–100 mΩ, default 30 mΩ), Thor power (40–130 W, default 100 W). Toggles: Lowering (energy flows back); only with it on can you go on to switch on Battery full, then Other loads off, and last Braking resistor; and Restart. Readouts: open-circuit voltage, lowest bus voltage (highest bus voltage when you watch regeneration), sag, runtime from full, runtime left now, lift top speed.

先玩：把电量从 80% 拉到 30%：开路电压变了多少？再拉到 5%：这时升降柱最快还能多快？把内阻拉到 100 mΩ，看底盘全力加速那一下电压掉多少。最后依次打开放下来、电池满了：母线电压涨了吗？再打开别的负载都关了：几十毫秒里发生了什么？最后打开制动电阻。Try first: Drag State of charge from 80% to 30%: how much did the open-circuit voltage change? Then down to 5%: how fast can the lift go now? Drag Resistance up to 100 mΩ and see how far the voltage drops when the base accelerates at full power. Next, switch on Lowering and then Battery full: did the bus voltage rise? Now switch on Other loads off: what happens within tens of milliseconds? Finally, switch on Braking resistor.

这一步的要点：电池给的是一个会往下掉的电压和一份会用完的能量：电流大、天冷、电快没了，电压都掉得多；磷酸铁锂的电压很平，看电压猜不出剩多少电。驱动器用 PWM 把母线电压"切"成平均电压，用电流环让电流跟上指令；电压决定能转多快，电流决定能出多大力。往回流的能量要有地方去，不然母线会过压。The point of this step: A battery gives a voltage that sags and an energy that runs out: a large current, the cold and a nearly empty battery all make the voltage drop further; LiFePO4’s voltage is very flat, so you cannot tell from the voltage how much charge is left. The drive uses PWM to "chop" the bus voltage into an average voltage, and its current loop makes the current follow the command; voltage sets how fast it can turn, current sets how hard it can push. Energy flowing back needs somewhere to go, or the bus goes into overvoltage.

第 ④ 步 · 力矩乘 N，惯量乘 N²Step ④ · Torque times N, inertia times N²

减速比Gear ratio

电机天生"转得快、劲儿小"：EC 45 flat 空载 5600 rpm，额定力矩只有 0.134 N·m。负载正好相反：升降柱的丝杠只要 1200 rpm，却要 0.2255 N·m；轮子在 0.3 m/s 时每分钟只转 36 转，要的力矩却是好几 N·m。中间要一个东西把转速换成力矩，这就是减速器。输入转 N 圈、输出转 1 圈，N 叫减速比。功率不能凭空变多，转速降成 1/N，力矩就放大 N 倍（再打一个效率的折扣）：Motors are by nature "fast but weak": the EC 45 flat runs at 5600 rpm with no load, and its nominal torque is only 0.134 N·m. Loads are just the opposite: the lift’s screw needs only 1200 rpm but 0.2255 N·m; at 0.3 m/s the wheels turn only 36 times a minute, yet need several N·m of torque. Something in between has to turn speed into torque, and that is the reducer. If the input makes N turns while the output makes 1, N is called the gear ratio. Power cannot grow out of nothing, so when the speed drops to 1/N, the torque is multiplied by N (then discounted by the efficiency):

ωout = ωm / N,  τout = η N τm

输出的转速是电机转速除以减速比；输出的力矩是电机力矩乘以减速比，再乘以效率。The output speed is the motor speed divided by the gear ratio; the output torque is the motor torque times the gear ratio, times the efficiency.

理想的减速器不吃功率：输入功率 τmωm 等于输出功率 τoutωout，转速少了 N 倍，力矩就多 N 倍。齿和齿之间、轴承里都有摩擦，有一部分功率变成热，所以要乘一个小于 1 的效率 η。An ideal reducer consumes no power: the input power τmωm equals the output power τoutωout, so if the speed is N times lower, the torque is N times higher. There is friction between the teeth and in the bearings, and part of the power turns into heat, so we multiply by an efficiency η less than 1.

N
减速比：输入转 N 圈，输出转 1 圈Gear ratio: the input makes N turns while the output makes 1
ωm, τm
电机的角速度和力矩Angular velocity and torque of the motor
ωout, τout
减速器输出端的角速度和力矩Angular velocity and torque at the reducer’s output
η
效率：输出功率占输入功率的比例Efficiency: output power as a fraction of input power

底盘的每个轮子：EC 45 flat 配一个 74 比 1 的三级行星减速器 GP 42 C，效率 72%（maxon 产品页）。电机的额定 0.134 N·m 到了轮子上是 0.134 × 74 × 0.72 = 7.14 N·m。电池在标称 25.6 V 时，驱动器最多给电机 23.04 V（第 ③ 步）；只拖着滚动阻力跑，电机约 5360 rpm，到轮子是 72.5 rpm，轮子半径 0.08 m，底盘最快约 0.61 m/s（我们算的）。Each wheel of the base: an EC 45 flat with a 74:1 three-stage planetary gearhead, the GP 42 C, efficiency 72% (maxon product page). The motor’s nominal 0.134 N·m becomes 0.134 × 74 × 0.72 = 7.14 N·m at the wheel. With the battery at its nominal 25.6 V, the drive can give the motor at most 23.04 V (step ③); pulling only the rolling resistance, the motor runs at about 5360 rpm, which is 72.5 rpm at the wheel; with a wheel radius of 0.08 m, the base’s top speed is about 0.61 m/s (our arithmetic).

链上每一段都有自己的上限，最弱的那一段说了算。这个减速器能长期承受 15 N·m，电机只给得出 7.14 N·m，长期的限制在电机；可它短时只许 22 N·m，而驱动器 15 A 的峰值电流到了轮子上是 32.3 N·m，所以驱动器的电流上限要按减速器来设，不能超过 10.2 A（我们算的，第 ⑬ 步）。Every link in the chain has its own limit, and the weakest link decides. This gearhead can take 15 N·m continuously, while the motor can only give 7.14 N·m, so in the long run the limit is the motor; but for short periods the gearhead allows only 22 N·m, and the drive’s 15 A peak current becomes 32.3 N·m at the wheel, so the drive’s current limit has to be set by the gearhead, at no more than 10.2 A (our arithmetic, step ⑬).

减速器放大力矩，人人都知道；它同时放大的另一样东西，常常被忘掉：电机转子的惯量。站在输出端看，要让输出加速，电机就得以 N 倍的角加速度去转它自己的转子；电机为此花的力矩，到了输出端又被乘了一次 N。两次相乘，转子在输出端看起来就像大了 N² 倍：Everyone knows that a reducer multiplies torque; the other thing it multiplies at the same time is often forgotten: the inertia of the motor’s rotor. Seen from the output, to accelerate the output the motor has to spin its own rotor with N times the angular acceleration; and the torque the motor spends on that is multiplied by N once more on its way to the output. Multiply twice, and from the output the rotor looks N² times bigger:

Jref = N2 Jmk = 2πN / L,  mref = Jm k2

转子折算到输出端的惯量，是转子惯量乘以减速比的平方。如果输出是直线运动（丝杠），每移动 1 m 电机要转 k 弧度，转子折算成的质量就是转子惯量乘以 k 的平方。The rotor inertia reflected to the output is the rotor inertia times the gear ratio squared. If the output moves in a straight line (a screw) and the motor has to turn k radians for each 1 m of travel, the rotor’s reflected mass is the rotor inertia times k squared.

看动能最直接：转子转得比输出快 N 倍，它的动能 ½Jmωm2 = ½(N2Jm)ωout2，站在输出端看，就像多了一个 N2Jm 的惯量。丝杠转一圈（2π 弧度），滑台走一个导程 L，再乘上减速器的 N，滑台每走 1 m，电机要转 2πN/L 弧度，同样的道理，转子相当于一个 Jmk2 的质量。加速它要力，撞上东西时它也会把动能带过去。Kinetic energy shows it most directly: the rotor turns N times faster than the output, so its kinetic energy is ½Jmωm2 = ½(N2Jm)ωout2; seen from the output, it is as if an extra inertia of N2Jm were there. One turn of the screw (2π radians) moves the carriage by one lead L; multiply by the reducer’s N, and for each 1 m the carriage travels, the motor has to turn 2πN/L radians; by the same reasoning, the rotor acts like a mass of Jmk2. Accelerating it takes force, and when the output hits something, it carries its kinetic energy into the hit as well.

Jm
电机转子的惯量（kg·m²）；EC 45 flat 是 181 g·cm² = 1.81 × 10−5 kg·m²（规格书）Inertia of the motor’s rotor (kg·m²); for the EC 45 flat it is 181 g·cm² = 1.81 × 10−5 kg·m² (datasheet)
Jref
折算到输出端的转子惯量（kg·m²）Rotor inertia reflected to the output (kg·m²)
L, k
丝杠的导程（m）；滑台每走 1 m，电机要转的弧度（rad/m）Lead of the screw (m); the radians the motor has to turn for each 1 m of carriage travel (rad/m)
mref
折算成直线运动的等效质量（kg）Equivalent mass, reflected to the straight-line motion (kg)

轮子（74 比 1）：1.81 × 10−5 × 74² = 0.0991 kg·m²，两个轮子的转子折算到轮缘（半径 0.08 m）是 31.0 kg：推着 100 kg 的机器人加速，感觉像在推 131 kg。升降柱第二版：k = 2π × 3.5/0.005 = 4398 rad/m，转子相当于 350 kg，滑台加手臂才 26 kg；丝杠自己（直径 16 mm、长 0.5 m 的钢杆）还相当于 39.9 kg。第一版没有减速器、导程 10 mm：k = 628 rad/m，转子只相当于 7.1 kg（都是我们算的）。Wheels (74:1): 1.81 × 10−5 × 74² = 0.0991 kg·m²; the rotors of the two wheels, reflected to the rim (radius 0.08 m), come to 31.0 kg: accelerating the 100 kg robot feels like pushing 131 kg. Lift, design 2: k = 2π × 3.5/0.005 = 4398 rad/m, so the rotor acts like 350 kg, while the carriage plus arm is only 26 kg; the screw itself (a steel rod 16 mm in diameter and 0.5 m long) adds the equivalent of another 39.9 kg. Design 1 had no reducer and a 10 mm lead: k = 628 rad/m, and the rotor acted like only 7.1 kg (all our arithmetic).

一个 150 g 的电机，在升降柱上"重"350 kg。这不是错觉：第二版要以 0.5 m/s² 加速，光是转动转子就要 0.0398 N·m，是托住滑台所需的 0.0716 N·m 的一半多；加速时电机总共要出 0.1196 N·m，再加上电机自己的摩擦，电流 3.23 A（我们算的）。减速比越大，电机越容易"托住"负载，却越难"甩动"它自己。A 150 g motor "weighs" 350 kg on the lift. This is no illusion: for design 2 to accelerate at 0.5 m/s², just spinning up the rotor takes 0.0398 N·m, more than half of the 0.0716 N·m needed to hold up the carriage; while accelerating, the motor has to give 0.1196 N·m in all, and adding the motor’s own friction, the current is 3.23 A (our arithmetic). The larger the gear ratio, the more easily the motor can "hold up" the load, but the harder it is for it to "swing" itself.

那减速比该取多大？只看加速，有一个最好的值：让折算过来的转子惯量正好等于负载的惯量，N* = √(Jload/Jm)，这时同样的电机力矩给出的负载加速度最大，叫惯量匹配。比它小，力矩不够；比它大，力气都花在甩转子上了。升降柱上要甩动的是滑台加手臂 26 kg，再加上丝杠自己（相当于 39.9 kg），一共相当于 65.9 kg；让 Jmk² 等于它，k* = √(65.9 / (1.81 × 10−5)) = 1908 rad/m，导程 5 mm 时 N 只要 1.52；第二版的 3.5 比 1 是它的 2.3 倍（我们算的）。第二版并没选错：滑台大部分时间是托着不动或者慢慢走，要省的是托住时的电流和发热，不是加速度。选减速比，就是在这几件事之间取舍：So how large should the gear ratio be? Looking only at acceleration, there is a best value: the one where the reflected rotor inertia exactly equals the load inertia, N* = √(Jload/Jm); there the same motor torque gives the load the greatest acceleration. This is called inertia matching. Below it, the torque falls short; above it, the effort all goes into swinging the rotor. On the lift, what has to be swung is the carriage plus arm, 26 kg, plus the screw itself (equivalent to 39.9 kg), 65.9 kg equivalent in all; setting Jmk² equal to that gives k* = √(65.9 / (1.81 × 10−5)) = 1908 rad/m, so with a 5 mm lead N need only be 1.52; design 2’s 3.5:1 is 2.3 times that (our arithmetic). Design 2 was not the wrong choice: the carriage spends most of its time held still or moving slowly, and what needs saving is the current and heat while holding, not acceleration. Choosing a gear ratio means trading off between these things:

  • 减速比大：力矩大，托住负载只要很小的电流、很少的发热；电机侧的编码器换算到输出端分辨率更细（第 ⑨ 步）。Large gear ratio: high torque, so holding the load takes very little current and makes very little heat; a motor-side encoder, converted to the output, gives finer resolution (step ⑨).
  • 减速比大的代价：输出转得慢；转子折算过来的惯量按 N² 涨，加速费力，撞上东西时冲击大；摩擦也被放大 N 倍（还要再除以反向效率），从输出端推起来越来越费劲，大到一定程度就推不动了（第 ⑧ 步）；用电流估力矩越来越不准（第 ⑩ 步）。The price of a large gear ratio: the output turns slowly; the reflected rotor inertia grows as N², so accelerating is hard work and impacts are harsh when it hits something; friction is magnified N times too (and then divided by the backdrive efficiency), so pushing from the output gets harder and harder, and beyond a certain point it cannot be pushed at all (step ⑧); and estimating torque from current gets less and less accurate (step ⑩).
  • 减速比小（四足机器人常用 6 比 1 上下，第 ⑯ 步）：输出端"透明"，推得动、撞得起，电流就是力矩；代价是要一台力矩很大的电机，托住重物时发热多。Small gear ratio (quadruped robots often use around 6:1, step ⑯): the output is "transparent", can be pushed and can take a hit, and current is torque; the price is a motor with a lot of torque, which makes plenty of heat when holding up something heavy.
  • 先选是哪一根轴：升降柱（默认）、轮子、关节（示意）（同一台电机，减速比 30 以下配行星、30 以上配谐波，谐波效率按 76% 算，把一个 0.4 kg·m² 的小臂从垂着转到水平）。滑块减速比 N 是对数刻度，也可以在曲线上左右拖；升降柱按 5 mm 导程算，N 小于 1 表示不用减速器、把导程加大到 5/N mm（第一版的 10 mm 就是 N = 0.5），旁边同时显示 k（rad/m）。行星减速器的级数、效率和力矩上限跟着 N 变（每级最多 6 比 1）。First choose the axis: Lift (default), Wheel or Joint (illustrative) (the same motor, with a planetary gearhead for ratios below 30 and a strain wave gear above 30, the strain wave gear taken at 76% efficiency, turning a 0.4 kg·m² forearm from hanging down to horizontal). The Gear ratio N slider has a log scale, and you can also drag sideways on the curves; the lift assumes a 5 mm lead, and N below 1 means no gearhead and a lead increased to 5/N mm instead (design 1’s 10 mm is N = 0.5); k (rad/m) is shown alongside. The number of planetary stages, their efficiency and the torque limit change with N (at most 6:1 per stage).
  • 上图是这根轴在做那段动作（按▶ 走一遍），旁边几根条是输出端感到的惯量：负载、丝杠、折算过来的转子。下图横轴是减速比，上半是走完一段动作要多久（升降柱抬 0.40 m，轮子走 1 m，关节转 90°）：实线按驱动器的 15 A 和电机能拿到的 23.04 V（母线 25.6 V 的 0.9 倍）算；虚线不管最高速度、只看 15 A，它在 N* 附近最短。下半是托住负载要多少电流（轮子在平地上不用托，换成以 0.5 m/s² 加速要多少电流），横线是 3.29 A、5 A 和 15 A。竖线标着惯量匹配的 N*、当前的 N 和最快的 N。预设第一版、第二版、惯量匹配、准直驱 6:1。读数：输出最大力（或力矩）、输出最高速度、折算质量（或惯量）、托住要多少电流、走完要多久。The top panel shows the axis making its move (press ▶ Run the move); the bars beside it are the inertia felt at the output: load, screw and reflected rotor. In the bottom panel the horizontal axis is the gear ratio; the upper half shows how long the move takes (the lift rising 0.40 m, the wheel travelling 1 m, the joint turning 90°): the solid line assumes the drive’s 15 A and the 23.04 V the motor can get (0.9 times the 25.6 V bus); the dashed line ignores the top speed and counts only the 15 A, and it is shortest near N*. The lower half shows the current needed to hold up the load (on a flat floor the wheel has nothing to hold up, so it shows the current for accelerating at 0.5 m/s² instead), with horizontal lines at 3.29 A, 5 A and 15 A. Vertical lines mark the inertia-matched N*, the present N and the fastest N. Presets Design 1, Design 2, Inertia-matched, Quasi-direct 6:1. Readouts: max output force (or torque), max output speed, reflected mass (or inertia), holding current, time for the move.

先玩：在升降柱上把减速比从 0.5 拉到 20：折算过来的转子什么时候比负载还重？走完 0.40 m 的时间在哪里最短，为什么第二版不选那一点？换到轮子，看两个转子让机器人"重"了多少；再换到关节，按准直驱 6:1。Try first: With Lift selected, drag the gear ratio from 0.5 to 20: when does the reflected rotor become heavier than the load? Where is the time for the 0.40 m move shortest, and why did design 2 not choose that point? Switch to Wheel and see how much "heavier" the two rotors make the robot; then switch to Joint and press Quasi-direct 6:1.

这一步的要点：减速器把力矩放大 N 倍、转速缩小 N 倍，同时把转子的惯量放大 N² 倍；丝杠也是一种减速，转子折算成的质量是 Jmk²。减速比大，托得住、发热少、分辨率细；减速比小，转得快、推得动、撞得起。选它是在加速度、发热、速度和"透明"之间取舍，不是越大越好。The point of this step: A reducer multiplies torque by N and divides speed by N, and at the same time multiplies the rotor’s inertia by N²; a screw is a kind of reduction too, and the rotor’s reflected mass is Jmk². A large gear ratio holds well, heats little and resolves finely; a small one turns fast, can be pushed and can take a hit. Choosing it is a trade-off between acceleration, heat, speed and "transparency", not a case of the bigger the better.

第 ⑤ 步 · 行星、谐波、摆线Step ⑤ · Planetary, strain wave, cycloidal

三种减速器Three kinds of reducer

两个普通齿轮咬在一起，齿数比就是减速比；可一对齿轮做到 10 比 1 已经很别扭了，小齿轮太小、大齿轮太大。机器人里常见的是三种更紧凑的办法。When two ordinary gears mesh, the ratio of their tooth counts is the gear ratio; but a single pair at 10 to 1 is already awkward, with the small gear too small and the large one too large. Robots commonly use three more compact approaches.

行星减速器。中间一个小齿轮叫太阳轮，外面一圈内齿的大齿圈，中间夹着三个行星轮，行星轮装在一个行星架上。把齿圈固定住，电机带太阳轮，行星轮就一边自转、一边沿着齿圈公转，行星架跟着慢慢转，输出就从行星架上拿：Planetary gearhead. A small gear in the middle is called the sun gear; around the outside is a large ring gear with internal teeth; between them sit three planet gears, mounted on a carrier. Hold the ring gear still and let the motor drive the sun gear: the planets spin on their own axes while travelling round the ring gear, the carrier slowly turns with them, and the output is taken from the carrier:

i = 1 + Zr / ZsN = i1 i2 ⋯,  η = η1 η2 ⋯

齿圈固定、太阳轮输入、行星架输出时，一级的减速比是 1 加上齿圈齿数除以太阳轮齿数。几级串起来，减速比相乘，效率也相乘。With the ring gear fixed, the sun gear as input and the carrier as output, the ratio of one stage is 1 plus the ring gear’s tooth count divided by the sun gear’s. Put several stages in series and the ratios multiply, and so do the efficiencies.

站在行星架上看，行星架不动，太阳轮和齿圈通过行星轮反着转，转速之比是 −Zr/Zs：(ωs − ωc)/(ωr − ωc) = −Zr/Zs。回到地面上，齿圈不动（ωr = 0），解出 ωs/ωc = 1 + Zr/Zs。三个行星轮同时传力，一级就能做到 3 到 10 比 1 左右，还很紧凑。Stand on the carrier: from there the carrier is still, and the sun gear and the ring gear turn in opposite directions through the planets, with speeds in the ratio −Zr/Zs: (ωs − ωc)/(ωr − ωc) = −Zr/Zs. Back on the ground, the ring gear does not move (ωr = 0), and solving gives ωs/ωc = 1 + Zr/Zs. Three planets carry the load at once, so one stage can reach a ratio of between about 3 and 10 to 1 and still be compact.

Zs, Zr
太阳轮、齿圈的齿数（齿圈 = 太阳轮 + 2 × 行星轮）Tooth counts of the sun gear and the ring gear (ring = sun + 2 × planet)
ωs, ωc, ωr
太阳轮、行星架、齿圈的角速度Angular velocities of the sun gear, the carrier and the ring gear
i, i1, i2
一级的减速比；第 1、2 级的减速比Ratio of one stage; ratios of stages 1 and 2
N, η, η1, η2
几级串起来的总减速比和总效率；每一级的效率Overall ratio and overall efficiency of several stages in series; efficiency of each stage

太阳轮 12 齿、齿圈 30 齿（示意，maxon 不公布齿数）：1 + 30/12 = 3.5，和升降柱那一级的减速比一样。轮子的 74 比 1 是三级：3.5 × 3.5 × 6 = 73.5，产品页上写着精确值 147/2（maxon 产品页）。GP 42 C 一级、两级、三级、四级的效率是 90%、81%、72%、64%，正好约等于 0.9 的一、二、三、四次方；平均回差（空载）0.6°、0.8°、1.0°、1.0°；能长期承受的输出力矩 3.0、7.5、15、15 N·m（GP 42 C 规格书）。Sun gear 12 teeth, ring gear 30 teeth (illustrative; maxon does not publish tooth counts): 1 + 30/12 = 3.5, the same ratio as the lift’s single stage. The wheels’ 74 to 1 is three stages: 3.5 × 3.5 × 6 = 73.5, and the product page gives the exact value 147/2 (maxon product page). For the GP 42 C with one, two, three and four stages, the efficiencies are 90%, 81%, 72% and 64%, almost exactly 0.9 to the first, second, third and fourth power; the average backlash (no load) is 0.6°, 0.8°, 1.0° and 1.0°; and the output torque it can take continuously is 3.0, 7.5, 15 and 15 N·m (GP 42 C datasheet).

行星减速器便宜、效率高、能反驱（第 ⑧ 步），缺点是齿和齿之间留着间隙，换向时输出要晚一点才动（第 ⑦ 步）。轮子、升降柱、四足机器人的腿，常用它。Planetary gearheads are cheap, efficient and backdrivable (step ⑧). Their drawback is the clearance left between the teeth: when the direction reverses, the output starts moving a little late (step ⑦). Wheels, lift columns and the legs of quadruped robots often use them.

谐波减速器（也叫应变波齿轮，Harmonic Drive 是最早做它的公司）只有三个零件，原理却很奇特。外面一个刚性的内齿圈叫刚轮，固定不动；里面一个薄壁的、能被撑变形的外齿杯子叫柔轮，接输出；柔轮里面塞一个椭圆形的凸轮加一个薄轴承，叫波发生器，接电机。椭圆把柔轮撑成椭圆，长轴两端的齿和刚轮咬住，短轴两端完全脱开。柔轮通常比刚轮少 2 个齿（Harmonic Drive 的说明）。波发生器转一圈，咬合的位置绕一圈，柔轮相对刚轮就往反方向挪 2 个齿：A strain wave gear (also called a harmonic drive; Harmonic Drive was the first company to make one) has only three parts, yet it works in an unusual way. On the outside is a rigid ring with internal teeth, the circular spline, which stays fixed. Inside it is a thin-walled cup with external teeth that can be pushed out of shape, the flexspline, connected to the output. Inside the flexspline sits an elliptical cam with a thin bearing, the wave generator, connected to the motor.
