The ellipse forces the flexspline into an ellipse: at the two ends of the major axis its teeth mesh with the circular spline, and at the two ends of the minor axis they are completely clear. The flexspline usually has 2 teeth fewer than the circular spline (Harmonic Drive). Each turn of the wave generator carries the mesh once round, and the flexspline shifts 2 teeth relative to the circular spline, in the opposite direction:

N = Zf / (Zc − Zf)

刚轮固定时，减速比等于柔轮的齿数，除以刚轮和柔轮的齿数差。With the circular spline fixed, the gear ratio equals the flexspline’s tooth count divided by the difference in tooth count between the circular spline and the flexspline.

咬合点绕一圈，柔轮上的每个齿都要和刚轮上"下一个空位"咬一次，可刚轮多 2 个齿，所以一圈下来柔轮落后 2 个齿，也就是转了 (Zc − Zf)/Zf 圈，方向和波发生器相反。齿数差只有 2，减速比就能一下子做到上百。As the mesh goes once round, each tooth of the flexspline has to mesh once with the "next gap" on the circular spline; but the circular spline has 2 more teeth, so after one round the flexspline has fallen 2 teeth behind. That is, it has turned (Zc − Zf)/Zf of a turn, in the opposite direction to the wave generator. With a difference of only 2 teeth, the ratio leaps straight to a hundred or more.

Zf, Zc
柔轮、刚轮的齿数，Zc = Zf + 2Tooth counts of the flexspline and the circular spline, Zc = Zf + 2

柔轮 200 齿、刚轮 202 齿：200/2 = 100 比 1；160/162 是 80 比 1（我们算的）。单级的减速比一般是 30 到 160 比 1，特制的做到过 400 比 1（Harmonic Drive）。Harmonic Drive 的 CSG-20-100：能反复承受的峰值力矩 107 N·m，瞬时峰值 191 N·m，"标准精度" 1′，自重 0.98 kg（CSG-2UH 产品页）。Flexspline 200 teeth, circular spline 202 teeth: 200/2 = 100 to 1; 160/162 gives 80 to 1 (our arithmetic). A single stage is usually between 30 and 160 to 1, and special versions have reached 400 to 1 (Harmonic Drive). Harmonic Drive’s CSG-20-100: repeated peak torque 107 N·m, momentary peak 191 N·m, "standard accuracy" 1′, mass 0.98 kg (CSG-2UH product page).

谐波减速器零回差、精度高（1′ 角分，在 0.8 m 外是 0.23 mm）、又轻又小，所以轻型机械臂的关节常用它，比如 DLR 的轻型机器人（Schuller 等，2024）。代价也来自那个会变形的柔轮：受力时会扭（第 ⑦ 步：CSD-20-80 在 51 N·m 下扭 9.1′），效率低一些（Harmonic Drive 产品资料里的一个算例是 76%，CSF-2UP 资料），还有周期性的传动误差，频率是输入转速的两倍（Schuller 等）。FR3 关节里用的是哪种减速器，Franka 没有公开。Strain wave gears have zero backlash and high accuracy (1′ of arc, which is 0.23 mm at 0.8 m away), and are light and small, so the joints of lightweight arms often use them, DLR’s lightweight robots for example (Schuller et al., 2024). The price also comes from that deformable flexspline: it twists under load (step ⑦: a CSD-20-80 twists 9.1′ at 51 N·m), it is less efficient (a worked example in Harmonic Drive’s product literature gives 76%, CSF-2UP brochure), and it has a periodic transmission error at twice the input rotation frequency (Schuller et al.). Franka has not disclosed which kind of reducer is inside the FR3’s joints.

摆线减速器（RV 减速器是它最有名的一种）。一个带圆弧凸起（"齿"）的圆盘，套在一个偏心轴上，在一圈圆柱销中间滚动；盘上的凸起比销子少一个。偏心轴转一圈，圆盘在销圈里"晃"一圈，同时反着转过一个凸起。和谐波一样，靠"差一点点"得到大减速比（谐波差 2 个齿，摆线差 1 个凸起），只是所有零件都是刚性的。RV 减速器先过一级普通齿轮，再进摆线这一级，偏心轴有好几根（Nabtesco 的说明）。它刚性好、抗冲击，Nabtesco 说它的滞后损失小于 1′，急停时能承受额定力矩的 5 倍，常用在工业机器人的大关节上。Cycloidal reducer (the RV reducer is the best-known type). A disc with rounded lobes (its "teeth") sits on an eccentric shaft and rolls inside a ring of cylindrical pins; the disc has one lobe fewer than there are pins. Each turn of the eccentric shaft makes the disc "wobble" once round the pin ring while turning backwards by one lobe. As with the strain wave gear, a large ratio comes from "a tiny difference" (2 teeth for the strain wave gear, 1 lobe for the cycloidal), except that every part here is rigid. An RV reducer first goes through a stage of ordinary gears and then into the cycloidal stage, and it has several eccentric shafts (Nabtesco). It is stiff and resists shock; Nabtesco says its hysteresis loss is under 1′ and that it can take 5 times its rated torque in an E-stop. It is common in the large joints of industrial robots.

  • 三个标签页：行星、谐波、摆线（RV），齿是真的在啮合。▶ 播放 / ■ 暂停、输入转 1 圈（正好停在 1.00 圈）、重来，滑块转速（慢放）；上面一排小表盘数着输入、输出各转了几圈。Three tabs: Planetary, Strain wave, Cycloidal (RV); the teeth really do mesh. ▶ Play / ■ Pause, Turn the input once (stops at exactly 1.00 turns), Restart, and the slider Speed (slowed); a row of small dials along the top counts the turns made by the input and the output.
  • 行星：滑块太阳轮齿数（10–30，默认 12）和齿圈齿数（默认 30；三个行星轮要等距地装得下，所以一跳就是 6 齿），行星轮跟着算；按输入转 1 圈，行星架转 1/3.5 = 0.286 圈。级数 1/2/3：减速比相乘，效率 90/81/72%，回差 0.6/0.8/1.0°。我们的机器人：升降柱的 3.5:1、轮子的 74:1（3.5 × 3.5 × 6 = 73.5，三级）。齿数是示意的，maxon 只公开了减速比。Planetary: sliders Sun teeth (10–30, default 12) and Ring teeth (default 30; the three planets must fit evenly spaced, so it moves in steps of 6 teeth), with the planets worked out from them; press Turn the input once and the carrier turns 1/3.5 = 0.286 of a turn. Stages 1/2/3: the ratios multiply; efficiency 90/81/72%, backlash 0.6/0.8/1.0°. Our robot: the lift’s 3.5:1 and the wheels’ 74:1 (3.5 × 3.5 × 6 = 73.5, three stages). The tooth counts are illustrative; maxon publishes only the ratios.
  • 谐波：为了看得清，柔轮画 60 齿、刚轮 62 齿（30 比 1；真的是 160/162、200/202 这样）。椭圆的波发生器在转，两个咬合区跟着转；柔轮上的记号每转一圈往回退 2 个齿。柔轮其实只变形一个齿高那么一点，主图上看不出来，下面一条放大的窄图按真实的比例画着咬合的地方。摆线：滑块凸瓣数（7–19，默认 11），11 个凸瓣的圆盘在 12 个销子里滚（11 比 1）。最下面一张表把三种放在一起比：减速比、回差、刚度、效率、用在哪，当前标签页的那一列亮着。Strain wave: to keep it visible, the flexspline is drawn with 60 teeth and the circular spline with 62 (30 to 1; real ones are more like 160/162 or 200/202). The elliptical wave generator turns, and the two mesh zones turn with it; the mark on the flexspline slips back 2 teeth per turn. In reality the flexspline deforms by only about one tooth height, too little to see in the main drawing, so a narrow magnified strip below draws the meshing region in true proportion. Cycloidal: slider Lobes (7–19, default 11); a disc with 11 lobes rolls inside 12 pins (11 to 1). A table at the very bottom compares all three: ratio, backlash, stiffness, efficiency, where it is used; the column for the current tab is highlighted.

先玩：在行星里把太阳轮调大，减速比变大还是变小？再把齿圈调大呢？换成 3 级，减速比、效率、回差各是多少？在谐波里按输入转 1 圈，盯住柔轮上的记号：它往哪边走、走几个齿？在摆线里数一数，偏心轴转几圈，圆盘才转一圈。Try first: In Planetary, make the sun gear bigger: does the ratio go up or down? And if you make the ring gear bigger? Switch to 3 stages: what are the ratio, efficiency and backlash? In Strain wave, press Turn the input once and watch the mark on the flexspline: which way does it move, and by how many teeth? In Cycloidal, count how many turns the eccentric shaft makes for the disc to turn once.

这一步的要点：行星减速器靠几个行星轮分担力，一级 3–10 比 1，效率高、能反驱，但有回差；谐波减速器靠柔轮比刚轮少 2 个齿，一级就能上百，零回差、精度高，但会扭、效率低一些；摆线（RV）减速器靠圆盘比销子少一个凸起，刚、抗冲击，用在工业机器人的大关节。后两种都是靠"差一两个齿"，一级就换来很大的减速比。The point of this step: A planetary gearhead shares the load among several planets, gives 3–10 to 1 per stage, and is efficient and backdrivable, but has backlash; a strain wave gear relies on the flexspline having 2 teeth fewer than the circular spline, reaches a hundred or more in one stage, and has zero backlash and high accuracy, but it twists and is somewhat less efficient; a cycloidal (RV) reducer relies on the disc having one lobe fewer than there are pins, is stiff and shock-resistant, and is used in the large joints of industrial robots. The last two both get a large ratio from a single stage by being "one or two teeth short".

第 ⑥ 步 · 把转动变成直线Step ⑥ · Turning rotation into a straight line

丝杠Screws

升降柱要的是直线运动。丝杠就是一根螺杆，上面套一个螺母，螺母不让它跟着转，丝杠一转，螺母就沿着它走。转一圈走的距离叫导程。把螺纹的一圈"剥"下来摊平，它就是一个斜坡：底边是螺纹一圈的周长 πd，高是导程 L，斜坡的倾角叫导程角 λ，tan λ = L/(πd)。转动丝杠，就是把螺母沿着这个斜坡往上推。The lift needs straight-line motion. A screw is simply a threaded rod with a nut on it; the nut is kept from turning with it, so when the screw turns, the nut travels along it. The distance travelled per turn is the lead. "Unroll" one turn of the thread and lay it flat, and it is a slope: its base is the circumference of one turn of the thread, πd, its height is the lead L, and its angle is the lead angle λ, tan λ = L/(πd). Turning the screw pushes the nut up this slope.

F = 2π η τ / L

螺母能推出的力，等于 2π 乘以效率、乘以丝杠上的力矩，再除以导程。The force the nut can push with equals 2π times the efficiency times the torque on the screw, divided by the lead.

还是功率守恒：丝杠以 ω 转，螺母以 v = Lω/2π 走；输入功率 τω 乘以效率等于输出功率 Fv，消掉 ω 就是这个式子。导程越小，同样的力矩推出的力越大，螺母走得也越慢，和减速器一样。Conservation of power again: the screw turns at ω and the nut travels at v = Lω/2π; the input power τω times the efficiency equals the output power Fv, and cancelling ω gives this formula. The smaller the lead, the more force the same torque pushes with, and the slower the nut travels, just as with a reducer.

F
螺母沿轴向推出的力（N）Axial force the nut pushes with (N)
τ
丝杠上的力矩（N·m）Torque on the screw (N·m)
L
导程（m）：丝杠转一圈螺母走多远Lead (m): how far the nut travels per turn of the screw
η
正向效率：把力矩变成推力时的效率Forward efficiency: the efficiency of turning torque into thrust

匀速抬起 255.1 N：第二版的丝杠导程 5 mm、效率 90%，丝杠上要 255.1 × 0.005 / (2π × 0.9) = 0.2255 N·m，再经过 3.5 比 1、效率 90% 的减速器，电机上是 0.0716 N·m。第一版导程 10 mm、直接连电机，电机上要 0.451 N·m（都是我们算的）。停着托住时，螺纹和齿轮的摩擦反过来帮着托，要的更少（下面会算：第二版最少 0.0418 N·m，第一版最少 0.325 N·m）；这一篇说"托住要 0.0716 N·m、1.77 A"，是按抬的力矩算的，偏保守。Raising 255.1 N at a steady speed: design 2’s screw has a 5 mm lead and 90% efficiency, so the screw needs 255.1 × 0.005 / (2π × 0.9) = 0.2255 N·m; through the 3.5 to 1 gearhead at 90% efficiency, that becomes 0.0716 N·m at the motor. Design 1 has a 10 mm lead and is coupled straight to the motor, so the motor needs 0.451 N·m (all our arithmetic). When standing still and holding, the friction in the thread and gears works the other way and helps hold, so less is needed (worked out below: at least 0.0418 N·m for design 2, at least 0.325 N·m for design 1); where this page says "holding takes 0.0716 N·m, 1.77 A", that is based on the lifting torque, which is conservative.

直线运动也可以看成一种"减速比"：滑台每走 1 m，电机要转 2πN/L 弧度（第 ④ 步）。所以第一版和第二版的差别，归根到底是这个数差了 7 倍：628 和 4398 rad/m。Linear motion can also be seen as a kind of "gear ratio": for every 1 m the carriage travels, the motor turns 2πN/L radians (step ④). So the difference between design 1 and design 2 comes down, in the end, to a factor of 7 in this number: 628 versus 4398 rad/m.

斜坡上有摩擦，所以效率小于 1。更要紧的是反过来：负载压在螺母上，会不会把丝杠推着倒转？这取决于斜坡有多陡、摩擦有多大。螺纹面上的摩擦系数 μ 对应一个摩擦角 φ，tan φ = μ：There is friction on the slope, so the efficiency is less than 1. What matters more is the other direction: with the load pressing on the nut, will it push the screw round backwards? That depends on how steep the slope is and how much friction there is. The friction coefficient μ on the thread faces corresponds to a friction angle φ, tan φ = μ:

η = tan λ / tan(λ + φ)η′ = tan(λ − φ) / tan λ,  λ ≤ φ ⇒ η′ ≤ 0

正向效率是导程角的正切除以"导程角加摩擦角"的正切；反向效率是"导程角减摩擦角"的正切除以导程角的正切。导程角不比摩擦角大时，反向效率小于等于零，负载推不动丝杠，这叫自锁。The forward efficiency is the tangent of the lead angle divided by the tangent of "lead angle plus friction angle"; the backdrive efficiency is the tangent of "lead angle minus friction angle" divided by the tangent of the lead angle. When the lead angle is no larger than the friction angle, the backdrive efficiency is zero or less and the load cannot drive the screw: this is called self-locking.

把螺母当成斜坡上的一个木块：往上推时，摩擦和重力一起挡着你，像是把斜坡变陡了 φ；松手以后，重力想让它往下滑，摩擦反过来挡着它，像是把斜坡变缓了 φ。斜坡本来就不比 φ 陡（λ ≤ φ），木块自己就滑不下来。也正因为这样，自锁的丝杠正向效率一定不到 50%：能自锁，就意味着推上去时有一大半力气花在了摩擦上。Think of the nut as a block on a slope. When you push it up, friction and gravity both hold you back, as if the slope were steeper by φ; once you let go, gravity wants it to slide down and friction now holds it back, as if the slope were gentler by φ. If the slope is no steeper than φ to begin with (λ ≤ φ), the block cannot slide down by itself. This is also why a self-locking screw’s forward efficiency is always below 50%: being able to self-lock means that more than half the effort of pushing up is spent on friction.

λ
导程角，tan λ = L/(πd)，d 是螺纹的中径Lead angle, tan λ = L/(πd), where d is the pitch diameter of the thread
φ, μ
摩擦角，tan φ = μ（方牙螺纹）；梯形螺纹的牙面斜 15°，要用 tan φ = μ/cos 15°；μ 是螺纹面之间的摩擦系数Friction angle, tan φ = μ (square thread); a trapezoidal thread’s flanks are inclined at 15°, so use tan φ = μ/cos 15°; μ is the friction coefficient between the thread faces
η, η′
正向效率（力矩 → 推力），反向效率（推力 → 力矩）；η′ ≤ 0 就是自锁Forward efficiency (torque → thrust), backdrive efficiency (thrust → torque); η′ ≤ 0 means self-locking

Roton 的数（滑动丝杠配青铜螺母，摩擦系数 0.15）：导程角 8° 时，正向 45%、反向 −13%（自锁）；20° 时正向 65%、反向 52%（不自锁）；直接套上面的公式、μ = 0.15，算出来是 47%/−7% 和 67%/56%（我们算的），和 Roton 的数差几个百分点。滚珠丝杠把螺纹面之间的滑动换成钢珠的滚动，摩擦很小，正向效率约 90%、反向约 80%，基本不随导程角变（Roton 的说明），所以它从不自锁。一根直径 16 mm 左右的梯形丝杠 Tr16×4（导程 4 mm，中径 14 mm）导程角 5.20°，按方牙、μ = 0.10 算，正向 47%、反向 −10%，自锁；算上 15° 的牙面，是 46% 和 −14%（我们算的，摩擦系数是示意的）。Roton’s figures (sliding screws with a bronze nut, friction coefficient 0.15): at a lead angle of 8°, forward 45% and backdrive −13% (self-locking); at 20°, forward 65% and backdrive 52% (not self-locking). Plugging μ = 0.15 straight into the formula above gives 47%/−7% and 67%/56% (our arithmetic), a few percentage points off Roton’s figures. A ball screw replaces the sliding between thread faces with rolling steel balls, so friction is very low: forward efficiency is about 90% and backdrive about 80%, almost independent of lead angle (Roton), so it is never self-locking. A trapezoidal lead screw about 16 mm in diameter, Tr16×4 (lead 4 mm, pitch diameter 14 mm), has a lead angle of 5.20°; taken as a square thread with μ = 0.10, it gives forward 47% and backdrive −10%, self-locking; allowing for the 15° flanks, 46% and −14% (our arithmetic; the friction coefficient is illustrative).

滚珠丝杠"效率高"和"会被负载推着倒转"是同一件事的两面：摩擦小，往哪个方向都容易转。竖着用的滚珠丝杠，断电以后一定要有东西托住，Roton 说得很直接：不自锁的丝杠，要靠制动力矩才能托住负载。A ball screw’s "high efficiency" and its "being driven backwards by the load" are two sides of the same coin: with little friction, it turns easily in either direction. A ball screw used vertically must have something to hold it up once the power is cut. Roton puts it bluntly: a screw that is not self-locking needs a braking torque to hold the load.

回到升降柱。断电以后，255.1 N 的重量通过滚珠丝杠拧电机：丝杠上是 255.1 × 0.005 × 0.8 / 2π = 0.1624 N·m，再倒着经过减速器（反向效率按 90% 算，示意），到电机轴上是 0.0418 N·m；电机自己的摩擦只有 0.0109 N·m，挡不住，滑台就会往下滑（我们算的）。第一版没有减速器、导程又大，电机轴上是 0.325 N·m，滑得更快。办法有三种：Back to the lift. Once the power is cut, the 255.1 N weight twists the motor through the ball screw: 255.1 × 0.005 × 0.8 / 2π = 0.1624 N·m at the screw, then backwards through the gearhead (backdrive efficiency taken as 90%, illustrative), giving 0.0418 N·m at the motor shaft. The motor’s own friction is only 0.0109 N·m, which cannot hold it, so the carriage slides down (our arithmetic). Design 1 has no gearhead and a larger lead: 0.325 N·m at the motor shaft, so it slides faster. There are three ways out:

  • 加制动器：断电时靠弹簧把电机轴抱住，通电才松开。算制动器别指望摩擦帮忙：按丝杠和减速器都没有摩擦算，电机轴上是 255.1 × 0.005 / (2π × 3.5) = 0.058 N·m，留一倍余量是 0.116 N·m；Miki Pulley 的 BXW 系列，最小的一款制动力矩 0.24 N·m（Miki Pulley 产品页），是 0.058 的 4.1 倍（我们算的）。这是第二版最后的做法。Add a brake: when the power is cut, a spring makes it clamp the motor shaft, and it releases only when powered. When sizing the brake, don’t count on friction to help: assuming no friction in either the screw or the gearhead, the motor shaft sees 255.1 × 0.005 / (2π × 3.5) = 0.058 N·m, and doubling that for margin gives 0.116 N·m. The smallest model in Miki Pulley’s BXW series has a braking torque of 0.24 N·m (Miki Pulley), 4.1 times 0.058 (our arithmetic). This is what design 2 does in the end.
  • 换成梯形丝杠：Tr16×4 加同样的减速器，按 μ = 0.10 算是自锁的，停着不动时一点电流都不用；可它离自锁的边很近（导程角 5.20°，摩擦角 5.71°，μ 小于 0.091 就不自锁了），振动和冲击也会让自锁失效，丝杠厂家的经验是导程角超过约 4.5° 一般就不自锁了（ZIMM 的说明），所以它只能算多一道保险，人会站在下面时还是要有制动器。它效率低，抬的时候要 2.97 A（滚珠丝杠是 2.04 A，都算上电机自己的摩擦），铜损是 2.1 倍；导程 4 mm 时 0.10 m/s 要电机转 5250 rpm，电池在标称 25.6 V 时驱动器给不出这么高的电压，只能到约 0.096 m/s；螺纹还会磨损（我们算的）。Switch to a trapezoidal lead screw: a Tr16×4 with the same gearhead is self-locking at μ = 0.10, so standing still takes no current at all. But it sits very close to the edge of self-locking (lead angle 5.20°, friction angle 5.71°; with μ below 0.091 it no longer self-locks), and vibration and shock can also defeat self-locking; screw makers’ experience is that above a lead angle of about 4.5° a screw is generally not self-locking (ZIMM). So it only counts as an extra safeguard, and if people will stand underneath, you still need a brake. It is also inefficient: raising takes 2.97 A (2.04 A with the ball screw, both including the motor’s own friction), so the copper loss is 2.1 times as high. With a 4 mm lead, 0.10 m/s needs the motor at 5250 rpm, and with the battery at its nominal 25.6 V the drive cannot supply that much voltage, so it only reaches about 0.096 m/s. The thread also wears (our arithmetic).
  • 加配重或气弹簧，把大部分重量平衡掉，电机只管加速和摩擦。断电时还是要有东西托住剩下的那一点。Add a counterweight or a gas spring to balance out most of the weight, so the motor only deals with acceleration and friction. When the power is cut, something still has to hold up the small remainder.

还有一种丝杠：行星滚柱丝杠，用一圈带螺纹的小滚柱代替钢珠，接触点多，能扛更大的力。据二手资料，特斯拉的人形机器人 Optimus 的直线关节就是围绕它做的，有报道说最大的一种能推 8000 N（第 ⑯ 步）。There is one more kind of screw: the planetary roller screw, which uses a ring of small threaded rollers instead of balls; with more contact points, it can take larger forces. According to secondary sources, the linear joints of Tesla’s humanoid robot Optimus are built around it, and reports say the largest can push 8000 N (step ⑯).

  • Ⓐ 是"剥开的螺纹"：一个斜坡（导程角 λ），上面一个木块代表螺母和负载；两根条比的是重力沿斜坡往下拉的力 F·sin λ 和摩擦最多能挡住的 μF·cos λ，旁边写着松手以后它会不会自己滑下去。Ⓑ 是效率随导程角变化的两条曲线：正向 η 和反向 η′，η′ ≤ 0 的区域标着"自锁"；曲线上标着滚珠丝杠（90%/80%）、Tr16×4、Roton 的两个例子（滑动丝杠配青铜螺母，μ 0.15）、我们的两根滚珠丝杠。Ⓐ is "the unrolled thread": a slope (lead angle λ) with a block on it standing for the nut and the load. Two bars compare the force of gravity pulling down the slope, F·sin λ, with the most that friction can hold back, μF·cos λ, and a note beside them says whether it will slide down by itself once let go. Ⓑ shows two curves of efficiency against lead angle, forward η and backdrive η′, with the region where η′ ≤ 0 labelled "self-locking"; marked on the curves are the ball screw (90%/80%), Tr16×4, Roton’s two examples (sliding screw with a bronze nut, μ 0.15) and our two ball screws.
  • Ⓒ 是升降柱，旁边一张高度–时间图，每断一次电就留下一条灰线，下面记一行。设计：第一版、第二版（默认）、梯形丝杠 Tr16×4；丝杠：滚珠或梯形；滑块导程 L（2–20 mm）、摩擦系数 μ（梯形）（0.003–0.25，只管滑动丝杠，滚珠丝杠一直按 90%/80% 算）；开关制动器 0.24 N·m（默认关）；按钮断电（按完变成重来）。读数：导程角和摩擦角、正反两个效率、抬起来要的电机力矩和电流、托住最少要的力矩（就是断电后负载拧电机的力矩）、断电会怎样、制动器够不够（不算摩擦）。Ⓒ is the lift, with a height–time plot beside it; every power cut leaves a grey line and adds a row below. Design: Design 1, Design 2 (default), Lead screw Tr16×4; Screw: Ball or Trapezoidal; sliders Lead L (2–20 mm) and Friction μ (sliding) (0.003–0.25; it applies only to sliding screws, and the ball screw always uses 90%/80%); toggle Brake 0.24 N·m (off by default); button Cut power (which becomes Restart once pressed). Readouts: the lead angle and friction angle, the forward and backdrive efficiencies, the motor torque and current needed to raise, the minimum torque to hold (that is, the torque with which the load twists the motor after a power cut), what happens if the power is cut, and whether the brake is enough (not counting friction).

先玩：在第二版按断电：几秒滑到底？按重来，打开制动器再断一次。换成梯形丝杠 Tr16×4：断电时为什么托得住，余量有多大，抬的时候又要多少电流？把摩擦系数慢慢调小，看自锁在哪一点消失。Try first: In Design 2, press Cut power: how many seconds does it take to slide to the bottom? Press Restart, switch on the Brake and cut the power again. Switch to Lead screw Tr16×4: why does it hold when the power is cut, how much margin is there, and how much current does raising take? Turn Friction down slowly and see at what point self-locking disappears.

这一步的要点：丝杠是绕在圆柱上的斜坡，F = 2πητ/L，导程越小推力越大、走得越慢。它有正反两个效率：导程角不大于摩擦角就自锁，代价是正向效率不到 50%，而且自锁的余量常常很小；滚珠丝杠效率约 90%，从不自锁，竖着用时断电就会被负载推着倒转，必须有制动器托住，算制动器时别指望摩擦帮忙。The point of this step: A screw is a slope wrapped round a rod, F = 2πητ/L; the smaller the lead, the more thrust and the slower the travel. It has two efficiencies, forward and backdrive: if the lead angle is no larger than the friction angle it is self-locking, at the price of a forward efficiency below 50%, and the self-locking margin is often small. A ball screw is about 90% efficient and never self-locks; used vertically, it is driven backwards by the load as soon as the power is cut, so it must have a brake to hold it, and when sizing the brake, don’t count on friction to help.

第 ⑦ 步 · 电机转了，负载不一定跟着动Step ⑦ · The motor turns, but the load may not follow

间隙、摩擦和柔性Backlash, friction and compliance

前面的公式都把减速器当成理想的：电机转 N 度，输出就转 1 度。真实的传动链里，至少还藏着三样东西。All the formulas so far have treated the reducer as ideal: the motor turns N degrees and the output turns 1 degree. A real transmission hides at least three more things.

回差（间隙）。齿轮的齿和齿之间要留一点空隙，不然会卡死、热胀以后会顶住。传过去的力矩一直朝一个方向时，齿面贴着，看不出来；力矩一换方向（换向，或者开始刹车），电机要先转过这段空隙，另一侧的齿面才贴上，输出才跟着动。竖直的轴被重力一直压在同一侧，上下走都很少显出回差。这一段输入转了、输出没动的角度，叫空程。GP 42 C 一级、两级、三级的平均回差（空载）是 0.6°、0.8°、1.0°（规格书），说的是输出轴能来回晃多少度。Backlash (play). Gear teeth need a little clearance between them, or they would jam, and bind once they expand with heat. While the transmitted torque keeps pointing one way, the tooth faces stay in contact and it does not show. Once the torque changes direction (at a reversal, or when braking starts), the motor first has to turn through this gap before the tooth faces on the other side meet and the output follows. On a vertical axis, gravity keeps the teeth pressed against the same side, so backlash rarely shows, going up or down. This angle, through which the input turns while the output stays still, is called lost motion. The GP 42 C’s average backlash (no load) is 0.6°, 0.8° and 1.0° for one, two and three stages (datasheet): that is how many degrees the output shaft can rock back and forth.

开场说的第三件事就是它。轮子用的是三级的，1.0°，半径 0.08 m 的轮子在地上就是 0.08 × 1.0 × π/180 = 1.40 mm：底盘每换一次向，电机先空转这一段（在电机上是 74°），轮子没动，可装在电机上的编码器已经数了进去，里程计就以为走了 1.40 mm。好在它不会越积越多：下一次换向，齿面换回原来那一侧，这 1.40 mm 又还回来了；来回挪多少次，光是回差让位置差的都不超过 1.40 mm。两个轮子停在间隙的不同位置时，朝向也会偏，最多 2 × 1.40/0.40 = 7.0 mrad = 0.40°，1 m 外就是 7.0 mm（我们算的）。升降柱那一级的 0.6°，换成滑台的位移只有 0.005 × 0.6/360 = 8.3 µm（我们算的），丝杠把它缩小了，何况重力一直压着同一侧齿面，基本显不出来。This is the third thing from the opening. The wheels use the three-stage version, 1.0°, which on the floor, for a wheel of radius 0.08 m, is 0.08 × 1.0 × π/180 = 1.40 mm. Every time the base reverses, the motor first idles through this stretch (74° at the motor) while the wheel stays still, but the encoder on the motor has already counted it, so the odometry thinks the robot has moved 1.40 mm. Luckily it does not build up: at the next reversal the tooth faces switch back to the original side and the 1.40 mm is given back. However many times the base shuffles back and forth, backlash alone never leaves the position more than 1.40 mm off. When the two wheels stop at different points in their gaps, the heading is off too, by at most 2 × 1.40/0.40 = 7.0 mrad = 0.40°, or 7.0 mm at 1 m (our arithmetic). The lift’s single stage has 0.6°, which at the carriage is only 0.005 × 0.6/360 = 8.3 µm (our arithmetic): the screw scales it down, and gravity keeps pressing on the same tooth faces anyway, so it hardly shows.

摩擦。齿面、轴承、密封圈都有摩擦。最简单的模型分三部分：和速度大小无关、方向总是挡着运动的库仑摩擦；和速度成正比的粘性摩擦；还有要让静止的东西动起来，得先克服一个更大的静摩擦，一动起来又小下去，这会让慢速运动一顿一顿的（"粘滑"）。谐波减速器的规格书上有两个相关的数，单位和地方都不一样，很容易看错：CSD-20-80 的"起动力矩"4.8 N·cm，是在输入端要拧多大力才让它转起来，换到输出端是 4.8 × 80 = 384 N·cm = 3.84 N·m；"反驱力矩"4.9 N·m，是在输出端要多大力矩才能把它推着倒转（CSD-20-80 产品页）。这两个数和它的额定力矩 22 N·m 比，已经是 17–22%（我们算的）。Friction. Tooth faces, bearings and seals all have friction. The simplest model has three parts: Coulomb friction, which does not depend on how fast things move and always opposes the motion; viscous friction, proportional to speed; and static friction, a larger friction you must overcome first to get something at rest moving, which drops again once it moves. This makes slow motion jerky ("stick–slip"). A strain wave gear’s datasheet has two related numbers, given in different units and at different ends, which are easy to misread. The CSD-20-80’s "starting torque" of 4.8 N·cm is how hard you must twist the input to get it turning; at the output that is 4.8 × 80 = 384 N·cm = 3.84 N·m. Its "backdriving torque" of 4.9 N·m is the torque needed at the output to push it into turning backwards (CSD-20-80 product page). Compared with its rated torque of 22 N·m, these two numbers are already 17–22% (our arithmetic).

柔性。没有什么是绝对刚的：轴会扭，齿会弯，谐波减速器的柔轮本来就是靠变形工作的。规格书用三段折线描述它的扭转刚度：力矩小时最软，力矩越大越硬：Compliance. Nothing is perfectly rigid: shafts twist, teeth bend, and a strain wave gear’s flexspline works by deforming in the first place. The datasheet describes its torsional stiffness with a broken line of three segments: softest at low torque, stiffer as the torque grows:

Δθ(T) = T / K1  (T ≤ T1)Δθ(T) = T1/K1 + (T − T1)/K2  (T1 < T ≤ T2)Δθ(T) = T1/K1 + (T2 − T1)/K2 + (T − T2)/K3  (T > T2)

输出端受到力矩 T 时扭过的角度 Δθ：力矩不超过 T1，就是 T 除以 K1；超过 T1 的那部分按 K2 算；超过 T2 的那部分按 K3 算，三段加起来。The angle Δθ the output twists through under a torque T: up to T1, it is T divided by K1; the part above T1 is taken at K2; the part above T2 at K3; then add the three pieces together.

刚度 K 是"每扭 1 rad 要多少 N·m"，扭的角度就是力矩除以刚度。谐波减速器在小力矩时咬合的齿少、柔轮好变形，所以最软；力矩一大，咬上的齿多了，就硬起来。厂家把这条弯曲的线近似成三段直线。The stiffness K is "how many N·m it takes to twist it by 1 rad", so the twist angle is the torque divided by the stiffness. At low torque a strain wave gear has few teeth in mesh and the flexspline deforms easily, so it is softest; as the torque rises, more teeth engage and it gets stiffer. The manufacturer approximates this curve with three straight lines.

T
加在输出端的力矩（N·m），输入端固定Torque applied at the output (N·m), with the input held fixed
Δθ
扭转角（rad）：输入端固定时，输出端被扭过的角度Twist angle (rad): how far the output is twisted while the input is held fixed
T1, T2
三段之间的分界力矩（N·m）Torques at the boundaries between the three segments (N·m)
K1, K2, K3
三段的扭转刚度（N·m/rad）Torsional stiffness of the three segments (N·m/rad)

CSD-20-80：T1 = 7 N·m、K1 = 1.3 × 104，T2 = 25 N·m、K2 = 1.7 × 104，K3 = 2.5 × 104 N·m/rad（产品页）。在额定的 22 N·m 下扭 1.42 mrad，也就是 4.9′；在能反复承受的峰值 51 N·m 下扭 2.64 mrad，9.1′；关节外 0.6 m 处就是 1.58 mm，0.8 m 处 2.11 mm（我们算的）。它的"标准精度"是 1′（0.8 m 外 0.23 mm）。CSD-20-80: T1 = 7 N·m, K1 = 1.3 × 104; T2 = 25 N·m, K2 = 1.7 × 104; K3 = 2.5 × 104 N·m/rad (product page). At the rated 22 N·m it twists 1.42 mrad, i.e. 4.9′; at 51 N·m, the peak it can take repeatedly, it twists 2.64 mrad, 9.1′. At 0.6 m from the joint that is 1.58 mm, and at 0.8 m 2.11 mm (our arithmetic). Its "standard accuracy" is 1′ (0.23 mm at 0.8 m).

"零回差"不等于"不会动"：谐波减速器没有间隙，可一受力就扭，扭的量比它的精度大好几倍。精度说的是不受力时它准不准，刚度说的是受了力它让多少，两个数要分开看。"Zero backlash" does not mean "does not move": a strain wave gear has no gap, but it twists as soon as it is loaded, and by several times its accuracy. Accuracy says how true it is when unloaded; stiffness says how much it gives under load. Read the two numbers separately.

这三样东西有一个共同点：它们都在电机和负载之间。装在电机上的编码器只知道电机转了多少，换向时的空程、受力时的扭转、慢速时的一顿一顿，它都看不见，要靠装在负载那一侧的编码器（第 ⑨ 步）。对控制也有影响：要是位置环用的是负载那一侧的编码器，负载差一点时电机得先穿过整段间隙才推得到它，推过了头再倒回来又要穿一次，环就在两个齿面之间来回找，停不下来，这叫极限环（第 6 篇讲过控制环）；只用电机侧的编码器时不会这样来回找，负载只是停在间隙里的某处，最多差一个回差。有扭转的关节，就是一个弹簧连着两块质量，环调得太硬会晃。All three have one thing in common: they sit between the motor and the load. An encoder on the motor only knows how far the motor has turned. The lost motion at a reversal, the twist under load, the jerky motion at low speed: it cannot see any of them, and you need an encoder on the load side (step ⑨). Control is affected too. If the position loop uses the load-side encoder, then when the load is a little off, the motor first has to cross the whole gap before it can push the load; if it overshoots, coming back means crossing the gap again, so the loop hunts back and forth between the two tooth faces and never settles. This is called a limit cycle (page 6 covered control loops). With only the motor-side encoder, it does not hunt like this: the load just stops somewhere in the gap, off by at most one backlash. A joint that twists is a spring connecting two masses, and a loop tuned too stiff will make it shake.

  • 上面一排是传动链，画成一串能滑动的块：电机（转角 θm）→ 夹在两堵墙之间的一个齿（墙之间的空就是间隙）→ 一根弹簧 → 压在有摩擦的地面上的负载（转角 θ）。电机按正弦来回摆。下面左图画负载的转角对电机转角（换算到输出端，θm/N），对角线是理想的，一来一回围成一个圈；右图是 8 s 里两者随时间的曲线，负载卡住不动的时段涂了阴影，还画着传过去的力矩。在时间图上拖，可以跳到那一刻。The top row is the transmission, drawn as a string of sliding blocks: the motor (angle θm) → a tooth held between two walls (the space between the walls is the gap) → a spring → the load (angle θ), pressing on a floor with friction. The motor swings back and forth sinusoidally. Below, the left plot shows the load angle against the motor angle (scaled to the output, θm/N); the diagonal is the ideal, and each back-and-forth traces out a loop. The right plot shows both against time over 8 s, with the stretches where the load is stuck shaded and the transmitted torque drawn in as well. Drag along the time plot to jump to that moment.
  • 预设轮子减速器（回差 1.0°；它的刚度我们没有数据，画成不扭的）、谐波关节（没有回差，按 CSD-20-80 的三段刚度，51 N·m 的负载力矩一直挡着运动，扭 ±9.1′）、加上摩擦（还是谐波关节，去掉负载力矩，换成 5 N·m 的摩擦，静摩擦按 1.5 倍算，摆幅只有 ±0.1°，示意）。滑块幅度 θm/N、间隙（0–1.0°）、摩擦（示意）（0–5 N·m）、负载力矩（0–51 N·m）；开关柔性（CSD-20-80）、负载一直朝一边（像重力）；▶ 播放、重来。读数：空程、扭转角、0.6 m 外的误差、轮缘上每次换向差多少、电机编码器看见的角度和实际的角度。旁边的小图换向（开场的第三件事）：底盘换向时，电机先空转 74°（换到轮子上是 1.0°）轮子才动，里程计和实际差了 1.40 mm；再换回来，又还回去，来回六趟也最多差 1.40 mm。Presets: Wheel gearhead (backlash 1.0°; we have no stiffness data for it, so it is drawn as not twisting), Strain wave joint (no backlash, the CSD-20-80’s three-segment stiffness, a 51 N·m load torque always opposing the motion, twisting ±9.1′) and With friction (still the strain wave joint, but with the load torque replaced by 5 N·m of friction, static friction taken as 1.5 times that, and a swing of only ±0.1°, illustrative). Sliders: Amplitude θm/N, Backlash (0–1.0°), Friction (illustrative) (0–5 N·m), Load torque (0–51 N·m); toggles: Compliance (CSD-20-80), Load always one way (like gravity); ▶ Play and Restart. Readouts: lost motion, twist angle, error at 0.6 m, the offset at the wheel rim per reversal, and the angle the motor encoder sees next to the actual angle. The small plot beside it, Reversing (the third thing from the opening): when the base reverses, the motor first idles through 74° (1.0° at the wheel) before the wheel moves, and the odometry ends up 1.40 mm off from reality; reverse again and it is given back, so even after six legs back and forth the error is at most 1.40 mm.

先玩：在轮子减速器里看那个圈有多宽，再看旁边的换向小图：差的那 1.40 mm 为什么不会越积越多？打开负载一直朝一边：间隙为什么看不见了？换到谐波关节：没有间隙，圈为什么还在，它的宽度由什么决定，0.6 m 外差多少？把负载力矩拉回 0 再看。最后按加上摩擦，看时间图上的阴影：负载为什么一顿一顿的？Try first: In Wheel gearhead, see how wide the loop is, then look at the small Reversing plot beside it: why doesn’t the 1.40 mm error build up? Turn on Load always one way: why does the gap disappear? Switch to Strain wave joint: there is no gap, so why is the loop still there, what sets its width, and how far off is it at 0.6 m? Drag Load torque back to 0 and look again. Finally, press With friction and look at the shading on the time plot: why does the load move in jerks?

这一步的要点：电机和负载之间藏着回差（换向时的空程）、摩擦（库仑、粘性、静摩擦）和柔性（受力就扭）。行星减速器有回差，谐波减速器没有回差却会扭，扭的量能比它的精度大好几倍。这些都发生在电机编码器"后面"，它看不见；要知道负载真的在哪，得在负载那一侧量。The point of this step: Between the motor and the load hide backlash (lost motion at each reversal), friction (Coulomb, viscous, static) and compliance (it twists under load). A planetary gearhead has backlash; a strain wave gear has none but twists, and the twist can be several times its accuracy. All of this happens "behind" the motor encoder, so it cannot see it; to know where the load really is, you have to measure on the load side.

第 ⑧ 步 · 从输出端推，推得动吗Step ⑧ · Push from the output: will it move?

能不能反驱Can it be backdriven?

平常是电机带着负载转。反过来，从负载那一端推，能不能把整条传动链连同电机一起推着倒转？能，就叫能反驱（backdrivable）；推不动，就叫不能反驱，自锁的丝杠是极端的情形。第 ⑥ 步的升降柱已经让我们吃过一次亏：滚珠丝杠能反驱，断电以后重物自己就把它推下去了。Normally the motor drives the load. Now turn it round: if you push from the load end, can you drive the whole transmission backwards, motor and all? If you can, it is backdrivable; if you cannot, it is not backdrivable, and a self-locking screw is the extreme case. The lift in step ⑥ has already caught us out once: a ball screw is backdrivable, and once the power was off, the weight pushed it down by itself.

从输出端推的时候，你要对付两样东西。一样是摩擦：电机自己的摩擦，到了输出端被放大 N 倍；减速器里的摩擦本来就在；倒着传力时效率往往更低，有的干脆是负的（自锁）。另一样是惯量：第 ④ 步说的，转子在输出端看起来大了 N² 倍，推着它加速，就像推一个重得多的东西。When you push from the output, you are up against two things. One is friction: the motor’s own friction is multiplied by N by the time it reaches the output; the friction inside the reducer is there anyway; and efficiency is often lower when force flows backwards, in some cases even negative (self-locking). The other is inertia: as step ④ showed, the rotor looks N² times larger from the output, so pushing it to accelerate is like pushing something much heavier.

τback ≈ N τf,m / η′ + τf,gJfelt = Jload + N2 Jm

从输出端把它推动，至少要克服的力矩，约等于电机的摩擦力矩乘以减速比、除以反向效率，再加上减速器自己的摩擦。推着它加速时，手上感到的惯量是负载的惯量加上折算过来的转子惯量。The least torque you must overcome to move it from the output is about the motor’s friction torque times the gear ratio, divided by the backdrive efficiency, plus the reducer’s own friction. When you push it to accelerate, the inertia your hand feels is the load’s inertia plus the reflected rotor inertia.

站在输出端，电机的摩擦力矩 τf,m 要乘以 N 才对得上（和电机的力矩被放大 N 倍是同一件事），倒着传过减速器还要再打一个反向效率的折扣。减速比越大，这两项越大：几十比一的关节，你推它，推的是被放大了几十倍的摩擦和被放大了几千倍的转子。Seen from the output, the motor’s friction torque τf,m has to be multiplied by N to put it in output terms (the same thing as the motor’s torque being multiplied by N), and going backwards through the reducer it takes a further hit from the backdrive efficiency. The larger the ratio, the larger both terms: push a joint geared several dozen to one, and you are pushing friction magnified several dozen times and a rotor magnified several thousand times.

τback
从输出端推动它要的最小力矩（N·m），规格书有时直接给，叫"反驱力矩"The least torque at the output that will move it (N·m); datasheets sometimes give it directly, as the "backdriving torque"
τf,m, τf,g
电机的摩擦力矩（电机轴上）；减速器自己的摩擦力矩（折到输出端）The motor’s friction torque (at the motor shaft); the reducer’s own friction torque (reflected to the output)
Jload, Jm
负载自己的惯量（输出端）；电机转子的惯量（第 ④ 步）The load’s own inertia (at the output); the motor rotor’s inertia (step ④)
η′
反向效率（第 ⑥ 步）；≤ 0 时根本推不动Backdrive efficiency (step ⑥); at ≤ 0 it cannot be pushed at all
Jfelt
从输出端推着加速时感到的惯量The inertia you feel when pushing it to accelerate from the output

轮子（74 比 1，三级行星，反向效率按 72% 算，示意）：电机的摩擦 0.0109 N·m 到了轮子上是 0.0109 × 74/0.72 = 1.12 N·m，在轮缘上是 14.0 N；两个轮子加上滚动阻力 14.7 N（示意），断电时要用约 43 N 才推得动这台 100 kg 的机器人，推起来像 131 kg（我们算的）。谐波减速器 CSD-20-80 的规格书直接给了反驱力矩：4.9 N·m（产品页），在关节外 0.5 m 处推 9.8 N，减速器自己就转了；连上电机，还要加上电机摩擦乘 80、再除以反向效率的那一份（EC 45 flat 至少 0.87 N·m，我们算的）。The wheels (74 to 1, three-stage planetary, backdrive efficiency taken as 72%, illustrative): the motor’s friction of 0.0109 N·m becomes 0.0109 × 74/0.72 = 1.12 N·m at the wheel, or 14.0 N at the rim. With two wheels plus 14.7 N of rolling resistance (illustrative), it takes about 43 N to push this 100 kg robot with the power off, and it then feels like 131 kg (our arithmetic). For the CSD-20-80 strain wave gear, the datasheet gives the backdriving torque directly: 4.9 N·m (product page), so a 9.8 N push at 0.5 m from the joint turns the gear on its own; with the motor connected, add the motor’s friction times 80, divided by the backdrive efficiency (at least 0.87 N·m for the EC 45 flat, our arithmetic).

反驱力矩不是一个固定的数：温度低、润滑脂稠，摩擦就大；静止时要先克服静摩擦，比动起来以后大。它只能告诉你推动它大概要多大力，不能拿来托住负载：Harmonic Drive 自己的样本说，除非把输入轴锁住，谐波减速器很容易被反驱，有伤人风险时，绝不能不加失效保护装置就让它托着负载（Harmonic Drive PSA-G 样本）。The backdriving torque is not a fixed number: when it is cold and the grease is thick, friction is higher; from standstill you must first overcome static friction, which is larger than once it is moving. It only tells you roughly how hard you have to push to move it; you cannot rely on it to hold up a load. Harmonic Drive’s own catalogue says that unless the input shaft is locked, a strain wave gear is easily backdriven, and where there is a risk of injury it must never be left holding a load without a fail-safe device (Harmonic Drive PSA-G catalogue).

为什么在意它？至少有五个理由：Why care about it? There are at least five reasons:

  • 断电以后会怎样：能反驱的竖直轴会掉下来（升降柱），水平轴会被人或者斜坡推着走；不能反驱的会停在原地，可人被夹住时也推不开它。所以能反驱的竖直轴必须配制动器（第 ⑫ 步）。When the power is cut: a backdrivable vertical axis falls (the lift), and a horizontal one can be pushed along by a person or a slope; one that is not backdrivable stays where it is, but then a trapped person cannot push it away either. So a backdrivable vertical axis must have a brake (step ⑫).
  • 撞上东西时：能反驱、折算惯量小的关节，撞到东西时会被推回去，冲击小；高减速比的关节"硬"，撞上去的是电机转子那 N² 倍的惯量。足式机器人的腿每一步都在撞地，所以用低减速比（第 ⑯ 步）。When it hits something: a backdrivable joint with little reflected inertia gets pushed back on impact, so the blow is small; a high-ratio joint is "hard", and what hits is N² times the motor rotor’s inertia. A legged robot’s legs hit the ground at every step, so they use low gear ratios (step ⑯).
  • 量力：能反驱、摩擦小的传动，外面的力能原样传回电机，电流就是力矩（第 ⑩ 步）；高减速比的传动，摩擦把外力"吃掉"一大块，只能另装力矩传感器。Measuring force: in a backdrivable, low-friction transmission, outside forces pass back to the motor unchanged, so the current is the torque (step ⑩); in a high-ratio transmission, friction "eats" a large share of the outside force, and the only option is a separate torque sensor.
  • 用手拖着教：人拉着机器人走一遍，让它记下来。FR3 能被人拉着走，Franka 说这是因为每个关节的力矩传感器很灵敏，能估出外面的接触力，所以能"顺滑、直观地"用手引导（FR3 产品页）：传感器量到你的力，控制器让电机跟着让开。这是"控制出来的"能反驱；断电以后，FR3 的七个关节会被锁止销锁住（硬件手册），平常推不动；可要是有人被夹住，手册给了不通电也能脱困的三种办法：用应急解锁工具逐个解开关节、把底座拆下来，或者硬把手臂推开、拉开（关节会因此损坏）。Teaching by hand: a person leads the robot through a motion and it records it. FR3 can be led by hand; Franka says this is because the torque sensors in each joint are sensitive enough to estimate external contact forces, so it can be guided by hand "smoothly and intuitively" (FR3 product page): the sensors measure your force and the controller makes the motors give way. This is backdrivability "made by control". With the power off, FR3’s seven joints are held by locking bolts (hardware manual) and normally cannot be pushed; but if someone is trapped, the manual gives three ways to free them without power: release the joints one by one with the emergency unlocking tool, take off the base, or force the arm away by pushing or pulling it (which damages the joints).
  • 回收能量：能反驱，下放、刹车时才能把能量送回电池（第 ③ 步）。Recovering energy: only a backdrivable transmission lets lowering and braking send energy back to the battery (step ③).

没有一种选择在每一条上都赢，所以不同的机器人选得不一样：升降柱用能反驱的滚珠丝杠，靠制动器托住；轮子用中等减速比的行星；四足机器人的腿用 6 比 1 左右的低减速比，图的是能反驱、撞得起、用电流就能控力矩（Katz，2018）；小舵机用几百比一的减速，又小又有劲，代价是反驱起来很涩（第 ⑯ 步）。No choice wins on every count, so different robots choose differently: the lift uses a backdrivable ball screw and relies on a brake to hold it up; the wheels use planetary gearheads with a moderate ratio; a quadruped’s legs use a low ratio of about 6 to 1, for backdrivability, surviving impacts and controlling torque through current alone (Katz, 2018); small servos use reductions of several hundred to one, which makes them small and strong, at the price of being stiff to backdrive (step ⑯).

  • 先选一种执行器：升降柱·滚珠丝杠、升降柱·梯形丝杠、轮子 74:1、谐波关节（按 CSD-20-80 的数）、准直驱 6:1（按 Mini Cheetah 的关节）、舵机 353.5:1（按 Dynamixel XM430）。图上画着输出端和作用在它上面的力：重力、手、摩擦；下面两根条比一比"推力加重力"和"要克服的摩擦"，再给一句结论。关节是在水平面里推的，没有重力。First pick an actuator: Lift, ball screw, Lift, lead screw, Wheel 74:1, Strain wave joint (with the CSD-20-80’s numbers), Quasi-direct 6:1 (based on the Mini Cheetah joint) or Hobby servo 353.5:1 (based on the Dynamixel XM430). The picture shows the output and the forces acting on it: gravity, your hand, friction. Below it, two bars compare "push plus weight" with "the friction to overcome", followed by a one-line verdict. The joints are pushed in a horizontal plane, so there is no gravity.
  • 滑块是推力，名字跟着执行器换：往下推滑台（0–300 N）、推机器人（0–100 N）、推 0.5 m 处（0–20 N）。电源：断电（默认）或通电，控制补偿（只有装了力矩传感器、或者减速比低到电流能当力矩用的，才真能"让开"；别的会说缺了什么）；滚珠丝杠的升降柱还有开关制动器 0.24 N·m。按钮▶ 推 2 秒（升降柱上不推时是▶ 放手 2 秒）、重来。读数：起动要的力、感到的质量（或惯量）、断电时会怎样、这一推的结果。没有出处的数（准直驱关节的摩擦、舵机的反驱力矩和转子惯量）都标着"示意"。The slider is the push, and its name changes with the actuator: Push the carriage down (0–300 N), Push the robot (0–100 N), Push at 0.5 m (0–20 N). Power: Power off (default) or Powered, compensated (only actuators with a torque sensor, or with a ratio low enough for the current to stand in for torque, can really "give way"; for the others it says what is missing); the ball-screw lift also has a Brake 0.24 N·m toggle. Buttons: ▶ Push for 2 s (on the lift with no push it is ▶ Let go for 2 s) and Restart. Readouts: the force to start it moving, the felt mass (or inertia), what happens with the power off, and the result of this push. Numbers without a source (the quasi-direct joint’s friction, the servo’s backdriving torque and rotor inertia) are all marked "illustrative".

先玩：先选升降柱·滚珠丝杠，什么都不推，按▶ 放手 2 秒；打开制动器再来一次；再换梯形丝杠。换到轮子 74:1，推多大的力机器人才动，推起来有多重？比一比谐波关节和准直驱 6:1：推动它们各要多大的力？再给谐波关节选通电，控制补偿：现在呢？Try first: Start with Lift, ball screw, push nothing and press ▶ Let go for 2 s; switch on the Brake and go again; then change to Lift, lead screw. Switch to Wheel 74:1: how hard must you push before the robot moves, and how heavy does it feel? Compare Strain wave joint with Quasi-direct 6:1: how much force does each take to move? Then give the strain wave joint Powered, compensated: what now?

这一步的要点：从输出端推，要对付被放大 N 倍的摩擦和被放大 N² 倍的转子惯量，反向效率还可能更低甚至为负（自锁）。能反驱，竖直的轴（还有可能停在斜坡上的底盘）就要为断电准备制动器，但撞得起、量得出力、能回收能量；不能反驱，断电时稳，可撞上去硬、外力感觉不到。力矩传感器加上控制，也能让一个关节"感觉上"能被推动，FR3 的手拉引导就是这样。The point of this step: Pushing from the output, you are up against friction multiplied by N and rotor inertia multiplied by N², and the backdrive efficiency may be lower still, even negative (self-locking). If it is backdrivable, a vertical axis (and a base that may stop on a slope) needs a brake for when the power is cut, but it survives impacts, can measure force and can recover energy; if it is not, it stays put when the power is cut, but hits hard and cannot feel outside forces. A torque sensor plus control can also make a joint "feel" backdrivable: that is how FR3’s hand guiding works.

第 ⑨ 步 · 量转角的传感器Step ⑨ · The sensor that measures rotation

编码器：装在电机侧还是关节侧Encoders: on the motor side or on the joint side

编码器量的是一根轴转到了哪。最常见的一种是增量式：轴上一个刻着一圈细格的码盘（光学的透光、不透光，或者磁性的南北极），旁边两个读头 A 和 B，错开四分之一个刻线间距。轴转动时，A、B 各出一串方波，两串波错开 90°：A 先变还是 B 先变，就知道往哪个方向转；A、B 的上升沿、下降沿全数上，每条刻线能数出 4 个数，这叫四倍频。下面说的"一格"，都指数出来的一个数。很多编码器还有第三路 Z（index），一圈只出一个脉冲，用来找零点。An encoder measures where a shaft has turned to. The most common kind is incremental: a disc on the shaft is marked with a ring of fine lines (on an optical one, alternately clear and opaque; on a magnetic one, north and south poles), and beside it sit two read heads, A and B, offset by a quarter of the line spacing. As the shaft turns, A and B each put out a train of square waves, and the two trains are 90° apart: whether A or B changes first tells you which way it is turning; count every rising and falling edge on A and B, and each line gives 4 counts. This is called quadrature (×4) decoding. From here on, "one count" always means one of these counted edges. Many encoders also have a third channel, Z (index), which gives just one pulse per turn and is used to find the zero point.

增量式只会数"又转过了几格"，不知道自己一开始在哪。所以上电以后要先回零：慢慢走到一个已知的位置，比如升降柱最底下装一个参考开关，碰到它就把计数清零（驱动器的回零模式和参考开关输入就是干这个的，第 ⑭ 步）。绝对式编码器给每个角度一个独一无二的编号，一上电就知道在哪。单圈的只分得清一圈之内；多圈的还记得转过了几整圈。电机在关节走一个来回时要转好多圈，装在电机侧的绝对式编码器要是多圈的，才能一上电就知道关节在哪；关节常常转不满一整圈，装在关节侧，单圈的就够。An incremental encoder can only count "how many more counts it has turned through"; it has no idea where it started. So after power-up it first has to go through homing: move slowly to a known position, for example a reference switch fitted at the very bottom of the lift column, and reset the count to zero when it touches it (this is what the drive’s homing mode and reference-switch input are for, step ⑭). An absolute encoder gives every angle a unique number, so it knows where it is the moment it is powered up. A single-turn one can only tell positions apart within one turn; a multi-turn one also remembers how many whole turns it has made. The motor turns many times while the joint makes one trip back and forth, so an absolute encoder on the motor side has to be multi-turn to know where the joint is at power-up; a joint often turns less than one full turn, so on the joint side a single-turn one is enough.

Δθout = 360° / (N · c),  Δx = L / (N · c)

装在电机上的编码器，换算到输出端，一格对应的角度是 360° 除以"减速比乘以电机每转的计数"；如果输出是丝杠，一格对应的距离是导程除以同一个数。For an encoder on the motor, one count converted to the output is an angle of 360° divided by "the gear ratio times the motor’s counts per turn"; if the output is a screw, one count is a distance of the lead divided by the same number.

电机转 N 圈输出才转 1 圈，所以电机侧的每一格到了输出端都被缩小了 N 倍。减速比大，电机侧的编码器换算过来就很细，这是减速比的一个好处（第 ④ 步）。N turns of the motor make 1 turn of the output, so every motor-side count is shrunk N times by the time it reaches the output. With a large gear ratio, a motor-side encoder becomes very fine once converted: this is one of the benefits of a gear ratio (step ④).

c
电机转一圈的计数（四倍频以后）counts per motor turn (after ×4 decoding)
N, L
减速比；丝杠导程the gear ratio; the screw lead
Δθout, Δx
换算到输出端的一格：角度，或者滑台的位移one count converted to the output: an angle, or a movement of the carriage

升降柱：电机上装一个每转 1024 线的增量式编码器（示意），四倍频后每转 4096 格，滑台每一格是 0.005/(3.5 × 4096) = 0.349 µm；只用电机自带的霍尔传感器（每转 48 个状态），每一格也有 29.8 µm。轮子：减速比按精确值 147/2 = 73.5 算（第 ⑤ 步），4096 × 73.5 = 301,056 格一圈，轮缘上每格 1.67 µm；要是按名义的 74 算，里程计每走 1 m 少算约 6.8 mm（都是我们算的）。直接装在关节上的绝对式编码器按位数算：12 位一圈 4096 格，每格 0.088°；14 位 0.022°；17 位 9.9″；20 位 1.24″，在 0.8 m 外分别是 1.23 mm、0.31 mm、38 µm、4.8 µm（″ 是角秒，1/3600°；我们算的）。The lift column: fit an incremental encoder with 1024 lines per turn on the motor (illustrative); after ×4 decoding that is 4096 counts per turn, and each count moves the carriage 0.005/(3.5 × 4096) = 0.349 µm. Even using only the motor’s built-in Hall sensors (48 states per turn), a count is 29.8 µm. The wheels: take the gear ratio at its exact value, 147/2 = 73.5 (step ⑤); 4096 × 73.5 = 301,056 counts per turn, 1.67 µm per count at the rim; if you used the nominal 74 instead, the odometry would come up about 6.8 mm short for every 1 m travelled (all our arithmetic). For an absolute encoder mounted directly on the joint, it comes down to the number of bits: 12 bits is 4096 counts per turn, 0.088° per count; 14 bits 0.022°; 17 bits 9.9″; 20 bits 1.24″; at 0.8 m out, these are 1.23 mm, 0.31 mm, 38 µm and 4.8 µm (″ is an arcsecond, 1/3600°; our arithmetic).

分辨率不是精度。分辨率说的是"一格多小"，精度说的是"读数离真值多近"。RLS 的 AksIM-2 绝对式编码器分辨率最高 20 位（1.24″），自校准以后的精度是 ±14″ 到 ±72″（RLS 产品页），比一格大十几倍到几十倍。Mini Cheetah 的关节用的磁编码器标称 14 位，作者说实际每次读数有大约 2 位的噪声（Katz，2018）。Resolution is not accuracy. Resolution says "how small one count is"; accuracy says "how close the reading is to the true value". RLS’s AksIM-2 absolute encoder has a resolution of up to 20 bits (1.24″), and after self-calibration its accuracy is ±14″ to ±72″ (RLS product page): a dozen or so to several dozen times larger than one count. The magnetic encoder in the Mini Cheetah’s joints is nominally 14 bits, and the author says each reading actually carries about 2 bits of noise (Katz, 2018).

编码器装在哪，决定了它能看见什么：Where an encoder is mounted decides what it can see:

  • 电机侧：装在电机轴上，又便宜又细（分辨率乘了 N），驱动器换相、电流环、速度环都靠它（第 ① 步：无刷电机得知道转子在哪）。可它只知道电机转了多少；电机和负载之间的回差、扭转（第 ⑦ 步）、减速器的传动误差（第 ⑤ 步）、皮带打滑，它都看不见。开场那 1.40 mm，就是这么漏掉的。Motor side: mounted on the motor shaft, it is both cheap and fine (its resolution is multiplied by N), and the drive relies on it for commutation, the current loop and the speed loop (step ①: a brushless motor needs to know where its rotor is). But it only knows how far the motor has turned; the backlash and twist between the motor and the load (step ⑦), the gearhead’s transmission error (step ⑤) and belt slip are all things it cannot see. That is how the 1.40 mm in the opening slipped through.
  • 关节侧（输出侧）：装在减速器后面，直接量负载的转角，回差、扭转都在读数里。代价是它转得慢，要同样细，就得多很多位；要装在空心的关节里，线也难走。Joint side (output side): mounted after the gearhead, it measures the load’s angle directly, so backlash and twist are both in the reading. The price is that it turns slowly, so to be just as fine it needs many more bits; and fitted inside a hollow joint, its cables are hard to route.
  • 两边都装：两个读数之差，是传动链的扭转，再加上回差和传动误差。只有扭转比后两样大得多的时候（比如故意串一根软弹簧，第 ⑩ 步的第三种办法），乘上刚度才是力矩；像 CSD-20-80 这样硬的谐波减速器，1′ 的传动误差按 K1 算就相当于 3.8 N·m（我们算的）。FR3 通过 libfranka 同时给出 q（"测得的关节位置"）和 theta（"电机位置"）（libfranka 文档）。Both sides: the difference between the two readings is the twist of the drive train, plus the backlash and the transmission error. Only when the twist is much larger than those two (for example, with a soft spring deliberately put in series: the third method in step ⑩) does multiplying it by the stiffness give the torque; in a strain wave gear as stiff as the CSD-20-80, 1′ of transmission error, worked out with K1, is equivalent to 3.8 N·m (our arithmetic). Through libfranka, the FR3 gives both q ("measured joint position") and theta ("motor position") (libfranka docs).

别的机器人选得也不一样。Mini Cheetah 只在电机侧装一个 14 位的磁编码器，6 比 1 的减速换算过来一圈 98,304 格（0.0037°，我们算的），它的减速比低、几乎没有扭转，够用；Dynamixel XM430 的舵机，编码器在输出端，12 位一圈 4096 格（ROBOTIS 说明书），353.5 比 1 的齿轮有多少间隙，它都看得见。Other robots choose differently, too. The Mini Cheetah has only one 14-bit magnetic encoder, on the motor side; through its 6:1 reduction that becomes 98,304 counts per turn (0.0037°, our arithmetic), and with its low gear ratio and almost no twist, that is enough. The Dynamixel XM430 servo has its encoder on the output, 12 bits, 4096 counts per turn (ROBOTIS e-Manual), so however much backlash its 353.5:1 gear train has, it can see it.

  • 上面是一个关节：电机 → 减速器 → 0.6 m 长的连杆（自重 1.5 kg，示意），末端挂负载，连杆来回摆 ±30°，重力压着它。电机侧编码器换算出来的连杆、关节侧编码器读到的连杆，画成两根淡淡的影子，误差放大了画（行星放大 10 倍，谐波最多放大 200 倍）。下面的曲线是连杆的角度，和两种读数在连杆末端各差多少毫米；在曲线上拖，可以跳到那一刻。At the top is one joint: motor → gearhead → a 0.6 m link (weighing 1.5 kg itself, illustrative) with a payload hung at its tip; the link swings back and forth through ±30°, with gravity pressing down on it. The link as converted from the motor-side encoder and the link as read by the joint-side encoder are drawn as two faint shadows, with their errors magnified (10 times for the planetary gear, up to 200 times for the strain wave gear). The plots below show the link angle and how many millimetres each reading is off at the tip of the link; drag along a plot to jump to that moment.
  • 选减速器：行星 74:1（间隙 1.0°）或者谐波 80:1（会扭）（按 CSD-20-80）。电机侧每转 64、256、1024 线（四倍频前）；关节侧 12、14、17、20 位；摆动：水平 ±30°或竖直过顶 ±30°（默认；连杆越过最高点时，重力的力矩换方向）；负载 0–3 kg。小图把 A、B 两路方波和霍尔传感器的 6 个状态放慢了画：看方向怎么判断、每条刻线怎么数出 4 个数。读数：两种编码器在末端每一格多大、各差多少毫米，重力在关节上的力矩，和两个编码器一减算出来的力矩。Pick a Gear: Planetary 74:1 (1.0° backlash) or Strain wave 80:1 (CSD-20-80 twist). Motor side: 64, 256 or 1024 lines per turn (before ×4 decoding); Joint side: 12, 14, 17 or 20 bits; Swing: Level ±30° or Over the top ±30° (the default; as the link passes its highest point, the gravity torque reverses); Payload 0–3 kg. The small plot shows the A and B square waves and the Hall sensors’ 6 states in slow motion: see how the direction is worked out and how each line gives 4 counts. Readouts: how large one count of each encoder is at the tip and how many millimetres each is off, the gravity torque at the joint, and the torque obtained by subtracting the two encoders.

先玩：先用行星 74:1：连杆每次越过最高点，电机侧的误差为什么一下子从一边跳到另一边？换成水平摆动呢？换成谐波 80:1，把负载加到 3 kg：误差变成什么样？把关节侧降到 12 位，它是不是反而比电机侧还"粗"？再调到 20 位：两个编码器一减算出来的力矩，和真的差多少？Try first: Start with Planetary 74:1: each time the link passes its highest point, why does the motor-side error suddenly jump from one side to the other? And with a Level swing? Switch to Strain wave 80:1 and raise the Payload to 3 kg: what does the error look like now? Drop the Joint side to 12 bits: does it turn out even "coarser" than the motor side? Then set it to 20 bits: how far off the true torque is the torque you get by subtracting the two encoders?

这一步的要点：增量式编码器数格子，上电要回零；绝对式一上电就知道在哪。电机侧的编码器分辨率乘了减速比，又细又便宜，但看不见电机和负载之间的回差和扭转；关节侧的编码器直接量负载，看得见，但要更多的位。两边都装，读数之差是扭转（还混着回差和传动误差），扭转够大时可以拿来算力矩。分辨率不等于精度。The point of this step: An incremental encoder counts ticks and has to be homed at power-up; an absolute one knows where it is the moment it is powered up. A motor-side encoder has its resolution multiplied by the gear ratio, so it is fine and cheap, but it cannot see the backlash and twist between the motor and the load; a joint-side encoder measures the load directly and can see them, but needs more bits. Fit both, and the difference between the readings is the twist (mixed with backlash and transmission error); when the twist is large enough, it can be used to work out the torque. Resolution is not accuracy.

第 ⑩ 步 · 关节到底用了多大的劲Step ⑩ · How hard the joint is really pushing

力矩传感器Torque sensors

机器人要知道自己用了多大的力，原因很多：碰到人要马上停（碰撞检测），擦桌子要按一定的力往下压（力控和阻抗控制，第 6 篇），要知道手里多拿了什么（上一篇第 ⑪ 步：没登记的杯子会被当成 1.47 N 的"外力"），还要能让人拉着走（第 ⑧ 步）。关节的力矩有三种量法。A robot needs to know how much force it is using for many reasons: it must stop at once if it bumps into a person (collision detection); to wipe a table it must press down with a set force (force control and impedance control, page 6); it must know what extra it has in its hand (the previous page, step ⑪: an unregistered cup is taken as an "external force" of 1.47 N); and a person must be able to pull it along by hand (step ⑧). There are three ways to measure a joint’s torque.

第一种：从电流算。力矩正比于电流（第 ① 步），乘上减速比和效率，就是关节的力矩，不用加任何传感器：Method one: work it out from the current. Torque is proportional to current (step ①); multiply by the gear ratio and the efficiency and you have the joint torque, with no extra sensor at all:

τ̂J = N η kt I − τ̂f

估出来的关节力矩，等于减速比乘以效率、乘以力矩常数、乘以电流，再减去估出来的摩擦力矩。The estimated joint torque equals the gear ratio times the efficiency times the torque constant times the current, minus the estimated friction torque.

电机出的力矩 ktI 经过减速器被放大 N 倍、打一个效率的折扣，就到了关节；可中间还有摩擦，要减掉。麻烦全在这一项：摩擦随温度、速度、方向、磨损变，静止和刚动起来时又不一样；效率也随负载和速度变，还要看功率往哪边流：负载拖着电机转的时候（往下放、被人推着走），式子变成除以反向效率，同样的电流对应的力矩就不一样了；谐波减速器还有周期性的力矩波动。估错多少，算出来的力矩就差多少。The motor’s torque ktI is multiplied N times by the gearhead and discounted by the efficiency on its way to the joint; but there is friction along the way, and that has to be subtracted. All the trouble is in this term: friction changes with temperature, speed, direction and wear, and is different again at standstill and just as motion starts; the efficiency also changes with load and speed, and depends on which way the power flows: when the load drives the motor (lowering, or being pushed along by someone), the formula divides by the backdrive efficiency instead, so the same current means a different torque; and a strain wave gear also has a periodic torque ripple. Whatever the estimate gets wrong, the computed torque is off by the same amount.

τ̂J
估出来的关节力矩（N·m）；字母上的尖帽表示"估的"the estimated joint torque (N·m); the hat on the letter means "estimated"
N, η, kt, I
减速比、效率、力矩常数、电机电流the gear ratio, the efficiency, the torque constant, the motor current
τ̂f
估出来的摩擦力矩，折算到关节（N·m）the estimated friction torque, reflected to the joint (N·m)

拿升降柱的电机配一个 CSD-20-80 谐波减速器做关节（示意，效率按 76% 算）：每安培是 80 × 0.76 × 0.0404 = 2.456 N·m。可这个减速器的起动力矩折到输出端是 3.84 N·m，反驱力矩是 4.9 N·m，是它额定力矩 22 N·m 的 17–22%（我们算的）。摩擦要是估不准，就有好几 N·m 的力矩"看不见"：在 0.6 m 外，4.9 N·m 就是 8.2 N 的力，相当于手上压着一个不到 1 kg 的东西都察觉不出（我们算的）。Take the lift’s motor with a CSD-20-80 strain wave gear as a joint (illustrative, efficiency taken as 76%): each ampere gives 80 × 0.76 × 0.0404 = 2.456 N·m. But this gear’s starting torque, reflected to the output, is 3.84 N·m, and its backdriving torque is 4.9 N·m: 17–22% of its rated torque of 22 N·m (our arithmetic). If the friction estimate is off, several N·m of torque are "invisible": at 0.6 m out, 4.9 N·m is a force of 8.2 N, which means something of just under 1 kg pressing on the hand would go unnoticed (our arithmetic).

减速比越低，这一招越好用：摩擦小、折算过来的转子惯量小，外面的力几乎原样传到电机上。Mini Cheetah 的关节只有 6 比 1，它就不装力矩传感器，直接用电流控制力矩（Katz，2018）。谐波减速器上就不行了：研究谐波减速器的人写得很直接，减速比低的关节可以用电流估力矩，谐波减速器里的摩擦让这条路走不通（Schuller 等，2024）。The lower the gear ratio, the better this trick works: friction is small, the reflected rotor inertia is small, and forces from outside reach the motor almost unchanged. The Mini Cheetah’s joints are only 6:1, so it has no torque sensors and controls torque directly through the current (Katz, 2018). With a strain wave gear it no longer works. Researchers who study strain wave gears say so plainly: joints with a low gear ratio can estimate torque from the current, but the friction in a strain wave gear blocks this route (Schuller et al., 2024).

第二种：直接量。在力的必经之路上放一个特意做得"有一点点软"的弹性体，比如关节输出端的一个辐条轮，在它上面贴应变片。应变片是一段细细的金属箔，被拉长时电阻变大、被压短时变小，变化的比例正比于应变（单位长度的伸长量）：Method two: measure it directly. In the path the force has to take, put an elastic body that is deliberately made "just a little soft", for example a spoked wheel at the joint’s output, and stick strain gauges on it. A strain gauge is a fine strip of metal foil: its resistance goes up when it is stretched and down when it is squeezed, and the fractional change is proportional to the strain (the extension per unit length):

ΔR / R = GF · εVout / Vex ≈ GF · ε

应变片电阻变化的比例，等于应变系数乘以应变。四片应变片都贴在受力处、接成一个全桥时，输出电压和激励电压之比，约等于应变系数乘以应变。The fractional change in a strain gauge’s resistance equals the gauge factor times the strain. When four strain gauges are all stuck where the load is and wired as a full bridge, the ratio of the output voltage to the excitation voltage is approximately the gauge factor times the strain.

金属被拉长，又长又细，电阻就变大，比例系数叫应变系数 GF，金属箔一般约为 2。可这个变化非常小：1000 µε（千分之一）的应变只让电阻变 0.2%。所以把四片接成一个惠斯通电桥：受拉的两片放在桥的一组对边，受压的两片放在另一组对边（相邻的两臂一拉一压），四片的变化就加在一起，桥的输出就是激励电压的 GF·ε 倍；温度让四片一起变，却在桥里互相抵消。Stretched metal gets longer and thinner, so its resistance goes up; the factor of proportion is called the gauge factor GF, and for metal foil it is usually about 2. But the change is tiny: a strain of 1000 µε (one part in a thousand) changes the resistance by only 0.2%. So the four gauges are wired as a Wheatstone bridge: the two in tension go on one pair of opposite arms of the bridge and the two in compression on the other pair (of any two adjacent arms, one is stretched and one squeezed), so the four changes add up and the bridge output is GF·ε times the excitation voltage; temperature changes all four together, and that cancels out in the bridge.

R, ΔR
应变片的电阻和它的变化（Ω）the strain gauge’s resistance and its change (Ω)
GF
应变系数，金属箔约 2the gauge factor, about 2 for metal foil
ε
应变，常用 µε（百万分之一）做单位the strain, usually given in µε (millionths)
Vex, Vout
加在电桥上的激励电压；电桥输出的电压the excitation voltage applied to the bridge; the bridge’s output voltage

按 GF = 2，全桥在 1000 µε 时输出 2 mV/V，这也是传感器常见的满量程标法（Micro-Measurements 的说明）：用 5 V 激励，满量程只有 10 mV，要放大几百倍再进模数转换器；16 位的转换器分 ±10 mV，每一格 0.31 µV（我们算的）。With GF = 2, a full bridge gives 2 mV/V at 1000 µε, which is also how sensors commonly state their full scale (Micro-Measurements): with 5 V excitation, the full scale is only 10 mV, so it has to be amplified several hundred times before going into an analogue-to-digital converter; a 16-bit converter spread over ±10 mV gives 0.31 µV per count (our arithmetic).

弹性体"软"一点，信号就大，可关节也跟着软；硬一点，信号小、噪声相对大。Schuller 等人总结过装在连杆侧的力矩传感器的代价：占地方、降低关节刚度、走线麻烦。所以也有人把应变片直接贴在谐波减速器的柔轮上：他们测的 Schaeffler RT1-T，规格是 3% 的精度、16 位、每秒估 5000 次（Schuller 等）。Make the elastic body a bit "softer" and the signal is bigger, but the joint gets softer too; make it stiffer and the signal is smaller, with relatively more noise. Schuller et al. sum up the costs of a torque sensor on the link side: it takes up space, lowers the joint’s stiffness and makes the wiring awkward. So some people stick the strain gauges directly onto the strain wave gear’s flexspline: the Schaeffler RT1-T they tested is specified at 3% accuracy, 16 bits and 5000 estimates per second (Schuller et al.).

FR3 的每个关节在连杆一侧都有力矩传感器（规格书：link-side torque sensor in all 7 axes），libfranka 里读到的 tau_J 就是它们，"测得的连杆侧关节力矩传感器信号"；它再用自己的动力学模型减掉重力、惯性那一部分，给出 tau_ext_hat_filtered，"由外力产生的、低通滤波过的关节力矩"（libfranka 文档）。末端也常装一个六维力传感器，量手腕上的三个力和三个力矩，原理一样，只是一块弹性体上贴了好几组应变片。Every joint of the FR3 has a torque sensor on its link side (datasheet: link-side torque sensor in all 7 axes), and the tau_J you read in libfranka is their output: "measured link-side joint torque sensor signals". It then uses its own dynamics model to subtract the gravity and inertia parts and gives tau_ext_hat_filtered, "low-pass filtered torques generated by external forces on the joints" (libfranka docs). A six-axis force/torque sensor is also often fitted at the end of the arm to measure the three forces and three torques at the wrist; the principle is the same, only with several sets of strain gauges on one elastic body.

第三种：量弹簧扭了多少。故意在电机和负载之间串一根刚度已知的弹簧，两端各装一个编码器（第 ⑨ 步），力矩就是刚度乘以两个读数之差，τ = K(θm/N − θ)（K 是弹簧的刚度，θm 是电机转角，θ 是负载的转角，N 是减速比）。这叫串联弹性执行器（SEA）。弹簧软一些，量得细、撞上东西也有缓冲；代价是关节"软"，控制带宽低。Method three: measure how far a spring twists. Deliberately put a spring of known stiffness in series between the motor and the load, with an encoder at each end (step ⑨); the torque is the stiffness times the difference between the two readings, τ = K(θm/N − θ) (K is the spring’s stiffness, θm the motor angle, θ the load angle, N the gear ratio). This is called a series elastic actuator (SEA). A softer spring measures more finely and also cushions impacts; the price is a "soft" joint with a low control bandwidth.

  • 情景（示意）：上面那个谐波关节带着 0.6 m 的小臂摆动，第 2.0 s 碰到一个东西，它往回顶 10 N，也就是 6 N·m。图上标着两个量的地方：① 电流（在减速器前面），② 连杆侧的力矩传感器（在减速器后面）。下面两条 0–4 s 的曲线，一种办法一条：真实的外力矩、估出来的力矩、正负阈值，和一条报警条（红的是在报警）；再下面把碰撞前后（−30 到 +80 ms）放大，① 画虚线，② 画实线。滑块报警阈值（0.5–10 N·m，默认 3.0）。Scenario (illustrative): the strain wave joint described above swings a 0.6 m forearm, and at 2.0 s it hits something that pushes back with 10 N, that is 6 N·m. The picture marks the two places where it is measured: ① the current (before the gearhead) and ② the link-side torque sensor (after the gearhead). Below are two 0–4 s plots, one per method: the true external torque, the estimated torque, the positive and negative thresholds, and an alarm bar (red means alarming); further down, the moments around the collision (−30 to +80 ms) are zoomed in, with ① dashed and ② solid. Slider: Alarm threshold (0.5–10 N·m, default 3.0).
  • 开关摩擦补偿，减速比 N 6 / 80 / 160（减速比低，电流法变好），换一组随机数、重来。小图是一根贴了 ±45° 应变片的轴和它的全桥：拉动传感器上的力矩（0–50 N·m），看应变 → 电阻变化 → 电桥输出（mV/V）→ 放大 250 倍 → 16 位模数转换的计数一路怎么变（应变片、放大器和模数转换都是示意的）。读数：两种办法各在什么时候察觉、碰撞之前误报了几次，能察觉的手上最小的力。摩擦的大小来自规格书（3.84–4.9 N·m），估不准的那部分、噪声和波动都是示意的。The toggle Friction compensation; Gear ratio N 6 / 80 / 160 (the current method improves at a low ratio); New random seed and Restart. The small diagram is a shaft with strain gauges at ±45° and its full bridge: drag Sensor torque (0–50 N·m) and watch how each stage changes along the way: strain → resistance change → bridge output (mV/V) → amplified 250 times → counts of a 16-bit analogue-to-digital converter (the gauges, the amplifier and the conversion are all illustrative). Readouts: when each method notices the collision, how many false alarms it raised before the collision, and the smallest force at the hand it can detect. The size of the friction comes from the datasheet (3.84–4.9 N·m); the part that cannot be estimated accurately, the noise and the ripple are illustrative.

先玩：阈值是 3 N·m：哪种办法先发现碰撞？电流法在碰撞之前就一直在报警，为什么？打开摩擦补偿再看。把减速比换成 6：电流法为什么一下子好用了？换成 160 呢？最后在小图里把力矩拉到 1 N·m，看电桥上是多少微伏。Try first: With the threshold at 3 N·m, which method spots the collision first? The current method is alarming all along, even before the collision: why? Switch on Friction compensation and look again. Set the Gear ratio to 6: why does the current method suddenly work well? And at 160? Finally, in the small diagram, drag the torque to 1 N·m and see how many microvolts appear across the bridge.

这一步的要点：关节力矩有三种量法：从电流算（便宜，但被摩擦和效率的不确定性拖累，减速比越高越不准）；用应变片直接量（准，但关节要多一个弹性体，变软、变复杂）；量一根已知刚度的弹簧扭了多少（SEA）。低减速比的腿常用电流；要细腻力控的协作臂（比如 FR3）在每个关节装力矩传感器。The point of this step: There are three ways to measure joint torque: work it out from the current (cheap, but dragged down by uncertainty in friction and efficiency, and the higher the gear ratio, the less accurate); measure it directly with strain gauges (accurate, but the joint needs an extra elastic body and becomes softer and more complex); or measure how far a spring of known stiffness twists (SEA). Legs with a low gear ratio usually use the current; collaborative arms that need fine force control (such as the FR3) put a torque sensor in every joint.

第 ⑪ 步 · 命令怎么变成电流Step ⑪ · How a command becomes a current

驱动器听谁的Who the drive takes orders from

第 ③ 步说了驱动器的功率部分：功率管、PWM、电流环。它还有另一半：听指令、管状态、保护自己和电机。底盘上的单片机通过 CAN 总线给轮子和升降柱的驱动器发指令（第 15 篇）；驱动器里，三层控制环一层套一层：Step ③ covered the drive’s power side: the power transistors, PWM and the current loop. It has another half too: taking commands, managing its state, and protecting itself and the motor. The microcontroller on the base sends commands over the CAN bus to the drives for the wheels and the lift column (page 15); inside each drive, three control loops are nested one inside another:

  • 位置环：拿目标位置和编码器量到的位置比，算出该用多快的速度去追。很多驱动器是这样三层串着的；EPOS4 不一样：它的位置环是一个 PID，算出来的直接是电流，每秒算 2500 次，速度环只在速度模式里用（EPOS4 产品页，maxon 的应用说明）。Position loop: compares the target position with the position the encoder measures and works out how fast to go to catch up. Many drives cascade the three loops like this; the EPOS4 is different: its position loop is a PID whose output is the current directly, computed 2500 times per second, and the speed loop is used only in the velocity modes (EPOS4 product page, maxon application notes).
  • 速度环：拿目标速度和量到的速度比，算出要多大的电流（也就是多大的力矩）。EPOS4 上也是 2500 次/秒。Speed loop: compares the target speed with the measured speed and works out how much current (that is, how much torque) is needed. On the EPOS4 this also runs 2500 times per second.
  • 电流环：拿目标电流和量到的电流比，调 PWM 的占空比。25,000 次/秒，开关本身 50,000 次/秒。Current loop: compares the target current with the measured current and adjusts the PWM duty cycle. 25,000 times per second; the switching itself happens 50,000 times per second.

越往里越快：这里的"快"是反应快（带宽高），不一定是每秒算的次数多，EPOS4 的位置环和速度环就都是 2500 次/秒。里面一层的带宽得比外面一层高好几倍，外面的才能把它当成"说到做到"（第 5 篇讲过为什么）。指令可以从任何一层进来：给位置、给速度，或者直接给力矩（电流）。驱动器还时刻盯着几样东西。电流它自己限住，不报错：15 A 最多给 3 s，之后只给连续的 5 A；电机的 I²t 估到绕组太热，就把电流限到电机的额定电流（第 ② 步）。母线电压（额定 10–50 V；低于 8.0 V 报欠压，高于 58 V 报过压，硬件参考手册）、跟随误差（实际位置落后目标太多，说明卡住了或者托不住了）、温度，任何一样越界就停机报错；电流冲到 20 A（比如短路）也报过流。The further in, the faster: "fast" here means quick to respond (high bandwidth), not necessarily computed more times per second; the EPOS4’s position and speed loops, for instance, both run 2500 times per second. An inner loop’s bandwidth has to be several times higher than the outer one’s before the outer loop can treat it as "as good as done" (page 5 explained why). A command can come in at any level: a position, a speed, or a torque (current) directly. The drive also keeps a constant watch on a few things. The current it limits by itself, without raising a fault: 15 A for 3 s at most, then only the continuous 5 A; when the motor’s I²t estimate says the winding is too hot, it limits the current to the motor’s nominal current (step ②). The bus voltage (nominal 10–50 V; below 8.0 V it raises an undervoltage fault, above 58 V an overvoltage fault, hardware reference), the following error (the actual position lagging too far behind the target, which means it is stuck or cannot hold the load) and the temperature: if any of these goes out of bounds, the drive stops and raises a fault; a current that shoots up to 20 A (in a short circuit, say) also raises an overcurrent fault.

这么多驱动器、这么多厂家，指令怎么发才统一？工业上常用的一套标准叫 CiA 402，在 CANopen 和 EtherCAT 上都用。它规定了一个状态机：驱动器上电以后不会自己动，要一步一步把它"叫醒"，每一步都要你明确地下命令。With so many drives from so many makers, how can commands be sent in one uniform way? A standard widely used in industry is CiA 402, used over both CANopen and EtherCAT. It defines a state machine: after power-up the drive will not move by itself; you have to "wake it up" step by step, and every step needs an explicit command from you.

0x0006 → 0x0007 → 0x000F0x0040 → 0x0021 → 0x0023 → 0x0027

往控制字里依次写入 6、7、15，驱动器就从"禁止合闸"走到"准备合闸"，再到"已合闸"，最后到"运行"；第二行是这几个状态在状态字里的样子。Write 6, 7 and 15 into the controlword in turn, and the drive goes from "Switch On Disabled" to "Ready to Switch On", then to "Switched On", and finally to "Operation Enabled"; the second line shows what these states look like in the statusword.

这几步对应功率级的几个状态：禁止合闸时功率级关着；已合闸时功率级通上了电，但还不出力；只有在"运行"状态电机才能动（Synapticon 的说明）。分成几步，是为了让"给电机通电"和"松开制动器"都成为一个明确的、有人负责的动作，而不是某个程序一启动就自己发生。出了错，驱动器进入"故障"状态，功率级关掉，必须先发一个"故障复位"，再从头走一遍。These steps correspond to states of the power stage: in Switch On Disabled the power stage is off; in Switched On the power stage is energised but gives no torque yet; only in "Operation Enabled" can the motor move (Synapticon). It is split into steps so that "energising the motor" and "releasing the brake" are each an explicit action that someone is responsible for, rather than something that just happens as soon as some program starts. On an error, the drive goes into the "Fault" state and the power stage is switched off; you must first send a "Fault Reset" and then go through the whole sequence again from the start.

0x6040
控制字（controlword）：上位机写给驱动器的命令，0x0006 叫 Shutdown，0x0007 叫 Switch On，0x000F 叫 Enable Operationthe controlword: the command the host writes to the drive; 0x0006 is called Shutdown, 0x0007 Switch On, 0x000F Enable Operation
0x6041
状态字（statusword）：驱动器报告自己处在哪个状态；只看其中几位（禁止合闸按 0x004F 屏蔽，其余按 0x006F）：0x0040 禁止合闸，0x0021 准备合闸，0x0023 已合闸，0x0027 运行the statusword: the drive reports which state it is in; only some bits count (mask with 0x004F for Switch On Disabled and with 0x006F for the others): 0x0040 is Switch On Disabled, 0x0021 Ready to Switch On, 0x0023 Switched On, 0x0027 Operation Enabled
0x6060
运行模式：1 位置曲线（PP），3 速度曲线（PV），4 力矩曲线（PT），6 回零（HM），8、9、10 是周期同步的位置、速度、力矩（CSP、CSV、CST）the mode of operation: 1 profile position (PP), 3 profile velocity (PV), 4 profile torque (PT), 6 homing (HM); 8, 9 and 10 are cyclic synchronous position, velocity and torque (CSP, CSV, CST)

升降柱用 CSP（8）：底盘的单片机每个周期发一个新的目标位置，驱动器自己跑位置环和电流环。EPOS4 Compact 50/5 CAN 支持 PPM、PVM、回零、CSP、CSV、CST（产品页）。第一版托不住滑台的时候，位置越落越远，跟随误差超限，驱动器进入故障，功率级关掉，滑台就彻底没人管了。The lift column uses CSP (8): the base’s microcontroller sends a new target position every cycle, and the drive runs the position loop and the current loop itself. The EPOS4 Compact 50/5 CAN supports PPM, PVM, homing, CSP, CSV and CST (product page). When design 1 could not hold up the carriage, the position fell further and further behind, the following error went over its limit, the drive went into Fault and switched off its power stage, and the carriage was left completely on its own.

"0x" 开头的数是十六进制。这些编号（0x6040、0x6041、0x6060）是 CiA 402 规定的"对象字典"里的地址，不同厂家的驱动器都一样，所以换一家的驱动器，上位机的程序大体不用改。Numbers starting with "0x" are hexadecimal. These numbers (0x6040, 0x6041, 0x6060) are addresses in the "object dictionary" that CiA 402 defines, and they are the same on drives from different makers, so if you switch to another maker’s drive, the host’s program mostly does not need to change.

FR3 自己的接口是另一种样子，但问的是同样的问题。它的关节驱动藏在它自己的控制系统里，外面的实时电脑通过 FCI 每 1 ms 和它交换一次数据：发关节力矩，或者关节位置、速度（第 15 篇）。它对指令有一张限制表：关节力矩 1–4 号 87 N·m、5–7 号 12 N·m；力矩的变化率不超过 1000 N·m/s，也就是说从 0 升到 87 N·m 至少要 87 ms；关节速度最高 1–4 号 2.62 rad/s、5 号和 7 号 5.26 rad/s、6 号 4.18 rad/s，实际的上限还随关节的位置变（Franka 的控制参数页）。违反了怎样？文档说得很简短："如果必要的条件不满足，运动会被中止。"libfranka 还会报告最近 100 个指令里有多少按时到了（control_command_success_rate）。The FR3’s own interface looks different, but the questions to ask are the same. Its joint drives are hidden inside its own control system; an external real-time computer exchanges data with it through the FCI once every 1 ms, sending joint torques, or joint positions or velocities (page 15). It has a table of limits on the commands: joint torque 87 N·m for joints 1–4 and 12 N·m for joints 5–7; a rate of change of torque of at most 1000 N·m/s, which means going from 0 to 87 N·m takes at least 87 ms; joint speed at most 2.62 rad/s for joints 1–4, 5.26 rad/s for joints 5 and 7, and 4.18 rad/s for joint 6, and the actual limits also change with the joint positions (Franka’s control parameters page). What happens if you break them? The documentation is brief: "If the necessary conditions are not met, the motion will be aborted." libfranka also reports how many of the last 100 commands arrived on time (control_command_success_rate).

  • 左边是 CiA 402 的状态图：未准备好、禁止合闸、准备合闸、已合闸、运行、快速停止、故障响应、故障，每个状态写着它的状态字、功率级（关、通电不出力、出力）和制动器（抱着、松开）；当前状态亮着，从它出去的几条路加粗，标着要发的控制字。下面一排按钮就是控制字：Shutdown 0x0006、Switch On 0x0007、Enable Operation 0x000F、Disable Voltage 0x0000、Quick Stop 0x0002、Disable Operation 0x0007、Fault Reset 0x0080，每个按钮上写着从当前状态发它会到哪（或者"这里无效"）。旁边是主控写的控制字 0x6040 和驱动器报的状态字 0x6041，按位拆开；下面一条日志记着每次状态切换，编号和 CiA 402 一样。On the left is the CiA 402 state diagram: Not Ready to Switch On, Switch On Disabled, Ready to Switch On, Switched On, Operation Enabled, Quick Stop Active, Fault Reaction Active and Fault; each state shows its statusword, the power stage (off, on but no torque, or giving torque) and the brake (on or released). The current state is lit up, and the paths leading out of it are drawn bold and labelled with the controlword to send. The buttons in the row below are the controlwords: Shutdown 0x0006, Switch On 0x0007, Enable Operation 0x000F, Disable Voltage 0x0000, Quick Stop 0x0002, Disable Operation 0x0007 and Fault Reset 0x0080; each button says where sending it from the current state would lead (or "no effect here"). Next to them are the controlword 0x6040 written by the master and the statusword 0x6041 reported by the drive, broken down bit by bit; below, a log records every state transition, numbered as in CiA 402.
  • 右边是升降柱，运行模式 CSP（8），和一张 8 s 的图：目标位置、实际位置和电流（横线是 5、15、20 A）。按抬到顶，主控每 1 ms 发一个新的目标位置，以 0.10 m/s 升到 0.40 m；放下来；开关第一版。控制环画成套在一起的方框：位置环（PID，2.5 kHz，算出来的是电流指令）→ 电流环（25 kHz）→ PWM（50 kHz），速度环（2.5 kHz）在 CSP 里不用、画成灰的。故障按钮：欠压（母线跌到 8.0 V 以下）、跟随误差（第一版举着）、过流（短路，电流冲过 20 A）；重新上电。读数：状态、模式、位置、电流（还有电机的 I²t 用掉了多少）。On the right is the lift column in mode of operation CSP (8), with an 8 s plot: target position, actual position and current (horizontal lines at 5, 15 and 20 A). Press Raise to the top and the master sends a new target position every 1 ms, rising at 0.10 m/s to 0.40 m; Lower; the toggle Design 1. The control loops are drawn as nested boxes: position loop (PID, 2.5 kHz, its output is the current command) → current loop (25 kHz) → PWM (50 kHz); the speed loop (2.5 kHz) is not used in CSP and is greyed out. Fault buttons: Undervoltage (the bus drops below 8.0 V), Following error (design 1) and Overcurrent (a short circuit: the current shoots past 20 A); Power cycle. Readouts: state, mode, position and current (plus how much of the motor’s I²t has been used up).

先玩：先按抬到顶：为什么什么都没发生？按顺序发 Shutdown、Switch On、Enable Operation，每一步功率级和制动器各是什么状态？再按抬到顶，到顶以后托住要多少电流（比第 ⑥ 步按抬算的 1.77 A 少，为什么）？抬到一半按欠压：现在要怎样才能让它重新动起来？最后按跟随误差（第一版举着）：电流被限到 5 A 是报错吗，接下来发生了什么？Try first: First press Raise to the top: why does nothing happen? Send Shutdown, Switch On and Enable Operation in that order: at each step, what are the power stage and the brake doing? Press Raise to the top again: once it is at the top, how much current does it take to hold it there (less than the 1.77 A that step ⑥ worked out for lifting: why)? Halfway up, press Undervoltage: what does it take now to get it moving again? Finally, press Following error (design 1): is the current being limited to 5 A a fault, and what happens next?

    这一步的要点：驱动器里的环一层套一层，越往里越快；它把电流限在允许的范围里，同时盯着电压、跟随误差和温度，越界就停机报错。CiA 402 给驱动器规定了一个状态机：上电不会自己动，要按控制字一步步走到"运行"才出力；出了错进入故障，必须复位、从头再来。FR3 的接口也一样，先看它的限制表和"违反了会怎样"。The point of this step: The loops in a drive are nested one inside another, faster the further in; the drive keeps the current within the allowed range while watching the voltage, the following error and the temperature, and stops with a fault if any of them goes out of bounds. CiA 402 gives drives a state machine: a drive does not move by itself at power-up, and only produces torque once the controlwords have taken it step by step to "Operation Enabled"; on an error it goes into Fault and has to be reset and started again from the beginning. The same goes for the FR3’s interface: look first at its table of limits and at "what happens if you break them".

    第 ⑫ 步 · 不经过任何软件Step ⑫ · No software in the path

    急停：在硬件上把力矩拿走Emergency stop: taking the torque away in hardware

    机器人的程序会卡死，总线会断，控制器会算错。所以急停不能是"给程序发一个停的消息"：它得在那条消息根本发不出去的时候也管用。急停按下去，要直接在硬件上把能让机器动起来的那股劲拿走。标准对它有几条硬规矩（ISO 13850 和 IEC 60204-1）：A robot’s program can hang, the bus can drop out, the controller can miscalculate. So an E-stop cannot be "send the program a message to stop": it has to work even when that message cannot be sent at all. When the E-stop is pressed, the power to move the machine must be taken away directly in hardware. The standards set a few hard rules for it (ISO 13850 and IEC 60204-1):

    • 按钮：红色的蘑菇头，背景尽量是黄色；按下去就卡住（自锁），要转一下或者拔一下才松开；里面的常闭触点是直接断开的：按钮的机械动作强行把触点拉开，触点轻微粘连也拉得开（一个急停按钮的规格书）。常常有两组触点，接成两路。The button: a red mushroom head, on a yellow background where possible; once pressed it stays down (latching) and is released only by a twist or a pull; its normally closed contacts have direct (positive) opening: the button’s mechanical movement forces the contacts apart, so even slightly sticking contacts are pulled open (an E-stop button datasheet). There are often two sets of contacts, wired as two channels.
    • 优先：急停在任何模式下都比别的功能优先；复位急停不能让机器重新动起来，要另外发一个启动命令（Kollmorgen 的说明）。Priority: in every mode the E-stop takes priority over all other functions; resetting the E-stop must not set the machine moving again: a separate start command is needed (Kollmorgen).
    • 停法：IEC 60204-1 定义了三类停止。0 类：立即切断执行机构的动力，不受控地停下；1 类：保持动力，受控地停下来，停住以后再切断；2 类：受控地停下来，动力不切。急停只许用 0 类或 1 类（machinerysafety101）。How to stop: IEC 60204-1 defines three stop categories. Category 0: power to the actuators is cut at once, an uncontrolled stop; Category 1: power is kept while the machine stops under control, and cut once it has stopped; Category 2: a controlled stop with the power left on. An E-stop may only use Category 0 or Category 1 (machinerysafety101).
    • 定位：急停是"补充的保护措施"，不是防护装置本身：它是出了事以后的最后一道，不是让人可以站在机器人旁边的理由（同上）。Role: an E-stop is a "complementary protective measure", not a safeguard in itself: it is the last line of defence once something has gone wrong, not a reason to let people stand next to the robot (same source).

    "切断动力"在硬件上有两种做法。一种是接触器：一个能通断大电流的电磁开关，串在驱动器的电源线上，线圈断电，触点就弹开，驱动器整个没电。另一种是驱动器里的 STO（安全转矩关断）：它封锁功率管的驱动信号，功率管再也不会导通，电机就出不了力矩，自己滑行停下，所以 STO 本身就是 0 类停止（Synapticon 的说明）。STO 只是不让电机出力，并不等于把电断开：ABB 的驱动器手册特意警告，STO 不会断开驱动器主回路和辅助回路的电压，检修前还得另外断电（ABB ACS530 手册）。In hardware there are two ways to "cut the power". One is a contactor: an electromagnetic switch that can make and break large currents, wired in series in the drive’s supply line; when its coil loses power, the contacts spring open and the whole drive is left without power. The other is the STO (safe torque off) inside the drive: it blocks the gate signals of the power transistors so that they can no longer switch on; the motor can then produce no torque and coasts to a stop by itself, so STO on its own is a Category 0 stop (Synapticon). STO only stops the motor from producing force; it is not the same as disconnecting the power: ABB’s drive manual warns specifically that STO does not disconnect the voltage of the drive’s main and auxiliary circuits, so the power must be disconnected separately before any servicing (ABB ACS530 manual).
