    动力没了，谁来托住？对竖直的轴，要么靠制动器，要么靠机械上自己就托得住的东西：自锁的丝杠（第 ⑥ 步，余量往往很小）、锁止销（下面的 FR3）、配重。我们的升降柱用滚珠丝杠，只能靠制动器。机器人上用的大多是弹簧压紧的电磁制动器：断电时弹簧把摩擦片压在轴上，通电时电磁铁把它吸开（Miki Pulley 的说明）。它首先是为"托住"设计的，不是为"刹车"；所以讲究的做法是先让电机受控地停下（安全停止 1，SS1），再抱闸，稍等一下再切断力矩（STO）；其中安全地控制制动器的那一步叫安全抱闸控制 SBC，只该在停住或者很慢的时候用（Synapticon 的说明）。Synapticon 的说明写得很直白：STO 把力矩拿走以后，"没有制动器的竖直轴会不受控地落下来"。这就是升降柱第二次掉下来的原因。With the power gone, who holds it up? A vertical axis relies either on a brake or on something that holds by itself mechanically: a self-locking screw (step ⑥; the margin is often small), locking bolts (the FR3, below), a counterweight. Our lift column has a ball screw, so it can only rely on a brake. Most brakes on robots are spring-applied electromagnetic brakes: with the power off, springs press the friction disc onto the shaft; with the power on, an electromagnet pulls it free (Miki Pulley). Such a brake is designed first of all to "hold", not to "brake"; so the careful way is to bring the motor to a controlled stop first (safe stop 1, SS1), then apply the brake, and after a short wait take the torque away (STO); the step that controls the brake safely is called safe brake control (SBC), and it should only be used at standstill or at very low speed (Synapticon). Synapticon puts it bluntly: once STO has taken the torque away, "a vertical axis without a brake will fall uncontrolled". That is why the lift column came down the second time.

    急停按钮的信号不直接接到电机上，而是先进一个安全继电器。它接两路输入，时刻比较两路是不是一致；它的输出带动接触器，接触器的常闭镜像触点（和主触点机械联动：主触点焊死了，它就一定合不上）再接回来，让它知道主触点真的断开了；复位要人按一下复位按钮，它还要检查一切正常才肯复位。为什么要两路？ISO 13849-1 把安全回路的结构分成几类：第 3 类要求"单个故障不会让安全功能失效"，能查出来的单个故障要查出来（machinerysafety101）。一路出了故障（触点焊死了，或者那一路的两根线被压破短接了），另一路照样能断开，继电器还会发现两路不一致，拒绝复位，直到修好。The E-stop button’s signal does not go straight to the motors; it first goes into a safety relay. The relay takes two input channels and keeps comparing them to see whether they agree; its outputs drive the contactors, and the contactors’ normally closed mirror contacts (mechanically linked to the main contacts: if a main contact has welded, its mirror contact cannot close) are wired back to it, so that it knows the main contacts really have opened; a reset needs someone to press a reset button, and even then the relay resets only after checking that everything is in order. Why two channels? ISO 13849-1 sorts the structures of safety circuits into several categories: Category 3 requires that "a single fault does not lead to the loss of the safety function", and that any single fault that can be detected is detected (machinerysafety101). If one channel fails (a welded contact, or the two wires of that channel crushed and shorted together), the other channel can still open, and the relay also notices that the two channels disagree and refuses to reset until the fault is repaired.

    d = v2 / (2a),  t = v / a

    以减速度 a 从速度 v 停下来，要走 v² 除以 2a 这么远，用 v 除以 a 这么久。Stopping from speed v at deceleration a takes a distance of v² divided by 2a and a time of v divided by a.

    匀减速时速度均匀地降到 0，平均速度是 v/2，乘以时间 v/a 就是距离。停得多快，取决于谁在刹：1 类停止是电机受控地刹，减速度可以设；0 类停止切断了电机，就只剩摩擦、滚动阻力和制动器。这里只算了减速那一段：从按下按钮到真的开始减速，还有继电器、单片机或者制动器的反应时间 tr，这段时间里照原来的速度又走了 v·tr，真正的停止距离是 v·tr + v2/(2a)。Under constant deceleration the speed falls evenly to 0, so the average speed is v/2, and multiplying it by the time v/a gives the distance. How quickly it stops depends on who is braking: in a Category 1 stop the motor brakes under control, and the deceleration can be set; a Category 0 stop cuts off the motor, which leaves only friction, rolling resistance and the brake. This counts only the deceleration itself: between pressing the button and actually starting to slow down there is also the reaction time tr of the relay, the microcontroller or the brake, during which the axis travels another v·tr at its old speed, so the true stopping distance is v·tr + v2/(2a).

    v, a
    开始停时的速度（m/s）；减速度（m/s²）Speed when the stop begins (m/s); deceleration (m/s²)
    d, t
    停下来要走的距离（m）和时间（s）Distance (m) and time (s) needed to stop

    底盘以 0.3 m/s 走：1 类停止，单片机先以 1.0 m/s² 刹（示意），0.30 s、45 mm 停住，然后才切断动力；要是 0 类停止、轮子上又没有制动器，就只剩摩擦和滚动阻力：算上减速器和电机的摩擦（第 ⑧ 步：断电时推它要约 43 N），加上两个转子 31 kg 的折算质量，减速度约 0.33 m/s²，滑约 0.9 s、0.14 m 停住；摩擦估不准，最坏只算滚动阻力 14.7 N，是 0.112 m/s²、2.7 s、0.40 m（我们算的）。升降柱：0 类停止加弹簧制动器，制动器按 20 ms 合上算（示意），这 20 ms 里滑台只往下沉 0.065 mm（转子折算过来的 350 kg 让它沉得很慢）；没有制动器，0.40 m 约 1.6 s 滑到底（我们算的）。The base driving at 0.3 m/s: in a Category 1 stop the microcontroller first brakes at 1.0 m/s² (illustrative), stopping in 0.30 s and 45 mm, and only then is the power cut; in a Category 0 stop with no brakes on the wheels, only friction and rolling resistance are left: counting the friction of the gearheads and motors (step ⑧: pushing it with the power off takes about 43 N) and adding the two rotors’ reflected mass of 31 kg, the deceleration is about 0.33 m/s², and it coasts for about 0.9 s and 0.14 m before it stops; the friction is hard to estimate, so in the worst case, counting only the rolling resistance of 14.7 N, it is 0.112 m/s², 2.7 s and 0.40 m (our arithmetic). The lift column: a Category 0 stop plus the spring-applied brake; taking 20 ms for the brake to close (illustrative), the carriage sinks only 0.065 mm in those 20 ms (the 350 kg reflected from the rotor makes it sink very slowly); without a brake it slides the 0.40 m to the bottom in about 1.6 s (our arithmetic).

    同一个急停，对不同的轴要用不同的停法：会滑、会倒的轴要尽快抱住，跑着的底盘要先受控地刹住再断电。急停回路的设计，就是给每一根轴回答"动力没了以后，谁来让它停、谁来托住它"。One E-stop needs different ways of stopping for different axes: an axis that can slide or fall must be clamped as quickly as possible, while a moving base should first be braked under control and only then lose its power. Designing an E-stop circuit means answering, for every axis: "once the power is gone, who stops it, and who holds it up?"

    FR3 自己就是这样做的。它的急停输入（X3.1）触发的是 1 类停止：先用电机受控地把每个关节停住，停住以后上制动、断电机的电（FR3 硬件手册）；这一路是 PL d、第 3 类（同一本手册）。断电以后，七个关节由机械的锁止销锁住：锁上时"咔"的一声，手臂会往下沉几厘米，停不在原来的位置（硬件手册 §4.8；做急停测试前，手册让先把手臂移到离下面的东西约 200 mm 的地方）。The FR3 itself works exactly this way. Its E-stop input (X3.1) triggers a Category 1 stop: the motors first bring every joint to a controlled stop, and once the joints have stopped, the brakes are applied and the motors’ power is cut (FR3 hardware manual); this path is PL d, Category 3 (same manual). With the power off, the seven joints are held by mechanical locking bolts: they lock with a "click", and the arm sinks a few centimetres, so it does not stay where it was (hardware manual §4.8; before an E-stop test, the manual has you first move the arm to about 200 mm from whatever is below it).

    我们给厨房机器人配的急停回路（示意，按上面的规矩）：急停按钮的两路触点 → 安全继电器 →（1）FR3 的 X3.1，两路，1 类停止；（2）单片机的一个输入，收到就让轮子以 1.0 m/s² 刹车；继电器的延时输出 0.5 s 以后断开轮子驱动器电源线上串着的两个接触器（1 类）；（3）继电器的瞬时输出立即断开升降柱驱动器电源线上串着的两个接触器，同时断掉制动器的电，弹簧抱住电机轴（0 类加制动器）。任何一个接触器焊死了，和它串着的另一个照样能断。滑台停着时，制动器只是托住，抱住之前只沉 0.065 mm；滑台正以 0.10 m/s 往下放时按下急停，这个"托住用"的制动器就得在约 4500 rpm 下当一次刹车：按我们的模型，滑台再走约 4.6 mm 才停，制动器吸收约 2.7 J。要查它的规格书里允许的急停能量和次数；不然就像 FR3 那样用 1 类：驱动器先受控地停住，再抱闸、断电。为什么用接触器而不用驱动器的 STO？因为 EPOS4 的产品页写着 STO："有（未认证）"（产品页）：厂家不保证它的安全等级，我们也拿不出数据把它算进急停回路里（第 ⑭ 步）。The E-stop circuit we gave the kitchen robot (illustrative, following the rules above): the E-stop button’s two contact channels → safety relay → (1) the FR3’s X3.1, two channels, Category 1 stop; (2) an input on the microcontroller, which on receiving it brakes the wheels at 1.0 m/s²; 0.5 s later the relay’s delayed output opens the two contactors in series in the wheel drives’ supply line (Category 1); (3) the relay’s instant output immediately opens the two contactors in series in the lift drive’s supply line and at the same time cuts the brake’s power, so the springs clamp the motor shaft (Category 0 plus brake). If any one contactor welds, the other one in series with it can still break the circuit. With the carriage at rest, the brake only has to hold, and the carriage sinks just 0.065 mm before the brake clamps; if the E-stop is pressed while the carriage is lowering at 0.10 m/s, this brake, made for "holding", has to act once as a stopping brake at about 4500 rpm: in our model the carriage travels about 4.6 mm further before it stops, and the brake absorbs about 2.7 J. Check its datasheet for the emergency-stop energy and the number of such stops it allows; otherwise use Category 1 as the FR3 does: the drive first stops under control, then applies the brake and cuts the power. Why contactors and not the drive’s STO? Because the EPOS4 product page lists STO as "yes (not certified)" (product page): the maker does not guarantee its safety level, and we have no data with which to count it as part of the E-stop circuit (step ⑭).

    • 左边（手机上在上面）是回路图（示意）：急停按钮 S1（红色、黄底、自锁，两组直接断开的常闭触点）→ 安全继电器（两路输入，两个灯显示两路是否一致；受监视的复位按钮；瞬时输出、延时 0.5 s 的输出，和一路给单片机的信号）→ FR3 的 X3.1、升降柱驱动器的两个串联接触器 K3、K4 和制动器线圈（瞬时），轮子驱动器的两个串联接触器 K1、K2（延时），单片机（让轮子以 1.0 m/s² 刹车）；四个接触器的镜像触点串起来接回继电器。On the left (at the top on a phone) is the circuit diagram (illustrative): E-stop button S1 (red on yellow, latching, two sets of normally closed contacts with direct opening) → safety relay (two input channels, with two lamps showing whether the channels agree; a monitored reset button; instant outputs, outputs delayed by 0.5 s, and a signal to the microcontroller) → the FR3’s X3.1, the lift drive’s two series contactors K3, K4 and the brake coil (instant), the wheel drives’ two series contactors K1, K2 (delayed), and the microcontroller (which brakes the wheels at 1.0 m/s²); the mirror contacts of all four contactors are wired in series back to the relay.
    • 右边（手机上在下面）是时间线，从按下前 0.3 s 到按下后 3 s：继电器的瞬时输出、延时输出和升降柱制动器的通断，轮子的速度，滑台的高度，FR3 关节的速度（示意：受控停下，再落进锁止销，手臂往下沉几厘米，不标数）。按钮按下急停（按钮是自锁的，按下以后变成拧开急停）、复位（按钮还按着、继电器锁死了，都复不了位；复位只让继电器重新接通，什么也不会动）、启动（复位以后才管用）、重来。按下时，升降柱：停在顶上（默认）或正在往下放。故障开关：通道 1 触点粘死、只接一路、去掉升降柱制动器、轮子 0 类停止、只用软件停，进程卡住。读数：轮子用了多久、走了多远，升降柱沉了多少（或者滑了多远），手臂怎样了，安全继电器的状态。On the right (at the bottom on a phone) is a timeline from 0.3 s before the press to 3 s after it: on/off traces for the relay’s instant and delayed outputs and for the lift brake, the wheel speed, the carriage height, and the FR3’s joint speed (illustrative: a controlled stop, then dropping into the locking bolts as the arm sinks a few centimetres; no numbers). Buttons: Press E-stop (the E-stop button latches, so once pressed it becomes Twist to release), Reset (no reset is possible while the button is still pressed in or the relay is locked; a reset only switches the relay back on, and nothing moves), Start (works only after a reset), Restart. At the press, the lift is: Parked at the top (default) or While lowering. Fault switches: Channel 1 contact welded, Single channel, Remove the lift brake, Wheels Category 0, Software stop only, process hung. Readouts: how long the wheels took and how far they travelled, how far the lift sank (or slid), what happened to the arm, and the state of the safety relay.

    先玩：先按按下急停，看每根轴怎么停；按复位，为什么不行？拧开急停再复位：机器人动了吗？打开通道 1 触点粘死再按一次急停：还停得住吗，复位时继电器说了什么？再加上只接一路。换成正在往下放再按急停，滑台多走了多少？最后试去掉升降柱制动器、轮子 0 类停止和只用软件停，进程卡住。Try first: Start with Press E-stop and watch how each axis stops; press Reset: why does it not work? Twist to release, then reset: did the robot move? Switch on Channel 1 contact welded and press the E-stop again: does it still stop, and what does the relay say when you reset? Then add Single channel. Switch to While lowering and press the E-stop: how much further does the carriage travel? Finally, try Remove the lift brake, Wheels Category 0 and Software stop only, process hung.

    这一步的要点：急停最后一定要由硬件把力矩拿走，软件卡死了也照样断：常闭、直接断开、自锁的按钮，两路接进会自检的安全继电器，单个故障不失效；只许 0 类或 1 类停止（1 类的减速交给控制器，但到时间由硬件断电），复位不能让机器自己动起来。切断动力（接触器）或者封锁驱动（STO）只是让电机不出力，竖直的轴要靠制动器托住；跑着的轴先受控地刹、再断电。每一根轴都要回答：动力没了，谁让它停，谁托住它。The point of this step: In the end an E-stop must have hardware take the torque away, so that it still cuts out even when the software has hung: a normally closed, direct-opening, latching button, wired as two channels into a self-checking safety relay, so that no single fault defeats it; only Category 0 or Category 1 stops are allowed (in Category 1 the deceleration is left to the controller, but the hardware cuts the power when the time is up), and a reset must not set the machine moving by itself. Cutting the power (contactors) or blocking the drive (STO) only stops the motor producing force; a vertical axis needs a brake to hold it up; a moving axis is braked under control first, and only then loses its power. Every axis needs an answer: when the power is gone, who stops it, and who holds it up?

    第 ⑬ 步 · 每一行是什么意思，哪几行能互相验算Step ⑬ · What each line means, and which lines check each other

    读一份规格书Reading a datasheet

    前面用到的数，大多来自一页规格书：maxon EC 45 flat 70 W、24 V 绕组（产品页，目录页）。现在把它从头读一遍。读规格书，不是把数抄下来，而是弄清楚三件事：每一行在什么条件下量的，哪几行能互相验算，它没写什么。这一页大约 25 行，分成四组：Most of the numbers used so far come from one datasheet page: the maxon EC 45 flat 70 W with the 24 V winding (product page, catalogue page). Now let’s read it from top to bottom. Reading a datasheet does not mean copying the numbers down; it means working out three things: under what conditions each line was measured, which lines can check each other, and what it does not say. The page has about 25 lines, in four groups:

    • 额定电压下的数值：额定电压 24 V；空载转速 5600 rpm、空载电流 270 mA；额定转速 4750 rpm、额定力矩（最大连续力矩）134 mN·m、额定电流（最大连续电流）3.29 A；堵转力矩 1690 mN·m、堵转电流 41.9 A；最高效率 85%。Values at nominal voltage: nominal voltage 24 V; no-load speed 5600 rpm, no-load current 270 mA; nominal speed 4750 rpm, nominal torque (max. continuous torque) 134 mN·m, nominal current (max. continuous current) 3.29 A; stall torque 1690 mN·m, stall current 41.9 A; max. efficiency 85%.
    • 电机的特性：端子电阻（相间）0.573 Ω、端子电感 0.301 mH、力矩常数 40.4 mN·m/A、转速常数 236 rpm/V、转速/力矩梯度 3.35 rpm/mN·m、机械时间常数 6.35 ms、转子惯量 181 g·cm²。Motor characteristics: terminal resistance (phase to phase) 0.573 Ω, terminal inductance 0.301 mH, torque constant 40.4 mN·m/A, speed constant 236 rpm/V, speed/torque gradient 3.35 rpm/mN·m, mechanical time constant 6.35 ms, rotor inertia 181 g·cm².
    • 热：外壳到环境的热阻 2.55 K/W、绕组到外壳 6.64 K/W；绕组的热时间常数 43.1 s、电机 127 s；环境温度 −40 到 +100 °C；绕组最高 +125 °C。Thermal data: thermal resistance housing to ambient 2.55 K/W, winding to housing 6.64 K/W; thermal time constant of the winding 43.1 s, of the motor 127 s; ambient temperature −40 to +100 °C; max. winding temperature +125 °C.
    • 机械和其他：最高转速 10000 rpm、8 对磁极、3 相、重 150 g。Mechanical and other data: max. speed 10000 rpm, 8 pole pairs, 3 phases, weight 150 g.

    第二组是"原料"，第一组的大部分能从它算出来。这就是验算的办法：The second group is the "raw material": most of the first group can be calculated from it. This is how to check them:

    ke = 1/kn ≈ kt,  Is = V/R,  τs = kt IsΔω/Δτ = R/kt2,  τmech = R Jm / kt2

    反电动势常数是转速常数的倒数，应该约等于力矩常数；堵转电流是电压除以电阻，堵转力矩是力矩常数乘以堵转电流；转速/力矩梯度（按 rad/s 算）是电阻除以力矩常数的平方；机械时间常数是电阻乘以转子惯量、除以力矩常数的平方。The back-EMF constant is the inverse of the speed constant and should be about equal to the torque constant; the stall current is the voltage divided by the resistance, and the stall torque is the torque constant times the stall current; the speed/torque gradient (in rad/s) is the resistance divided by the square of the torque constant; the mechanical time constant is the resistance times the rotor inertia, divided by the square of the torque constant.

    这些都是第 ① 步那条直线的推论。机械时间常数是"空载时从静止加速到空载转速的 63% 要多久"（maxon 的定义）：用直线算，电机就像一个一阶系统，时间常数正好是 RJm/kt2。几行对得上，说明你读懂了它们的意思和单位；对不上，要么是条件不同，要么是你看错了行。All of these follow from the straight line of step ①. The mechanical time constant is "how long it takes, with no load, to accelerate from rest to 63% of the no-load speed" (maxon’s definition): computed from the line, the motor behaves like a first-order system whose time constant is exactly RJm/kt2. If the lines agree, you have understood what they mean and their units; if they do not, either the conditions differ or you have read the wrong line.

    kn
    转速常数（rpm/V），换成国际单位 rad/s 每 V 再取倒数就是 keSpeed constant (rpm/V); converted to SI units, rad/s per V, and inverted, it gives ke
    Is, τs
    堵转电流、堵转力矩Stall current, stall torque
    Δω/Δτ
    转速/力矩梯度：力矩每多 1 N·m，转速掉多少 rad/s；规格书按 rpm/mN·m 给，要乘 60/2π、再除以 1000 才对得上Speed/torque gradient: how many rad/s the speed drops for each extra 1 N·m of torque; the datasheet gives it in rpm/mN·m, so multiply by 60/2π and then divide by 1000 to make the two match
    Jm
    转子惯量，181 g·cm² = 1.81 × 10−5 kg·m²Rotor inertia, 181 g·cm² = 1.81 × 10−5 kg·m²
    τmech
    机械时间常数（s）Mechanical time constant (s)

    逐行验算（我们算的）：ke = 0.0405 V·s/rad，kt = 0.0404 N·m/A ✓；24/0.573 = 41.9 A ✓；0.0404 × 41.9 = 1.69 N·m ✓；0.573/0.0404² = 351 rad/s 每 N·m = 3.35 rpm/mN·m ✓；0.573 × 1.81 × 10−5/0.0404² = 6.35 ms ✓；理想空载转速 24 × 236 = 5664 rpm，表上 5600，差 1.1%：一多半是摩擦（空载电流 0.27 A，模型给 5627 rpm，第 ① 步），剩下的 0.5% 表上没有交代（表上本来就是标称值）✓；额定力矩 ≈ 0.0404 × 3.29 = 132.9 mN·m，表上 134 ✓。Checking line by line (our arithmetic): ke = 0.0405 V·s/rad, kt = 0.0404 N·m/A ✓; 24/0.573 = 41.9 A ✓; 0.0404 × 41.9 = 1.69 N·m ✓; 0.573/0.0404² = 351 rad/s per N·m = 3.35 rpm/mN·m ✓; 0.573 × 1.81 × 10−5/0.0404² = 6.35 ms ✓; the ideal no-load speed is 24 × 236 = 5664 rpm, the table says 5600, a difference of 1.1%: more than half of it is friction (no-load current 0.27 A; the model gives 5627 rpm, step ①), and the remaining 0.5% the table does not explain (its values are nominal anyway) ✓; nominal torque ≈ 0.0404 × 3.29 = 132.9 mN·m, the table says 134 ✓.

    有一行对不上：额定转速。按冷态的直线，134 mN·m 时该转 5151 rpm，表上写 4750 rpm。这一页没说额定点是在什么温度下定的；绕组热了电阻变大，线会变陡（第 ① 步的交互里能看到），可只算铜损也降不到 4750。对不上的时候，别自己编一个解释塞给它：记下来，用表上的数，必要时问厂家。One line does not fit: the nominal speed. On the cold line the motor should turn at 5151 rpm at 134 mN·m; the table says 4750 rpm. The page does not say at what temperature the nominal point was set; as the winding heats up, its resistance rises and the line gets steeper (you can see this in the interactive of step ①), but copper loss alone does not bring it down to 4750. When something does not fit, don’t make up an explanation and pin it on the sheet: note it down, use the table’s number, and ask the maker if you need to.

    规格书最重要的信息，常常在注释里。这一页的目录版写着："表中的数值是标称值"；堵转力矩的脚注："计算不包括饱和效应"；连续工作区的说明："按第 17、18 行的热阻，在 25 °C 环境里连续工作，绕组会到达最高允许温度，这就是热的极限"；短时工作区："电机可以短时过载（可以反复）"（目录页）。把它们翻译成大白话：表上的数是这一型号的典型值，每一台会有出入；堵转力矩是理论上的，实际电流那么大时磁路早饱和了；额定值只在 25 °C、按它测热阻时的那种散热条件下成立；短时过载可以，多长算"短"，要按热时间常数自己算（第 ② 步）。还有一行不起眼的：产品页上这款电机标着 NRND，"不推荐用于新设计"。它还能买，但新做一台机器人，最好换一款在产的型号（产品页没有指明替代型号，要问厂家）；读法完全一样。The most important information in a datasheet is often in the notes. The catalogue version of this page says: "the values in the table are nominal"; the footnote on stall torque: "the calculation does not include saturation effects"; the note on the continuous operation range: "with the thermal resistances of lines 17 and 18, continuous operation at 25 °C ambient brings the winding to its maximum permissible temperature: this is the thermal limit"; on the short-term operation range: "the motor may be briefly overloaded (recurring)" (catalogue page). In plain words: the numbers in the table are typical values for this model, and each unit will differ a little; the stall torque is theoretical, because at such a large current the magnetic circuit has long since saturated; the nominal values hold only at 25 °C and with the cooling under which the thermal resistances were measured; brief overloads are fine, but how long counts as "brief" you have to work out yourself from the thermal time constants (step ②). And one inconspicuous line: on the product page this motor is marked NRND, "not recommended for new designs". It can still be bought, but for a new robot it is better to switch to a model in production (the product page names no successor, so ask the maker); you read its datasheet in exactly the same way.

    减速器的规格书要多看两件事。GP 42 C（规格书）：输出力矩分"最大连续"和"最大间歇"两种，比如 74 比 1 那款是 15 和 22 N·m（产品页）；效率是"最高效率"，轻载、低温时会更低；回差是"空载平均"；输入转速最高连续 8000 rpm。把它和电机放在一起看，才知道谁是最弱的一环：电机的额定力矩到轮子上是 7.14 N·m，减速器的连续 15 N·m 绰绰有余；可驱动器的 15 A 峰值到轮子上是 32.3 N·m，超过了减速器的间歇 22 N·m。电机带着轮子走时，电流上限设在 22/(74 × 0.72 × 0.0404) = 10.2 A 就够；可电机刹车时，功率倒着流，减速器的摩擦反过来加在输出端，同样 10.2 A 到轮子上是 42 N·m。要刹车时也不超，得把上限设到 22 × 0.72/(74 × 0.0404) = 5.3 A（反向效率也按 72% 算，示意）；平常起步、刹车只要 1.5 A 左右，5.3 A 绰绰有余（我们算的）。CSD-20-80（产品页）：力矩有四个："额定力矩"22 N·m（L10，是按寿命定的），"平均力矩上限"33、"反复峰值上限"51、"瞬时峰值上限"76 N·m；"起动力矩"4.8 N·cm 是在输入端量的（换到输出端要乘 80），单位是 N·cm；"反驱力矩"4.9 N·m 是在输出端量的，单位是 N·m。两个数看上去差不多，其实一个要先乘 80、再除以 100 才能和另一个比，一不小心就看反（第 ⑦ 步）。With a gearhead’s datasheet there are two more things to look at. GP 42 C (datasheet): the output torque comes as "max. continuous" and "max. intermittent", for example 15 and 22 N·m for the 74:1 version (product page); the efficiency is the "max. efficiency", and is lower at light load or low temperature; the backlash is "average, no load"; the max. continuous input speed is 8000 rpm. Only by putting it next to the motor do you see which is the weakest link: the motor’s nominal torque comes to 7.14 N·m at the wheel, well within the gearhead’s continuous 15 N·m; but the drive’s 15 A peak comes to 32.3 N·m at the wheel, above the gearhead’s intermittent 22 N·m. While the motor drives the wheel, a current limit of 22/(74 × 0.72 × 0.0404) = 10.2 A is enough; but when the motor brakes, the power flows backwards and the gearhead’s friction now adds to the torque at the output, so the same 10.2 A gives 42 N·m at the wheel. To stay within the limit when braking too, the limit has to be set to 22 × 0.72/(74 × 0.0404) = 5.3 A (taking the backdrive efficiency as 72% as well, illustrative); ordinary starting and braking need only about 1.5 A, so 5.3 A is plenty (our arithmetic). CSD-20-80 (product page): there are four torques: "rated torque" 22 N·m (L10, set by service life), "limit for average torque" 33, "limit for repeated peak torque" 51 and "limit for momentary peak torque" 76 N·m; the "starting torque" of 4.8 N·cm is measured at the input (multiply by 80 for the output), in N·cm; the "backdriving torque" of 4.9 N·m is measured at the output, in N·m. The two numbers look about the same, but one has to be multiplied by 80 and then divided by 100 before it can be compared with the other, and it is easy to read them the wrong way round (step ⑦).

    • 三个标签页：电机 EC 45 flat 70 W（24 V）、行星减速器 GP 42 C、谐波 CSD-20-80，每页是一张照着规格书排的表（电机那页标着规格书的行号）。点任意一行（手机上卡片就在那一行下面，宽屏在旁边）：它是什么意思、在什么条件下量的、当场验算、用到了哪几行（点一下就跳过去）、有什么陷阱、在我们的机器人上是多少。每行前面一个标记：✓ 对得上，≈ 差一点、知道为什么，? 这一页没写，! 小心。每页还有一张图：电机是只用规格书上的数画的力矩–转速线，减速器是每一级的力矩，谐波是扭转角随力矩，标着四个力矩上限。Three tabs: Motor EC 45 flat 70 W (24 V), Planetary gearhead GP 42 C and Strain wave gear CSD-20-80, each a table laid out like the datasheet (the motor tab carries the datasheet’s line numbers). Tap any line (on a phone its card opens right below that line, on a wide screen beside the table) to see what it means, under what conditions it was measured, a check worked out on the spot, which lines it uses (tap one to jump there), any traps, and what it comes to on our robot. Each line starts with a mark: ✓ checks out, ≈ slightly off for a known reason, ? not on this page, ! careful. Each tab also has a chart: for the motor, the torque–speed line drawn from the datasheet’s numbers only; for the gearhead, the torque at each stage; for the strain wave gear, the twist angle against torque, with the four torque limits marked.
    • 减速器页把它和电机、驱动器放在一起，算出谁是最弱的一环和驱动器的电流上限（带着轮子走 10.2 A，算上刹车 5.3 A）；谐波页把起动力矩和反驱力矩换到同一端、同一单位。最下面七个陷阱按钮（比如"堵转力矩不是能用的力矩""N·cm 和 N·m""产品状态 NRND"），点一个就跳到它那一行。The gearhead tab puts it together with the motor and the drive and works out which is the weakest link and the drive’s current limit (10.2 A for driving the wheels, 5.3 A once braking is counted too); the strain wave tab moves the starting torque and the backdriving torque to the same side and the same unit. At the bottom, seven Trap buttons (such as "Stall torque is not usable torque", "N·cm and N·m", "Product status NRND") each jump to their line when tapped.

    先玩：在电机页点堵转力矩：它是怎么算出来的，为什么不能用？再点额定转速：哪一步对不上？在减速器页看 74 比 1：电机、减速器、驱动器，谁先到上限？在谐波页把起动力矩换到输出端，和反驱力矩比一比。Try first: On the motor tab, tap Stall torque: how is it calculated, and why can’t you use it? Then tap Nominal speed: which step does not fit? On the gearhead tab, look at 74:1: motor, gearhead or drive, which reaches its limit first? On the strain wave tab, move the starting torque to the output and compare it with the backdriving torque.

    这一步的要点：读规格书要弄清每一行的条件（电压、温度、散热、寿命、空载还是带载、输入端还是输出端）；用公式把能互相验算的几行串起来，对上了才算读懂；注释里写着最要紧的限制；对不上的地方照实记下，别替它编理由。还要把相邻的几个零件的规格书放在一起看，找出最弱的一环。The point of this step: To read a datasheet, find out the conditions behind each line (voltage, temperature, cooling, service life, no load or under load, input side or output side); link the lines that can check each other with formulas, and only once they agree have you understood them; the notes hold the most important limits; where something does not fit, record it as it is and don’t invent reasons for it. And read the datasheets of neighbouring parts side by side to find the weakest link.

    第 ⑭ 步 · 两个东西接在一起之前Step ⑭ · Before you connect two things

    读接口说明Reading an interface description

    规格书说一个零件自己有多大本事；接口说明说它怎么和别的东西接：接什么电、给多大电流、收什么信号、说什么协议、出了事怎么办。机器人上的毛病，很多出在两个都没问题的零件之间。拿升降柱的驱动器 EPOS4 Compact 50/5 CAN 来读（产品页），它的接口分成这几组：A datasheet tells you what a part can do on its own; an interface description tells you how it connects to other things: what supply it takes, how much current it gives, what signals it accepts, what protocol it speaks, and what it does when something goes wrong. Many of a robot’s problems lie between two parts that are each fine on their own. Let’s read the one for the lift’s drive, the EPOS4 Compact 50/5 CAN (product page). Its interface falls into these groups:

    • 电源：功率电源 10–50 V，逻辑电源 10–50 V。Power: power supply 10–50 V, logic supply 10–50 V.
    • 电机：三相输出，最高输出电压是电源电压的 0.9 倍；连续 5 A，最大 15 A，最长 3 s。Motor: three-phase output, with a maximum output voltage of 0.9 times the supply voltage; 5 A continuous, 15 A maximum for at most 3 s.
    • 反馈：霍尔传感器；增量式编码器（两路单端，或者两路、三路差分）；SSI 绝对式编码器。Feedback: Hall sensors; incremental encoders (two channels single-ended, or two or three channels differential); SSI absolute encoders.
    • 数字输入、输出：8 个输入（限位开关、参考开关、通用、探针），3 个输出（抱闸、通用）；另有 2 个模拟输入（12 位，±10 V）和 2 个模拟输出。Digital inputs and outputs: 8 inputs (limit switches, reference switch, general purpose, touch probe) and 3 outputs (holding brake, general purpose); plus 2 analogue inputs (12-bit, ±10 V) and 2 analogue outputs.
    • 安全：STO，"有（未认证）"。Safety: STO, "yes (not certified)".
    • 通信和模式：CAN（CANopen 从站）、USB、RS232；位置曲线、速度曲线、回零、CSP、CSV、CST 模式；电流环 25 kHz，速度环、位置环 2.5 kHz，PWM 50 kHz。Communication and modes: CAN (CANopen slave), USB, RS232; profile position, profile velocity, homing, CSP, CSV and CST modes; current loop 25 kHz, speed and position loops 2.5 kHz, PWM 50 kHz.

    读接口说明的办法，是拿机器人上真实要接的每一样东西，一条一条去对：To read an interface description, take each thing on the robot that will really be connected to it, and check it line by line:

    • 电池 20.0–29.2 V，在 10–50 V 里：✓。可电机最多只拿到 0.9 倍：电池快空时 18.0 V，升降柱最快 0.0946 m/s，比要的慢 5%（第 ③ 步）。△Battery 20.0–29.2 V, within 10–50 V: ✓. But the motor gets at most 0.9 times that: 18.0 V when the battery is nearly empty, so the lift tops out at 0.0946 m/s, 5% slower than required (step ③). △
    • 连续电流：第二版托住按 1.77 A 算（偏保守），一个循环的均方根 1.41 A，都在 5 A 以内；可驱动器的 5 A 比电机的额定 3.29 A 大，要在驱动器里填上电机的额定电流和热时间常数，让它替电机做 I²t 保护（第 ② 步），所以这一行打 !。第一版抬要 11.2 A，托住最少也要 8.0 A：✗。Continuous current: design 2’s holding current, taken conservatively as 1.77 A, and the 1.41 A RMS over a cycle are both within 5 A. But the drive’s 5 A is more than the motor’s nominal 3.29 A, so the motor’s nominal current and thermal time constant must be entered in the drive to let it do the I²t protection for the motor (step ②); that is why this row gets a !. Design 1 needs 11.2 A to raise and at least 8.0 A to hold: ✗.
    • 轮子：同样的驱动器接轮子的电机，电流上限要按减速器的间歇力矩来设：只看带着轮子走是 10.2 A，算上刹车是 5.3 A（第 ⑬ 步）✓。Wheel: with the same drive on a wheel motor, set the current limit from the gearhead’s intermittent torque: 10.2 A if you only look at driving the wheel, 5.3 A once braking is included (step ⑬) ✓.
    • 反馈：电机自带霍尔，再加一个差分的增量式编码器 ✓；上电回零用一个参考开关接到数字输入上，用回零模式 ✓。Feedback: the motor’s built-in Hall sensors plus a differential incremental encoder ✓; for homing at power-up, a reference switch on a digital input and the homing mode ✓.
    • 制动器：有"抱闸"输出 ✓，可这一页没写它能带多大电流、什么电压。制动器线圈要多少电流，这一页上查不到：?，要去翻硬件手册，或者加一个继电器。Brake: there is a "holding brake" output ✓, but this page does not say how much current it can carry, or at what voltage. How much current the brake coil needs cannot be found on this page: ?, so look in the hardware manual, or add a relay.
    • 安全：STO 有，但"未认证"。没有认证，厂家就不保证它能达到哪个安全等级，我们也拿不出数据把它算进急停回路的 PL 里；稳妥的做法是用接触器切断驱动器的电源（第 ⑫ 步）✓。Safety: STO is there, but "not certified". Without certification the manufacturer does not guarantee that it reaches any particular safety level, and we have no data with which to count it in the PL of the E-stop circuit; the safe way is to cut the drive’s power with contactors (step ⑫) ✓.
    • 通信：CANopen，支持 CSP，和底盘上用 CAN 总线连单片机的做法对得上（第 15 篇）✓。Communication: CANopen with CSP, which matches the base’s use of a CAN bus to the microcontroller (page 15) ✓.

    FR3 的接口说明是另一种，但问题一样。它的急停输入 X3.1 触发 1 类停止，外接的使能装置接 X4（规格书，硬件手册）；控制柜吃 100–240 V 交流电，约 80 W；FCI 每 1 ms 交换一次数据；指令有限制：力矩 87 N·m（1–4 号关节）、12 N·m（5–7 号），力矩变化率 1000 N·m/s，关节速度 2.62 rad/s（1–4 号）、5.26 rad/s（5、7 号）、4.18 rad/s（6 号），"如果必要的条件不满足，运动会被中止"（控制参数页）。比如要让一个关节的力矩指令从 0 升到 40 N·m，至少要用 40 ms；10 ms 就升上去，FR3 会中止运动。The FR3’s interface description is a different kind, but the questions are the same. Its E-stop input X3.1 triggers a Category 1 stop, and an external enabling device connects to X4 (datasheet, hardware manual); the control box takes 100–240 V AC, about 80 W; FCI exchanges data every 1 ms; and commands have limits: torque 87 N·m (joints 1–4) and 12 N·m (joints 5–7), torque rate 1000 N·m/s, joint speed 2.62 rad/s (joints 1–4), 5.26 rad/s (joints 5 and 7) and 4.18 rad/s (joint 6); "if necessary conditions are not met, the motion will be aborted" (Franka’s control parameters page). For example, ramping one joint’s torque command from 0 to 40 N·m takes at least 40 ms; ramp it up in 10 ms and the FR3 aborts the motion.

    不管接的是什么，读任何接口说明都可以问这几个问题：Whatever you are connecting, you can ask these questions of any interface description:

    1. 每个量的单位和参考点是什么（N·m 还是千分之一的额定力矩，输入端还是输出端，相电压还是线电压）？What are the units and reference point of each quantity (N·m or thousandths of the rated torque, input side or output side, phase voltage or line voltage)?
    2. 多快：多久要发一次，多久会回一次？How fast: how often must you send, and how often does it reply?
    3. 范围：电压、电流、温度、速度、变化率，哪些是连续的、哪些是短时的？Ranges: voltage, current, temperature, speed, rate of change: which are continuous, and which are only brief?
    4. 越界或者超时会怎样：降额、报警、停机、中止，还是什么都不做？What happens out of range or on a timeout: does it derate, raise an alarm, shut down, abort, or do nothing at all?
    5. 状态：上电以后它在什么状态，要怎样才肯出力，出了错怎么恢复？State: what state is it in after power-up, what does it take before it will produce any force, and how does it recover from an error?
    6. 什么是认证过的：哪些功能能算进安全回路，哪些只是"有"？What is certified: which functions can be counted in the safety circuit, and which are merely "present"?
    7. 这一页没写什么：写着"有"却没写多大的（比如抱闸输出的电流），去哪儿查？What this page leaves out: for anything marked "present" with no rating given (such as the brake output’s current), where do you look it up?
    • 左边是 EPOS4 Compact 50/5 CAN 的接口，按组画成十块：电源、电机、反馈、数字输入、数字输出、模拟、安全、通信、模式、控制环。右边是一张清单，对一对：升降柱·第二版（默认）、升降柱·第一版或轮子，每一行按真实的数打一个标记：✓ 合适，! 要设一下，△ 差一点，✗ 不行，? 这一页没写，– 用不到。点一行，左边对应的那一组亮起来，下面说明理由和出处；点一组，清单里相关的几行亮起来。On the left is the interface of the EPOS4 Compact 50/5 CAN, drawn as ten blocks by group: power, motor, feedback, digital inputs, digital outputs, analogue, safety, communication, modes and control loops. On the right is a checklist, Against: Lift, design 2 (default), Lift, design 1 or Wheel; each row gets a mark from the real numbers: ✓ fits, ! needs a setting, △ falls a little short, ✗ fails, ? not on this page, – not used. Tap a row and the matching group on the left lights up, with the reason and the source below; tap a group and the related rows in the checklist light up.
    • 下面是 FR3 的接口：X3.1、X4、FCI 1 kHz、电源和限制表。关节：关节 1–4（87 N·m）（默认）或关节 5–7（12 N·m）；滑块力矩指令从 0 升到 40 N·m 用多久（1–200 ms，默认 100）：每 1 ms 一步，超了限制就显示"中止"。最后是"读任何接口都问"的七个问题，每个都写着 EPOS4 和 FR3 的答案。Below is the FR3’s interface: X3.1, X4, FCI 1 kHz, power and a table of limits. Joint: Joints 1–4 (87 N·m) (default) or Joints 5–7 (12 N·m); slider Ramp a 40 N·m torque command over t ms (1–200 ms, default 100): one step every 1 ms, and "aborted" appears once a limit is exceeded. Last come the seven questions under "Ask of any interface", each with the answers for the EPOS4 and the FR3.

    先玩：先看升降柱·第二版：哪一行是 !，哪一行是 △，哪一行是 ?，为什么？换到第一版，多了几个 ✗？换到轮子，电流上限为什么有两个数？在 FR3 那一栏，把力矩指令的上升时间从 100 ms 往下拉，到多少会被中止？换成关节 5–7：为什么怎么拉都会中止？Try first: Start with Lift, design 2: which row is !, which is △, which is ?, and why? Switch to Lift, design 1: how many more ✗ are there? Switch to Wheel: why does the current limit have two numbers? In the FR3 section, drag the torque command’s ramp time down from 100 ms: at what point is it aborted? Switch to Joints 5–7: why is it aborted however far you drag?

    这一步的要点：接口说明讲一个零件怎么和别的东西接：电、信号、协议、状态、越界以后怎样。读它的办法，是拿机器人上真要接的每一样东西一条条对，算出余量；特别要找"有，但没认证"和"有，但没写多大"的地方。The point of this step: An interface description tells you how a part connects to other things: power, signals, protocol, state, and what happens out of range. To read one, check it line by line against everything on the robot that will really be connected, and work out the margins; look especially for places marked "present but not certified" and "present but no rating given".

    第 ⑮ 步 · 从需求一路选到零件Step ⑮ · From requirements all the way to parts

    搭起来：给升降柱选型Putting it together: sizing the lift

    把前面十四步串起来，重新给升降柱选一遍。顺序很重要：先从负载往回推，算出每一级要什么，再从电池往前查，看每一级给不给得了。第一版错就错在只做了一步：拿"要的力矩"去比"堵转力矩"。Now string the fourteen steps so far together and size the lift again. The order matters: first work backwards from the load to find what each stage needs, then check forwards from the battery to see whether each stage can deliver it. Design 1 went wrong by doing only one step: comparing "the torque needed" with "the stall torque".

    1. 要求（示意）：滑台连手臂 26 kg，255.1 N；行程 0.40 m；速度 0.10 m/s，加速度 0.5 m/s²；在顶上能一直停着；断电、急停时不能掉；电池 20.0–29.2 V。Requirements (illustrative): carriage plus arm 26 kg, 255.1 N; stroke 0.40 m; speed 0.10 m/s, acceleration 0.5 m/s²; able to stay parked at the top indefinitely; must not drop on power loss or E-stop; battery 20.0–29.2 V.
    2. 丝杠：滚珠丝杠，导程 5 mm，正向 90%、反向 80%。托住按往上推算，丝杠上 0.2255 N·m（偏保守：螺纹的摩擦帮着托，只要不往下滑，0.1624 N·m 就够）；0.10 m/s 时丝杠转 1200 rpm（第 ⑥ 步）。Screw: ball screw, 5 mm lead, 90% forward and 80% backdrive efficiency. Holding is counted as pushing up: 0.2255 N·m at the screw (conservative: the thread’s friction helps to hold, and 0.1624 N·m is enough just to keep it from sliding down); at 0.10 m/s the screw turns at 1200 rpm (step ⑥).
    3. 减速比：电机最好在 4000–5000 rpm 附近干活，一级 3.5 比 1 的行星减速器，电机 4200 rpm；托住时电机上按 0.0716 N·m、1.77 A 算（偏保守）。转子折算到滑台是 350 kg，加速时光转子就要 0.0398 N·m；加速段电机要出 0.1196 N·m，再加上电机自己的摩擦 0.0109 N·m，电流 3.23 A（第 ④ 步）。Gear ratio: the motor works best at around 4000–5000 rpm, so a single-stage 3.5:1 planetary gearhead puts the motor at 4200 rpm; for holding, count 0.0716 N·m and 1.77 A at the motor (conservative). Reflected to the carriage, the rotor is 350 kg, and accelerating the rotor alone takes 0.0398 N·m; while accelerating, the motor must give 0.1196 N·m, plus its own friction of 0.0109 N·m, which takes 3.23 A (step ④).
    4. 电机的热：按一个循环（加速、抬 4 s、在顶上停 30 s、放下、空闲 20 s）算，均方根电流 1.41 A，不到额定 3.29 A 的一半；一直托着，绕组也只有 42.6 °C（第 ② 步）。Motor heat: over one cycle (accelerate, lift for 4 s, hold at the top for 30 s, lower, idle for 20 s) the RMS current is 1.41 A, less than half the nominal 3.29 A; even holding all the time, the winding reaches only 42.6 °C (step ②).
    5. 电机的速度：要 4200 rpm、18.97 V。满电时驱动器最多给 26.28 V ✓；电池快空时 18.0 V，只能到 3972 rpm，滑台慢 5%，可以接受 △（第 ③ 步）。Motor speed: it needs 4200 rpm and 18.97 V. With a full battery the drive gives up to 26.28 V ✓; with the battery nearly empty it gives 18.0 V, enough for only 3972 rpm, so the carriage is 5% slower, which is acceptable △ (step ③).
    6. 减速器：输出端连续 3.0 N·m、间歇 4.5 N·m，我们只要 0.226 N·m，余量很大；输入转速 4200 rpm 在 8000 rpm 以内 ✓（第 ⑬ 步）。Gearhead: 3.0 N·m continuous and 4.5 N·m intermittent at the output, and we need only 0.226 N·m, a large margin; the input speed of 4200 rpm is within 8000 rpm ✓ (step ⑬).
    7. 驱动器：最大 3.23 A，连续 5 A、峰值 15 A 都够 ✓；在驱动器里填上电机的额定电流 3.29 A 和热时间常数 43.1 s（第 ②、⑭ 步）。Drive: at most 3.23 A, so 5 A continuous and 15 A peak are both enough ✓; enter the motor’s nominal current of 3.29 A and its thermal time constant of 43.1 s in the drive (steps ② and ⑭).
    8. 电池：抬的时候母线多出 40.8 W、1.59 A，对 9.8 A 的平常负载是小数；放下时约 13 W 往回流，母线上别的负载（约 240 W）当场就把它用掉了；只有回来的比别的负载用的还多时，才要制动电阻兜底（第 ③ 步）。Battery: lifting adds 40.8 W, 1.59 A to the bus, small next to the usual 9.8 A load; lowering sends about 13 W back, and the other loads on the bus (about 240 W) use it up on the spot; only when more comes back than the other loads use is a braking resistor needed as a backstop (step ③).
    9. 断电和急停：滚珠丝杠能反驱，断电时电机轴上有 0.0418 N·m 想让它倒转，电机的摩擦只有 0.0109 N·m，所以必须加制动器。算制动器不指望摩擦帮忙：电机轴上是 0.058 N·m，选 0.24 N·m 的弹簧制动器，是它的 4.1 倍。急停时 0 类停止加制动器：停着时，制动器抱住之前滑台只沉 0.065 mm；要是正以 0.10 m/s 往下放，还要再走约 4.6 mm 才停住（我们算的），而且要确认这个"以托住为主"的制动器允许这样刹车，不然就用 1 类停止，先受控地停住再抱闸（第 ⑥、⑫ 步）。Power loss and E-stop: the ball screw is backdrivable, and with the power off 0.0418 N·m at the motor shaft tries to turn it backwards; the motor’s friction is only 0.0109 N·m, so a brake is a must. Size the brake without counting on friction: that is 0.058 N·m at the motor shaft, and we pick a 0.24 N·m spring-applied brake, 4.1 times that. On an E-stop, a Category 0 stop plus the brake: when parked, the carriage sags only 0.065 mm before the brake clamps; if it is lowering at 0.10 m/s, it travels about 4.6 mm more before it stops (our arithmetic), and you must check that this brake, "meant mainly for holding", is allowed to brake like this; if not, use a Category 1 stop, stopping under control first and then applying the brake (steps ⑥ and ⑫).
    10. 编码器和回零：电机上一个每转 1024 线的增量式编码器，四倍频以后每转 4096 格，滑台上每格 0.349 µm；底部一个参考开关，上电回零（第 ⑨ 步）。回差 0.6° 在滑台上只有 8.3 µm（第 ⑦ 步）。Encoder and homing: an incremental encoder with 1024 lines per turn on the motor gives 4096 counts per turn after quadrature (×4) decoding, and 0.349 µm per count at the carriage; a reference switch at the bottom for homing at power-up (step ⑨). The 0.6° of backlash is only 8.3 µm at the carriage (step ⑦).
    11. 还要回答的：手臂对滑台的弯矩由导轨承受，丝杠只管轴向力（导轨的选型这一篇没讲）；丝杠在 1200 rpm 会不会甩（细长的丝杠有临界转速）；装配后实测一次托住电流和反驱力矩，和算的对一对。Still to answer: the arm’s bending moment on the carriage is taken by the guide rail, and the screw carries only axial force (this page does not cover choosing the rail); whether the screw whips at 1200 rpm (a long, slender screw has a critical speed); after assembly, measure the holding current and the backdriving torque once and check them against the calculations.

    这一套零件是：EC 45 flat 70 W（24 V）+ GP 42 C 3.5:1 + 16 × 5 滚珠丝杠 + 0.24 N·m 弹簧制动器 + 每转 1024 线的编码器 + EPOS4 Compact 50/5 CAN + 一个参考开关，接在急停回路的接触器后面。把丝杠换成梯形丝杠 Tr16×4 呢？按 μ = 0.10 算它是自锁的，断电时自己托得住、停着不耗电；可余量很小（μ 低于约 0.09 就不自锁），振动和冲击也会让它慢慢滑，挂着手臂的竖直轴通常照样加制动器。它抬的时候要 2.97 A，铜损是 2.1 倍；导程 4 mm，电池在标称 25.6 V 时滑台只能到约 0.096 m/s；螺纹还会磨（第 ⑥ 步）。两种都说得通，看你更在乎"停着不耗电"还是"效率、速度和寿命"。这个电机已经标了 NRND，真要做，换一款在产的型号，再按同样的十一步走一遍。The set of parts: EC 45 flat 70 W (24 V) + GP 42 C 3.5:1 + 16 × 5 ball screw + 0.24 N·m spring-applied brake + encoder with 1024 lines per turn + EPOS4 Compact 50/5 CAN + one reference switch, wired behind the contactors of the E-stop circuit. What if the screw is swapped for a Tr16×4 trapezoidal lead screw? Calculated with μ = 0.10, it is self-locking: it holds by itself with the power off and uses no power while parked; but the margin is small (if μ falls below about 0.09 it no longer self-locks), and vibration and shocks can also make it creep down slowly, so a vertical axis carrying an arm usually gets a brake anyway. Lifting takes 2.97 A, with 2.1 times the copper loss; with its 4 mm lead, the carriage reaches only about 0.096 m/s at the battery’s nominal 25.6 V; and the thread wears (step ⑥). Both make sense: it depends on whether you care more about "no power while parked" or "efficiency, speed and life". This motor is already marked NRND, so for a real build, switch to a model in production and go through the same eleven steps again.

    • 左边是输入：负载（10–40 kg，默认 26）、速度（0.05–0.20 m/s，默认 0.10）、加速度（0.1–1.0 m/s²，默认 0.5）、每个循环停多久（0–120 s，默认 30）；导程（2、4、5、10、20 mm，默认 5）、丝杠（滚珠 90/80%，或梯形 Tr、μ 0.10）、减速比（不用、3.5、4.3、12、15）、电机绕组（24、36、48 V；36 V 和 48 V 的摩擦和惯量按 24 V 的估）、制动器（无 / 0.24 N·m）、电池（空 20.0 V、标称 25.6 V、满 29.2 V，默认按空的查）。On the left are the inputs: Load (10–40 kg, default 26), Speed (0.05–0.20 m/s, default 0.10), Acceleration (0.1–1.0 m/s², default 0.5), Hold time per cycle (0–120 s, default 30); Lead (2, 4, 5, 10, 20 mm, default 5), Screw (ball 90/80%, or Tr lead screw, μ 0.10), Gear ratio (none, 3.5, 4.3, 12, 15), Motor winding (24, 36, 48 V; friction and inertia for 36 V and 48 V estimated from the 24 V one), Brake (none / 0.24 N·m), Battery (empty 20.0 V, nominal 25.6 V, full 29.2 V; checked at empty by default).
    • 右边是一张检查表，每一行打 ✓、△、✗ 或 i（只是看看），给出数和一句理由：托住的力矩和额定力矩、均方根电流、峰值电流和驱动器、这个电池电压下的速度、减速器的力矩和输入转速、驱动器的连续电流、制动器（或者自锁）、断电和急停时托不托得住、编码器在滑台上的分辨率、折算质量和负载之比、每个循环的能量、绕组的稳态温度、产品状态。另有一张图画一个循环里的电流，横线是驱动器的 5 A、电机的额定电流和均方根；读数：判定、举着要的电流、最大电流、断电以后。预设第一版、第二版、梯形丝杠。On the right is a checklist: each row gets ✓, △, ✗ or i (for information only), with a number and a one-line reason: holding torque against nominal torque, RMS current, peak current and the drive, speed at this battery voltage, gearhead torque and input speed, the drive’s continuous current, the brake (or self-locking), whether it holds on power loss and E-stop, encoder resolution at the carriage, the ratio of reflected mass to load, energy per cycle, steady-state winding temperature, and product status. A chart shows the current over one cycle, with horizontal lines for the drive’s 5 A, the motor’s nominal current and the RMS; readouts: Verdict, Holding current, Peak current, Power off. Presets Design 1, Design 2, Lead screw.

    先玩：按第一版：有几个 ✗，最要命的是哪一个？按第二版，再把负载拉到 40 kg：先出问题的是哪一行？把导程改成 20 mm：哪几行变了，为什么？试一试 48 V 的绕组。Try first: Press Design 1: how many ✗ are there, and which is the worst? Press Design 2, then drag Load to 40 kg: which row runs into trouble first? Change Lead to 20 mm: which rows change, and why? Try the 48 V winding.

      这一步的要点：选型要从负载往回推（力、速度 → 丝杠 → 减速比 → 电机的力矩和转速 → 电流），再从电池往前查（电压够不够、电流给不给得了、热受不受得了），最后单独回答断电和急停时谁托住它。拿要的力矩去比堵转力矩，是最常见、也最危险的一个错。The point of this step: Sizing works backwards from the load (force, speed → screw → gear ratio → motor torque and speed → current), then checks forwards from the battery (is there enough voltage, can the current be supplied, can the heat be handled), and finally answers separately who holds it up on power loss and E-stop. Comparing the torque you need with the stall torque is the most common mistake, and the most dangerous.

      第 ⑯ 步 · 同样的问题，问别的机器人Step ⑯ · The same questions, put to other robots

      换一台机器人A different robot

      升降柱、轮子、FR3 的关节，三根轴就做了三种不同的选择。换一台机器人，零件全换了，问题却还是那几个：减速比多大？能不能反驱？力矩怎么量？编码器装在哪？断电以后会怎样？电从哪来、够用多久？下面拿这几个问题，去问几种很不一样的机器。答不上来的地方，照实写"没有公开"：知道自己缺什么，也是看懂一台机器人的一部分。The lift column, the wheels and the FR3’s joints: just three axes, and already three different sets of choices. Move to another robot and every part changes, yet the questions are the same few: How big is the gear ratio? Can it be backdriven? How is torque measured? Where are the encoders mounted? What happens when the power is cut? Where does the power come from, and how long does it last? Below, we put these questions to several very different machines. Where we cannot answer, we say so plainly: "not published". Knowing what you are missing is part of understanding a robot, too.

      • FR3 的关节：公开的是限制和传感器：力矩 87 N·m（1–4 号关节）、12 N·m（5–7 号），速度 2.62 rad/s（1–4 号）、5.26 rad/s（5、7 号）、4.18 rad/s（6 号），每个关节在连杆侧有力矩传感器，libfranka 同时给出关节位置 q 和电机位置 theta；急停是 1 类停止，断电后由锁止销锁住，锁上时手臂会往下沉几厘米（规格书，控制参数页，libfranka 文档，硬件手册）。用的是什么电机、什么减速器、减速比多大，没有公开。The FR3’s joints: the published details are the limits and the sensors: torque 87 N·m (joints 1–4) and 12 N·m (5–7); speed 2.62 rad/s (1–4), 5.26 rad/s (5 and 7) and 4.18 rad/s (6); a torque sensor on the link side of every joint; and libfranka reports both the joint position q and the motor position theta. The E-stop is a category 1 stop; once the power is off, locking bolts lock the joints, and as they engage the arm sinks by a few centimetres (datasheet, Franka’s control parameters page, libfranka docs, hardware manual). The motors, reducers and gear ratios it uses are not published.
      • Mini Cheetah 的关节（四足机器人）：一个航模用的大直径无刷电机，配 6 比 1 的单级行星减速器；峰值 17 N·m、连续 6.9 N·m，480 g；只在电机侧装了一个 14 位的磁编码器；不装力矩传感器，用电流控制力矩，作者说这正是选低减速比、能反驱的原因（Katz，2018；机器人的名字和整机见 Katz 等，2019）。这类关节常叫"准直驱"。The Mini Cheetah’s joints (a quadruped robot): a large-diameter brushless motor made for model aircraft, with a 6:1 single-stage planetary gearhead; 17 N·m peak and 6.9 N·m continuous, 480 g; a single 14-bit magnetic encoder, on the motor side only; no torque sensor, with torque controlled through the current, and the author says this is exactly why it was given a low gear ratio and made backdrivable (Katz, 2018; for the robot’s name and the whole machine, see Katz et al., 2019). Joints like this are often called "quasi-direct drive".
      • Unitree H1（人形机器人）：膝关节约 360 N·m，髋关节约 220 N·m，踝关节约 59 N·m，手臂关节约 75 N·m；电机是"低惯量、高转速的内转子永磁同步电机"；电池 15 Ah、0.864 kWh，最高 67.2 V（Unitree 产品页）。67.2 V 正好是 16 节锂电芯充满的 4.2 V × 16（我们算的）。减速器的类型和减速比，产品页没写。Unitree H1 (a humanoid robot): about 360 N·m at the knee, about 220 N·m at the hip, about 59 N·m at the ankle and about 75 N·m at the arm joints; each motor is a "low inertia high-speed internal rotor PMSM" (permanent-magnet synchronous motor); the battery is 15 Ah, 0.864 kWh, 67.2 V maximum (Unitree product page). 67.2 V is exactly what 16 fully charged lithium cells give: 4.2 V × 16 (our arithmetic). The product page does not say what type of reducer is used or what the gear ratio is.
      • Dynamixel XM430-W350（小舵机）：一台空心杯电机，全金属齿轮减速 353.5 比 1；12 V 时堵转 4.1 N·m、空载 46 rpm；输出轴上一个 12 位的绝对式磁编码器；有电流控制模式；只有 82 g（ROBOTIS 说明书）。说明书自己提醒：堵转力矩不是连续能用的力矩。它的反驱力矩没有公开；关掉力矩以后用手能扳动，只是很涩：ALOHA 2 的主手就是人用手扳着走、让从手跟着做的，主手的关节用的正是这款舵机（ALOHA 2 的报告，Trossen 的规格页）。Dynamixel XM430-W350 (a small servo): a coreless motor with all-metal gears reducing 353.5:1; at 12 V, 4.1 N·m stall torque and 46 rpm with no load; a 12-bit absolute magnetic encoder on the output shaft; a current control mode; and it weighs only 82 g (ROBOTIS e-Manual). The e-Manual itself warns that the stall torque is not a torque you can use continuously. Its backdriving torque is not published; with the torque switched off it can be turned by hand, but it is stiff. In ALOHA 2, a person moves the leader arms by hand and the follower arms copy them, and the joints of the leader arms use exactly this servo (ALOHA 2 report, Trossen spec page).
      • 工业机器人的大关节：常用 RV 减速器，两级（一级齿轮加一级摆线），滞后损失小于 1′，急停时能承受额定力矩的 5 倍（Nabtesco）。The big joints of industrial robots: these commonly use an RV reducer with two stages (one gear stage plus one cycloidal stage); its hysteresis loss is under 1′, and it can take 5 times its rated torque in an emergency stop (Nabtesco).
      • 人形机器人的直线关节：特斯拉 2022 年 AI Day 展示的 Optimus 原型有 28 个结构执行器（electrek）；据二手资料转述，这些是特斯拉在那次 AI Day 上展示的：其中的直线执行器围绕行星滚柱丝杠来做，最大的一种推力 8000 N（humanoid.guide 的汇总）；特斯拉没有发布书面的规格。Linear joints in humanoid robots: the Optimus prototype that Tesla showed at its 2022 AI Day has 28 structural actuators (electrek). Secondary sources, retelling what Tesla showed at that AI Day, report that its linear actuators are built around planetary roller screws and that the largest gives a thrust of 8000 N (humanoid.guide’s summary); Tesla has not published a written specification.
      • 电池：1X 的 NEO 是 842 Wh，能用 4 小时（1X），平均功率约 210 W（我们算的）；我们的厨房机器人是 2048 Wh、平均 251 W。一台人形机器人和一台厨房机器人，平均耗电在同一个量级。Batteries: 1X’s NEO has 842 Wh and runs for 4 hours (1X), about 210 W on average (our arithmetic); our kitchen robot has 2048 Wh and averages 251 W. A humanoid robot and a kitchen robot draw power of the same order of magnitude on average.

      放在一起看，选择是有规律的：要被地面反复撞击、要靠电流感受力的腿，用低减速比；要精细、要被人碰、又要量力的协作臂，在关节里加力矩传感器；要扛重、要刚、要准的工业臂，用 RV 和谐波；要小、要便宜、要有劲的舵机，用几百比一的齿轮，反驱很费劲；要推大力的直线关节，用丝杠。没有哪一种是"最好的"，每一种都是在第 ④ 到第 ⑩ 步那几件事之间，为自己的任务挑了一个位置。Put side by side, the choices follow a pattern. Legs, which are hit by the ground again and again and have to feel force through the current, use low gear ratios. Collaborative arms, which have to be precise, cope with people touching them and measure force as well, put torque sensors in their joints. Industrial arms, which must carry heavy loads and be stiff and accurate, use RV and strain wave gears. Servos, which must be small, cheap and strong, use gears of several hundred to one and are hard to backdrive. Linear joints that have to push hard use screws. None of these is "the best": each has picked, for its own task, a place among the trade-offs of steps ④ to ⑩.

      • 一张"问题 × 机器人"的表：行是 FR3 关节、厨房升降柱、厨房轮子、Mini Cheetah 关节、Unitree H1、Dynamixel XM430-W350、工业臂 RV 关节、人形直线关节、1X NEO；列是减速、峰值和连续力矩、能反驱吗、力矩怎么量、编码器在哪、断电会怎样、电池。格子分五种：公开的、我们的设计（示意）、二手来源、未公开、我们的资料里没有（不等于没公开），上面数着每一种各有几格。宽屏上点一格，它那一行、一列亮起来，下面显示完整的一句和出处；点机器人的名字，看它的整张卡片。A "question × robot" table. The rows are FR3 joint, Kitchen lift, Kitchen wheel, Mini Cheetah actuator, Unitree H1, Dynamixel XM430-W350, Industrial-arm RV joint, Humanoid linear actuator and 1X NEO; the columns are Reduction, Peak & continuous torque, Backdrivable?, How torque is sensed, Where the encoders sit, What happens when power is cut and Battery. There are five kinds of cell: published, our design (illustrative), secondary sources, not published, and not in our sources (which is not the same as not published); the counts at the top show how many cells there are of each kind. On a wide screen, click a cell and its row and column light up, with the full sentence and its source shown below; click a robot’s name to see its whole card.
      • 上面的问题按钮可以只看某一列，这时九台机器人的答案排成一列长句；手机上看全部时，一次看一台机器人，用 ◀ ▶ 翻。The Question buttons at the top let you look at a single column; the nine robots’ answers then line up in one column as full sentences. On a phone, with All selected, you see one robot at a time and flip through them with ◀ ▶.

      先玩：点能反驱吗这一列，从上往下看：哪几台能，为什么？再看力矩怎么量：用电流的那几台，减速比都是多大？数一数整张表里有几个"未公开"，它们集中在哪一列？Try first: Click Backdrivable? and read that column from top to bottom: which machines can be backdriven, and why? Then look at How torque is sensed: for the ones that use the current, what are the gear ratios? Count the "Not published" cells in the whole table: which column are they concentrated in?

      这一步的要点：换一台机器人，问的还是同样几个问题：减速比、能不能反驱、力矩怎么量、编码器在哪、断电以后会怎样、电够用多久。低减速比加电流感力，适合腿；力矩传感器加控制，适合协作臂；RV 和谐波适合又刚又准的工业臂；几百比一的齿轮适合小舵机。答不上来的，要知道去哪里找，或者承认没有公开。The point of this step: On a different robot you still ask the same few questions: the gear ratio, whether it can be backdriven, how torque is measured, where the encoders are, what happens when the power is cut, and how long the battery lasts. A low gear ratio with force sensed through the current suits legs; torque sensors plus control suit collaborative arms; RV and strain wave gears suit industrial arms that must be stiff and accurate; gears of several hundred to one suit small servos. Where you cannot answer, know where to look, or admit that it is not published.

      总结 · 回到升降柱Summary · Back to the lift column

      力矩从哪来，在哪里卡住Where the torque comes from, and where it gets stuck

      回到开场的三件事。第一版停在顶上三秒就滑下去：抬要 11.2 A，停着不往下滑最少也要 8.0 A，可电机能长期通的只有 3.29 A（热，第 ② 步），驱动器也只给 15 A、3 s（第 ②、⑪ 步），而滚珠丝杠会被重物推着倒转（第 ⑥ 步），断电又没有东西托住。选电机时拿要的 0.451 N·m 去比 1.69 N·m 的堵转力矩，正好比错了那一行（第 ⑬ 步）。第二版把导程换成 5 mm，又加了 3.5 比 1 的减速器，托住只要 1.77 A（第 ④、⑥ 步），可急停时力矩被拿走，竖直的轴没有制动器，还是会掉（第 ⑫ 步）。轮子换向时少走的 1.40 mm，是减速器的回差，装在电机上的编码器看不见（第 ⑦、⑨ 步）。Back to the three incidents from the opening. Design 1 slid down after three seconds at the top: raising it takes 11.2 A, and just keeping it from sliding down takes at least 8.0 A, but the motor can carry only 3.29 A continuously (heat, step ②), and the drive, too, gives only 15 A for 3 s (steps ② and ⑪); on top of that, the load can push the ball screw round backwards (step ⑥), and nothing holds it up when the power is off. When the motor was chosen, the 0.451 N·m it needed was compared with the 1.69 N·m stall torque: precisely the wrong row to compare with (step ⑬). Design 2 switched to a 5 mm lead and added a 3.5:1 gearhead, so holding it up takes only 1.77 A (steps ④ and ⑥); but an E-stop takes the torque away, and a vertical axis without a brake still falls (step ⑫). The 1.40 mm that the wheels fall short by each time they reverse is the gearhead’s backlash, which the encoder on the motor cannot see (steps ⑦ and ⑨).

      整条链可以这样记：Here is one way to remember the whole chain:

      • 电池给一个会往下掉的电压、一份会用完的能量；电压决定能转多快（第 ③ 步）。The battery supplies a voltage that sags and a store of energy that runs out; the voltage sets how fast the motor can turn (step ③).
      • 驱动器用 PWM 和电流环把电压变成指定的电流，把电流限在允许的范围里，盯着电压、温度和跟随误差，按状态机一步步才肯出力（第 ③、⑪ 步）。The drive uses PWM and a current loop to turn the voltage into the commanded current, keeps the current within the allowed range, watches the voltage, the temperature and the following error, and only puts out torque after stepping through its state machine (steps ③ and ⑪).
      • 电机把电流变成力矩，τ = ktI，转起来产生反电动势；能做到的是一条力矩–转速线，能长期待着的那一段由热决定（第 ①、② 步）。The motor turns current into torque, τ = ktI, and produces a back-EMF when it turns; what it can do is a torque–speed line, and the stretch of that line where it can stay for long is set by heat (steps ① and ②).
      • 减速器和丝杠把力矩放大 N 倍，把转子惯量放大 N² 倍；它们带来回差、摩擦和柔性，决定了能不能反驱（第 ④–⑧ 步）。The gearhead and the screw multiply the torque by N and the rotor inertia by N²; they bring backlash, friction and compliance, and decide whether the axis can be backdriven (steps ④–⑧).
      • 传感器：电机侧的编码器细而看不见传动链，关节侧的看得见；力矩可以从电流算、用应变片量、或者量弹簧扭了多少（第 ⑨、⑩ 步）。Sensors: an encoder on the motor side has fine resolution but cannot see the transmission, while one on the joint side can; torque can be calculated from the current, measured with strain gauges, or found from how far a spring has twisted (steps ⑨ and ⑩).
      • 安全链在硬件上把力矩拿走，竖直的轴还要有制动器托住；每一根轴都要回答"动力没了，谁让它停，谁托住它"（第 ⑫ 步）。The safety chain takes the torque away in hardware, and a vertical axis also needs a brake to hold it up; every axis has to answer "with the power gone, who stops it, and who holds it up?" (step ⑫).
      • 规格书和接口说明：弄清条件，互相验算，看注释，找最弱的一环，标出"有但没认证""有但没写多大"（第 ⑬、⑭ 步）。Datasheets and interface descriptions: pin down the conditions, check the figures against each other, read the notes, find the weakest link, and mark anything "present but not certified" or "present but no rating given" (steps ⑬ and ⑭).

      拿到任何一台机器人，都可以顺着这条链问一遍：每个关节的电机和减速比是多少，峰值和连续力矩各多大；它能不能反驱，断电以后会怎样；位置在哪一侧量，力矩怎么量；驱动器听什么指令、有什么状态、越界会怎样；急停按下去，每根轴怎么停，谁托住竖直的轴；电池多大，平均多少瓦，能用多久。能从规格书里找到答案的，验算一遍；找不到的，就是你要去问厂家、去实测、或者去拆开看的地方。Given any robot, you can walk along this chain and ask: what motor and gear ratio does each joint have, and how large are its peak and continuous torques? Can it be backdriven, and what happens when the power is cut? On which side is position measured, and how is torque measured? What commands does the drive accept, what states does it have, and what happens when something goes out of bounds? When the E-stop is pressed, how does each axis stop, and who holds up the vertical axes? How big is the battery, how many watts does the robot draw on average, and how long does it last? Where the datasheet gives the answer, check it with your own arithmetic; where it doesn’t, that is where you have to ask the maker, measure it yourself, or take it apart and look.

      • maxon EC 45 flat 70 W、GP 42 C 和 EPOS4 Compact 50/5 CAN：这一篇读的那几页规格书和接口说明（第 ⑬、⑭ 步）。maxon EC 45 flat 70 W, GP 42 C and EPOS4 Compact 50/5 CAN: the datasheet pages and the interface description read on this page (steps ⑬ and ⑭).
      • maxon 的电机数据说明：每一行规格书的定义，热、过载和温度的影响（第 ①、② 步）。maxon’s notes on motor data: what each line of the datasheet means, and the effects of heat, overload and temperature (steps ① and ②).
      • Harmonic Drive CSG-2UH 和 CSD-20-80：谐波减速器的力矩、刚度和反驱力矩（第 ⑤、⑦ 步）。Harmonic Drive CSG-2UH and CSD-20-80: the torque, stiffness and backdriving torque of strain wave gears (steps ⑤ and ⑦).
      • Roton：丝杠的效率和反驱：正反两个效率和自锁（第 ⑥ 步）。Roton: screw efficiency and backdriving: the two efficiencies, forward and backdrive, and self-locking (step ⑥).
      • Katz，Mini Cheetah 的关节 和 Schuller 等，带力矩传感的谐波减速器：低减速比用电流感力，高减速比为什么要力矩传感器（第 ⑧、⑩ 步）。Katz, the Mini Cheetah actuator and Schuller et al., a strain wave gear with torque sensing: sensing force through the current at a low gear ratio, and why a high gear ratio needs a torque sensor (steps ⑧ and ⑩).
      • Synapticon：STO 和 SBC、Kollmorgen：停止类别和急停：急停和制动的规矩（第 ⑫ 步）。Synapticon: STO and SBC, Kollmorgen: stop categories and E-stops: the rules for E-stops and braking (step ⑫).
      • FR3 硬件手册 和 Franka 控制参数：这台手臂的急停、锁止销和接口限制（第 ⑪、⑫ 步）。FR3 hardware manual and Franka’s control parameters: this arm’s E-stop, locking bolts and interface limits (steps ⑪ and ⑫).
      • 第 5 篇：环环相扣：电流环、PWM 和硬件安全回路在整个控制环里的位置。Page 5: Loops Within Loops: where the current loop, PWM and the hardware safety circuit fit among all the control loops.
      • 第 6 篇：从 PID 到世界模型：阻抗控制为什么需要能控力矩的关节。Page 6: From PID to World Models: why impedance control needs joints whose torque can be controlled.
      • 第 11 篇：关节和手之间：关节力矩和手上的力怎么换算，手上感到的质量。Page 11: Between the Joints and the Hand: how joint torques and forces at the hand convert into each other, and the mass felt at the hand.
      • 第 15 篇：一台机器人，几十个程序：总线、驱动和 ros2_control 在整台机器人里的位置。Page 15: One Robot, Dozens of Programs: where buses, drivers and ros2_control fit into the robot as a whole.
      • 上一篇：每次都偏一点：负载没登记时的"假外力"，和手臂自己准不准。Previous page: A Little Off, Every Time: the "phantom external force" when the payload is not configured, and how accurate the arm itself is.
      本页约定：力矩按 N·m、mN·m，电流按 A，电压按 V，功率按 W，转速按 rpm 和 rad/s，温度按 °C、温差按 K；引用的数照原文的写法。"我们算的"来自本页仓库 actuation/calc/ 里的小程序；"估"是没有出处的数量级估计；"示意"是为了讲清楚而定的设计或编的数。厨房机器人和厨房都是虚构的；升降柱、电池、底盘电机和急停回路是我们照着真实产品配的，零件的数据来自厂家的规格书，FR3 的数据来自 Franka 的文档。所有交互都在你的浏览器里实时计算，用固定的随机种子，所以每次打开看到的数都一样。Conventions on this page: torque in N·m and mN·m, current in A, voltage in V, power in W, speed in rpm and rad/s, temperature in °C and temperature differences in K; numbers quoted from sources are written the way the source writes them. "Our arithmetic" comes from the small programs in actuation/calc/ in this page’s repository; "est." marks an order-of-magnitude estimate with no source; "illustrative" marks a design chosen, or numbers made up, to make a point clear. The kitchen robot and the kitchen are both fictional; the lift column, the battery, the base motors and the E-stop circuit are ones we specified to match real products, with part data from the makers’ datasheets and FR3 data from Franka’s documentation. All the interactive figures are computed live in your browser with fixed random seeds, so you see the same numbers every time you open the page.
